text: Bars grow staggered (0.5s delay each) with labels fading in after growth. Line draws via stroke-dashoffset over 3s; a dot tracks the line, and value labels count up (0.8s power2.out) as the dot arrives. Source line fades in last.
how: Extend our data-driven chart components (brain: 'Data-driven chart components with real measurements') with this animation sequence in compose_lab.py. Use GSAP attr for bar height, strokeDashoffset for line, and dummy object tween for counter.

title: Editorial flash overlay with screen-blend gradient layers
text: Three CSS gradient layers (wash, core radial, sweep linear) with mix-blend-mode: screen, animated at 58% of duration: wash flashes 0.04s, core scales 0.86→1 in 0.05s, sweep slides 0.04s; all decay in 0.18-0.34s. Seek-safe, no WebGL.
how: Add as a lightweight transition overlay in compose.py/compose_lab.py. Define CSS custom properties for colors (--hf-editorial-flash-warm, etc.). Insert at cut points via timeline label 'flash'.

title: SVG Connector Drawing via Stroke-Dashoffset
text: Pre-draw full path, set stroke-dasharray=1000, stroke-dashoffset=1000. Animate dashoffset→0 with linear ease for constant-speed draw. Labels fade in at 50% of draw. Works for any flowchart, org chart, or route map.
how: Use in animated map shorts (planned) and tech architecture diagrams. Generate SVG paths from data in plan.py; animate in compose_lab.py via GSAP. No WebGL needed.

title: Extruded 3D Logo with Per-Letter Flip-Up
text: Beveled 3D letters (Three.js TextGeometry) flip up sequentially from face-down, then the whole word swings ±24° so specular highlights rake across bevels. Three material presets (chrome, gold, matte) via MeshStandardMaterial. Font loaded as typeface JSON; max 8 chars, auto-scales to fit 7.4 world units. Rim light and softbox studio environment for crisp reflections.
how: Add as a lab-look title card block in compose_lab.py: create a HyperFrames composition wrapper that passes text, tagline, finish, rim_color, background as variables. Use existing font-subsetting pipeline to generate Geist-Bold.typeface.json. Render via headless Chrome (already in stack).

title: Performance profiles with upscaler and render scale
text: Frost Sequence exposes quality (full/lite), upscaler (FSR1, TAAU, bilinear, native), and renderScale (0.35–1.0). Lite profile targets software WebGPU; full needs real GPU. Allows fast previews and final renders from same block.
how: Add --quality flag to our render CLI (doctor.py/render step). Implement FSR1/TAAU via FFmpeg filters or canvas drawImage scaling. Use renderScale=0.5 for preflight stills, 1.0 for final. Cuts GPU memory and render time.

title: Segment recycling tied to fog distance for seamless loops
text: Gallery Tunnel sets recycle boundary BACK = NUM_SEGMENTS * SEGMENT_DEPTH - FOG_FAR. Segments reappear already fogged to pure backdrop, so nothing pops in at the far end. Moving fog automatically moves the boundary — single source of truth.
how: Apply to our looping backgrounds (starfields, particle fields, map routes). Compute recycle distance from fog/fade parameter so loop point is invisible. Implement in compose_lab.py for any infinite-motion block.

title: Canvas texture headlines for 3D refraction
text: Glass Hero draws the headline to an off-screen canvas (3840×2160), auto-sizes font to fit width, then uses it as a CanvasTexture on a backdrop plane behind the glass. The glass material (transmission=1, dispersion=0.6) refracts the live texture.
how: For Kaise Tech 3D intros, render Hinglish/English headlines to high-res canvas texture, place behind a glass/refractive object. Use Geist/Inter font via FontFace API. Gives crisp, editable text that interacts with 3D materials.

title: WebGPU shader blocks for procedural backgrounds
text: Frost and Gabor Noise are 2-second, 31-line blocks that load a single WebGPU shader (shaders.iife.js) into a canvas. Zero JavaScript animation logic; the shader handles time, frost creep, noise drift. MIT licensed from shaders.com.
how: Add a 'shader' block type to our pipeline: write minimal HTML compositions that load a curated GLSL/WGSL shader (frost, noise, caustics, halftone) via a shared shader library. Use for lab-look backgrounds instead of Muse/FLUX, saving credits and ensuring style consistency.

title: Off-screen asset decode well for texture loading
text: Gallery Tunnel loads caller-supplied images into a 1px clipped div (#gt-assets) so the browser decodes them before WebGL upload. texImage2D reads the laid-out size; CSS scaling would upload 1×1 textures.
how: In our image pipeline (Muse/FLUX/Pollinations), add a hidden decode well in the composition HTML. Preload all asset URLs there before passing to Three.js or canvas drawImage. Prevents blank frames on first render.

title: Flat dark background for glass/HUD blocks
text: Glass shard title uses #0a0a0f flat background — no gradients, no glow. Godrays/goo use #000. Ensures clean compositing over any footage, avoids color contamination. HDR environment provides lighting; matcap gives iridescence. Fog uniform adds depth cue.
how: Enforce in compose_lab style guide: background: #0a0a0f for glass, #000 for WebGPU shaders. Document in AGENTS.md. Preflight.py should flag gradient backgrounds in lab blocks.

title: Voronoi text shatter into glass shards
text: Rasterize headline to bitmap, sample occupied pixels, run seeded Poisson-disc + Delaunay (d3-delaunay) to generate Voronoi cells, extrude each cell into a beveled glass mesh with HDR environment map and matcap. Shards fly in from ±X/Z with staggered rotation, assemble, idle, then fly out. All motion pure functions of two master progresses (tin, tout).
how: Add new compose_lab block 'glass-shard-title' using Three.js (r158+), d3-delaunay, seeded mulberry32. Expose variables: headline, tileCount (1-400), roundness, bevel, flyIn/OutTime, stagger, chaos, fog. Integrate with HyperFrames timeline (master tin/tout). Preload HDR + matcap assets. Use runtime canvas creation to avoid parser issues.

title: SVG gooey metaball filter (blur + alpha threshold)
text: SVG filter: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation=28 → feColorMatrix with 24× alpha gain and -8.9 bias (threshold ~0.392). Apply to container holding moving dots; filter activates only during split/merge windows (tl.set filter on/off). Dots use transform-only animation so shutter samples real trajectory.
how: Add gooey-metaball helper in compose_lab: create <filter id='goo'> in defs, apply filter: url(#goo) to group. Toggle via tl.set at precise timestamps. Pair with motion-blur snippet for directional smear. Use for logo reveals, UI morphs, scene transitions.

title: Guarded script evaluation + hf-seek sync + bfcache cleanup
text: IIFE checks if canvas exists before creating (prevents double-eval). Named seek handler (gstOnSeek) for removeEventListener match. Kills previous timeline on re-eval. Registers hf-seek listener; on pagehide (persisted=false) removes listener, kills timeline. Timeline drives master progresses (tin, tout) only; renderScene reads pure functions.
how: Update compose_lab template: wrap Three.js init in (function(){ if (document.getElementById('canvas-id')) return; ... })(). Use named seek handler function. Add pagehide cleanup. Ensure all per-frame state derived from st.tin/st.tout/st.time (no integrators). Apply to all lab blocks.

title: Media-in-host-root rule for sub-compositions
text: hw-frame docs explicitly warn: runtime never seeks media elements inside sub-compositions. Keep
how: Update compose.py and compose_lab.py to enforce this pattern: sub-composition exposes a transparent slot (data attributes), host injects media clip on track above. Add preflight check for media inside sub-comps.

title: Gamma-crush halftone look for dark lab aesthetic
text: Shader computes luminance of hue field, applies pow(luma, gamma) with gamma=12 (mapped from 1–20 UI). This crushes midtones so only noise crests become visible dots; bias lifts floor. Quantize flag snaps time to 30fps for LED-wall stepping.
how: Document in style guide for Kaise Tech 'lab' look. When using halftone-field, set gamma 10–14, bias 1–3, frequency 1.5–3 for broad plasma bands. Add quantize=true for retro-terminal sections.

title: Per-character stagger capped by duration budget
text: hw-path-text and hw-text-cloud compute delay = min(typeCharDelay, budget / chars) where budget ≈ 1.8–2.6s. Prevents long text from overrunning scene duration.
how: Apply in caption.py handwrite styles: set max_stagger_budget = scene_duration * 0.3; clamp per-char delay. Ensures hooks always finish before cut.

title: Hard-kill root at last visual frame, not at duration
text: hw-scribble-transition calls tl.set(root, {visibility:'hidden'}, 2.17) when last band clears (2.17s) instead of waiting for full 2.2s duration. Avoids blank frame flash on loop/transition.
how: Update review.py and doctor.py to flag compositions that hide root at data-duration. Enforce hide-time = last keyframe end in all block templates.

title: Reusable hwBoil wobble system
text: Deterministic per-frame jitter (position ±amp, rotation ±rot) driven by seeded hash, applied every N frames (frameDrop=3). Targets an array of elements; baseRot preserves intentional tilt. Used across frame, path-text, pipeline, text-cloud, scribble-transition.
how: Extract hwHash/hwBoil/hwOnUpdate into a shared motion utility (motion/boil.js). Import in compose_lab.py and classic compose.py for any hand-drawn layer. Seed per video for reproducibility.

title: Hand-drawn frame with corner doodles and caption
text: Wobbled rectangle border (stroke-dashoffset draw-on 0.9s), three corner spark doodles (staggered 0.12s), optional caption fade-in (1.4s). Whole unit (media+svg+caption) tilted (default -1.2°) and boiled together. Media slot documented for host-side footage.
how: Add as 'sketched-frame' block in compose.py for Puraan Ki Katha photo sequences. Planner provides image URL, caption, tilt. Host composition places video/photo in slot. Reuse hwWobbleRect and hwBoil.

title: Single-dispatcher onUpdate pattern (hwOnUpdate)
text: Attach multiple render functions to one GSAP timeline via tl.__hwRenders[]; single onUpdate calls all. Eliminates callback conflicts, guarantees deterministic order (boil, sweep, underline, write-on all on same timeline).
how: Refactor compose_lab.py's GSAP timeline builder: replace multiple eventCallback('onUpdate') with a hwOnUpdate(tl, fn) helper that pushes to tl.__hwRenders. Apply to all lab blocks (HUD, charts, kinetic titles).

title: Pose-based parameterization (boilPose, writeOnPose)
text: Replace raw numeric controls with named poses: boil ∈ {off, calm:{amp:1.6,rot:0.5}, lively:{amp:2.6,rot:0.9}}; writeOn ∈ {off, trace, reveal}. Unknown pose → console.error + fallback. Locks frameDrop=3, seed=8 for determinism.
how: Update plan.py schema: add boil_pose and write_on_pose enums to title block config. Map to amp/rot in compose_lab.py. Keeps Telegram approval UI simple (dropdowns) while preserving deterministic output.

title: Liquid glass notification card (CSS + Canvas shader)
text: Backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.35); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.42), rgba(255,255,255,0.13)) + rgba(140,150,164,0.52); border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.27). Canvas draw: clip to rounded rect, draw glassBuffer (blurred screen) with filter blur(12px) saturate(1.55), overlay caustic gradient (screen blend), stroke highlight, icon + text.
how: Port to compose_lab.py as a HUD block: render notification card to offscreen canvas, apply glass shader via Canvas 2D filters. Use for 'Kaise Tech' stat pop-ups, myth story verse cards. No WebGPU needed.

title: Planar UV correction for GLTF screen mapping
text: If GLTF screen UVs are wrong (tiled/clamped), recompute: geometry.computeBoundingBox(), uv.x = (pos.x - bb.min.x)/width, uv.y = (pos.y - bb.min.y)/height. Also align model so screen faces -Z: compare front/back mesh world Z, rotateY += PI if needed.
how: Add to doctor.py as a GLTF validation step for any future 3D device mockup blocks. Not needed now but good pattern for asset pipeline reliability.

title: HTML-in-Canvas capture via drawElementImage
text: Set canvas.layoutsubtree + width/height; canvas.getContext('2d').drawElementImage(htmlElement, 0, 0, w, h) captures live DOM (including CSS animations) to texture each frame. Requires Chrome flag #canvas-draw-element; CLI renderer enables automatically.
how: Document in AGENTS.md for future 'device frame' blocks. Not immediately usable (flag required), but enables recording browser UI interactions (code demos, app walkthroughs) as video layers without screen recording.

title: Fallback glyph handling for missing baked characters
text: When a character lacks baked strokes, emit console.warn, create <text> element with live font, fade in at writeEnd×0.5. Bundled @font-face ensures font loads. Keeps write-on working for arbitrary Hinglish/Devanagari.
how: In bake script, output coverage report. In compose_lab.py write-on module, implement fallback branch: if char not in table, create SVG <text> with class hw-wt-fallback, animate opacity 0→1. Test with Devanagari sample.

title: Aurora simplex noise shader
text: Three.js fragment shader using 3D simplex noise (snoise) to generate animated aurora bands: warm/cool/hot color zones, ridge-based creases, edge glow, vignette, gamma correction. Runs at 60fps on GPU. No textures needed.
how: Copy the fragment shader into a new WebGPU/Three.js background block for Kaise Tech intros. Parameterize color palette, speed, intensity via CSS custom properties. Use as dynamic lab background behind HUD elements.

title: Clip-path wipe entrances for UI panels
text: Lower-third blocks use clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0 0% 0 0) for left-to-right wipe-in, and inset(0 0 0 100%) for wipe-out. Accent tab scales Y from 0. Text rises with stagger. Performant, works in headless Chrome.
how: Replace opacity/scale entrances in compose_lab.py HUD panels with clip-path inset wipes. Add a 'wipeIn' utility that takes direction (left, right, top, bottom) and duration. Use for stat cards, comparison panels, end cards.

title: Piece-by-piece logo assembly
text: SVG logo split into 5 paths. Each slides from x:1920 with 0.08s stagger, power4.out. Then expand (scale 1.15, back.out), settle. Radial glow blooms behind. Tagline and URL pill fade up with y offset. 6s total.
how: Adapt for Studio360 end card: split logo SVG into pieces, animate with same stagger/bloom pattern. Add Hinglish tagline and channel handle pill. Replace current pen-stroke reveal with this higher-energy assembly.

title: Broadcast lower-third patterns
text: Three minimal styles: (1) Accent underline — name rises, rule draws left→right, role fades; text-shadow for legibility. (2) Bold block — dark block wipes in, uppercase name slams up (back.out), yellow tag pops. (3) Clean bar — white card clip-wipe, red accent tab grows, name/role rise. All 4.8s.
how: Add lower-third presets to compose.py for speaker intros, episode titles, source citations. Use accent underline for Puraan Ki Katha narrator names, bold block for Kaise Tech host labels, clean bar for data citations. Variables for text.

title: Lottie + GSAP hybrid character acting
text: Load a Lottie JSON (walk, stop, point) via lottie-web, push player to window.__hfLottie for global time sync. GSAP timeline triggers UI card reveal at Lottie's 5.2s point marker. Variables for title/body text. 7.5s.
how: Add lottie-web dependency. In compose_lab.py, create a CharacterBlock that loads a mascot Lottie, exposes gesture markers (point, wave), and syncs GSAP UI animations to those timestamps. Enables recurring characters without full avatar system.

title: Kicker/eyebrow tag for instant context
text: Kicker-name places a compact accent badge (Space Mono, 22px, uppercase, padded) above the main name — e.g., "Episode 47" — animated with back.out(2) drop-in. Provides series/episode context in 0.4s without extra voice.
how: In plan.py, when series_id exists, auto-insert kicker line in lower-third spec; style with brand accent color from plate-based color system.

title: Text-shadow for footage legibility
text: All cardless lower-thirds (kicker-name, mask-reveal, side-rule) use text-shadow: 0 2px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) on name and 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.45) on role. Ensures white text reads over unpredictable footage without opaque cards.
how: Add textShadowPreset('footage') in caption system; apply automatically when lower-third has no background card. Use in compose.py and compose_lab.py.

title: macOS notification banner as social-proof overlay
text: macOS-notification slides in from right (x: 420→0, power3.out 0.5s) with backdrop-filter blur(40px), semi-transparent dark card, app icon, title, and clamped 2-line body. Runs 5s, exits right. Ideal for "Trending now", "Breaking", or viewer comment callouts.
how: Add notificationBanner() in compose.py; trigger from stats.py when a Shorts spike detected. Style with brand colors; use Inter font (already in stack).

title: Glassmorphism UI drawing primitives
text: Reusable Canvas 2D functions: `drawGlassPanel`, `drawRoundedImage`, `drawNotification`, `drawDock`, `drawFinderWindow`, `drawMenuBar` — all using layered gradients, inner/outer strokes, and shadows for consistent macOS Tahoe glass look.
how: Port to a JS module (e.g., `glass-ui.js`) and call from compose_lab.py's UI panel, stat counter, chat bubble, and terminal typing renderers for a unified glassmorphism aesthetic.

title: Cinematic 3D device orbit with breathing motion
text: Turntable group rotates phone+laptop together; subtle sin/cos position/rotation noise on `drift` time (0.015 amplitude); GSAP timeline drives 12s camera pull-back (4.5→7) and device breathing tilt (±0.04 rad) on custom cubic-bezier eases.
how: Create reusable HyperFrames block `device-orbit` for showcase shots (app/website on device). Integrate into compose_lab.py with GSAP timeline driving both 3D transforms and live HTML capture.

title: Composition capability metadata
text: Composition root uses `data-requires-webgpu` and `data-no-timeline` attributes for runtime gating. `data-requires-webgpu` signals WebGPU dependency; `data-no-timeline` marks shader-only blocks that don't need GSAP timeline.
how: Add `capabilities` field to composition schema in compose.py/preflight.py; validate renderer supports WebGPU before scheduling; skip timeline for `no-timeline` blocks.

title: Artifact-closed-loop calibration comments
text: CSS comments document measured reference vs rendered values: e.g., `font 32.9px: artifact-closed-loop calibration (ref m1 ink 624x32 vs shipped-render 711x36 -> x0.876)`. Ensures deterministic visual parity across renders.
how: Adopt in compose_lab.py and compose.py: add calibration comments for every tuned size (font, padding, radius) referencing design spec vs headless Chrome output. Enforce in preflight.py layout audit.

title: Deterministic typing via pre-baked frame swap
text: Message-thread-reveal pre-generates every typed frame (mtr-ty-1-0 … mtr-ty-5-24) as hidden spans; timeline swaps visibility at exact frames. Zero runtime calculation, fully deterministic, matches TTS pacing exactly.
how: In plan.py, for each outgoing message, generate the full typed-frame sequence (character-by-character) and emit as static HTML; compose_lab.py places them in a typed-wrap container; timeline toggles visibility.

title: Layout audit attributes for overflow/overlap/occlusion
text: Elements carry `data-layout-allow-overflow`, `data-layout-allow-overlap`, `data-layout-allow-occlusion` to declare intentional layout violations. Preflight can flag unexpected ones.
how: Add these attributes to our HyperFrames elements in compose.py/compose_lab.py; extend preflight.py to parse and report violations not explicitly allowed.

title: Fractional-second GSAP timestamps imply beat-grid authoring
text: Message-thread-reveal uses timestamps like 0.7662, 2.9662, 3.6995, 7.2995, 8.0328, 10.5995 — consistent with a 120 BPM grid (0.5s/beat) plus micro-offsets. Enables beat-synced animation without audio analysis.
how: In plan.py, quantize scene transitions to 0.5s grid; in compose_lab.py, author GSAP timelines with fractional offsets (e.g., 0.7662 = beat 1 + 0.2662s). Document grid in playbook.md.

title: Message-thread chat story template
text: A complete iMessage-style conversation: bubbles with tails, typing indicators, link card, emoji row, delivered receipts, auto-scrolling thread, and end card. 25 content variables with `portrays` semantic tags (subject_name, subject_domain, subject_logo, authority_badge) for brand asset injection.
how: Install message-thread-reveal block; create a Kaise Tech playbook variant where the script planner outputs the 25 variables; use `portrays` to auto-fill brand assets from brain.jsonl.

title: Minimal line graph with draw-on, dot pop, riding value labels
text: SVG path stroke-dashoffset draw (1.3s), dots scale from 0 with back.out(1.2) at each data point, value labels animate opacity+y 0.35s after dot. Second series labels offset downward to avoid collisions. Dim axis (rgba 0.22), x-labels, color-dot legend.
how: Add mk-line-graph block; in research.py when data series detected, emit CONFIG.series + xLabels; compose_lab.py renders block on a track above background.

title: Text clone wall transition with difference-blend inversion
text: Tiled word wall (brick-offset rows) covers frame; a paper-colored rect sweeps x in difference blend mode, inverting ink↔paper; outgoing frame shrinks to rounded card (640×420) then scales to 0.6× fade. Wall holds 0.6–1.9s local — hard-cut content beneath during that window.
how: Install mk-clone-wall-transition; in plan.py insert at section boundaries with data-start = cut - 0.9s; set CONFIG.word to episode keyword; disable card.src for gradient fallback.

title: Procedural soft-blob gradient background with animatable card mask
text: Two radial gradients (circle closest-side, 72% falloff) drift slowly (sine.inOut yoyo). A full-bleed rounded-rect card (border-radius 0→40px) masks the blobs; supports dark/light schemes via CSS custom properties; optional frosted-glass backdrop-filter.
how: Install mk-background; use as base layer for lab-look shorts; drive CONFIG.scheme from page brand (Kaise Tech=dark, Puraan Ki Katha=light); animate bar mask for section transitions.

title: Map Target Callout with Dual Scribbles and Threat Wash
text: For animated map hooks, animate camera zoom using expo.inOut into a back.out(1.5) settle. At peak zoom, reveal the target using two overlapping SVG bezier paths (stroke widths 12px and 6px) animated sequentially via strokeDashoffset (0.62s and 0.44s), followed immediately by a tooltip pop-in (back.out(2.1)) and a multiply-blended radial color wash with scanlines.
how: Add map_callout template in compose_lab.py and compose.py. Use static map captures from Wikimedia/OSM, then apply SVG scribble paths and GSAP camera push for Kaise Tech geopolitical/tech supply chain shorts.

title: Stacked Push-Up Notification Cascade
text: Display sequential social alerts or log events by dropping banners at a consistent interval (e.g. 2.0s) with a 22px rise and expo.out settle. On each new banner entry, tween all preceding banners upward by -PITCH (e.g. -214px) simultaneously in lockstep, ending with a collective parent container exit (y: -560px, alpha fade).
how: Apply in compose_lab.py for tech feature announcements, AI benchmark lists, or milestone updates to simulate a live phone lock-screen cascade.

title: Layout-Offset Integer Font Fitting
text: When dynamically fitting variable text to container boundaries, decrement font-size by integer pixels until element offsetWidth fits within maxWidth (down to a floor of ~45% base size). Measuring via offsetWidth/offsetLeft rather than getBoundingClientRect() prevents rotated or transformed parent containers (like tilted cards) from exaggerating bounding boxes and incorrectly truncating text.
how: Add a client-side fitWidth helper in compose_lab.py for UI cards and kinetic titles to prevent Gemini-generated Hinglish/English text overruns without being skewed by CSS rotations.

title: Runtime Split-Span Decoration Anchoring
text: To anchor hand-drawn underlines or circled callouts around dynamic text, split the injected string into runtime head/tail span elements. Compute SVG stroke geometry dynamically: underline left equals parent offsetLeft plus tail offsetLeft minus lead em-ratio, while circled ellipses derive width and height directly from head span offset metrics.
how: Use in compose_lab.py kinetic titles and highlight cards so AI-generated keywords automatically get perfectly aligned emphasis circles and marker underlines regardless of word length.

title: Beam-Velocity Phosphor Trace Simulation
text: Simulate authentic CRT oscilloscope waveforms deterministically without feedback buffers. Trace backwards from current time t across a window of 3*tau (phosphor time constant). Apply two physical rules per sub-step: exponential decay exp(-age/tau) and beam-velocity brightness scaling vel = min(1, lRef / len), ensuring horizontal/slow segments glow brightly while fast vertical edges dim naturally. Drive repaints through a GSAP Object.defineProperty setter to guarantee deterministic updates during suppressed-event seeks.
how: Add to compose_lab.py to generate live audio waveforms, telemetry graphs, and AI latency traces in Kaise Tech explainers, binding trace frequency to VO loudness or synthesized audio stems.

title: Accelerating Notification Pacing with Dramatic Comma
text: To visualize escalating overwhelm or demand in hook sequences, shrink incoming message intervals geometrically (e.g., 2.6s → 0.85s → 0.74s → 0.64s down to 0.27s). Immediately follow the fastest flurry with an intentional 0.5s pause ('dramatic comma') before dropping the payoff/solution card on the viewer.
how: In plan.py and compose_lab.py, use this cadence when scripting and animating notification barrage hooks for tech/AI explainers to spike viewer retention before presenting the core tool.

title: Diegetic Clock Progression for Mounting Urgency
text: In mobile lockscreen or desktop UI simulations, advance the UI status bar clock in stepped hard cuts (e.g., 9:41 → 9:42 → 9:45 → 9:51) precisely aligned with incoming message waves. This visual cue conveys mounting passage of time and frantic urgency without dedicating voiceover words to time exposition.
how: In compose_lab.py mock-UI scenes, swap digital clock digits across key notification milestones to heighten narrative tension without bloating VO duration.

title: Top-Anchored Peek-Squash Stack Animation
text: For iOS-style card/notification stacks anchored at a fixed top, animate background cards by squashing Y and tapering X rather than repositioning tops: sy = (H_front + PEEK * d) / H_card, sx = max(0.001, 1 - DEPTH_SCALE * d), where d = front_idx - card_idx and PEEK = 8px. Cards where d > 2 fade to alpha 0.
how: Add stateAt(i, k) helper in compose_lab.py to animate multi-card stacks in Hinglish tech comparisons and chat threads without layout thrashing.

title: Radial Center-Clearance Mask for Ambient Overlays
text: When layering continuous ambient particles (dust, embers, snow, stars) over video or titles, apply a radial gradient mask (`mask-image: radial-gradient(circle 230px at 50% 50%, transparent 0 230px, #000 653px)`). Particles drift naturally across periphery and corners but smoothly fade to zero opacity in the frame center, guaranteeing captions and hero props remain legible without thinning edge particle density.
how: In `compose_lab.py` and `compose.py`, add `-webkit-mask-image` radial falloff to ambient overlay container divs behind title cards and subtitles.

title: Value-Sorted Choropleth Stagger with Outlier Pulse
text: When animating choropleth maps, sort SVG region paths by primary metric value before applying GSAP entrance stagger (`stagger: { each: 0.08, from: 'center' }`). After regions colorize, sequentially spotlight the top 2-3 outlier regions using a transient filter flare (`brightness(1.5)`, drop-shadow glow, and white stroke expansion for 0.5s) to direct viewer focus to critical data points.
how: In `compose_lab.py` map templates, sort region features by metric value prior to timeline binding and append the 3-step outlier pulse cue.

title: Split-Flap Cascade with Quadratic Fall Physics
text: Solari mechanical board text reveal: cells advance unidirectionally through a 40-character alphabet drum rather than cross-fading. The falling flap rotates with constant angular acceleration $\theta(p) = 180 \cdot p^2$, hanging momentarily at top before slapping down. Two half-faces swap visibility at $\theta = 90^\circ$ ($p = 0.707$). Inactive leaves must be cleared completely (styles wiped) to avoid stale seek-capture artifacts.
how: Add a `split_flap_board` helper to `compose_lab.py` to animate numbers, launch dates, and tech spec reveals in Kaise Tech explainers.

title: Overexposure Flash-Burn Scene Transition
text: Transition between high-contrast scenes using coupled brightness ramping and white flash. Outgoing scene scales to 1.03 with filter: brightness(1.5) over 0.2s, then scales to 1.06 with brightness(3) over 0.2s while an absolute white overlay ramps opacity from 0 to 0.5 then to 1.0. At 0.4s peak, swap scene elements, reset filters, and fade white overlay out over 0.35s.
how: Add as a transition preset in compose.py and compose_lab.py. Use on explosive reveal hooks or narrative turning points in mythology (Puraan Ki Katha) and tech explainers.

title: Proportional Bubble Map with Leader-Line Callouts
text: D3 geoAlbersUsa projection + TopoJSON states; 20 cities as circles with sqrt-scaled radius (6–45px) by population; top 5 get callout groups (leader line + name + value) with left/right offset logic; pulse ring on largest bubble; connections as quadratic bezier curves from NYC to 4 targets.
how: Create new map block in registry/blocks/india-bubble-map/ for Hinglish data shorts (state populations, city metrics); swap us-atlas for india topojson; reuse radiusScale, callout positioning, pulse animation; 12s duration fits Shorts.

title: Center-outward stagger by distance-from-centroid
text: Compute each element's center, calculate average centroid, measure Euclidean distance, sort indices by distance ascending. Apply GSAP stagger on sorted array. Creates organic ripple from center vs. arbitrary index order.
how: In compose_lab.py and compose.py, replace index-based stagger with distance-sorted stagger for any grid/cluster reveals (stat counters, card grids, map tiles). Add helper sort_by_distance(elements, center_point).

title: Closed-form analytic convolution replaces 80-tap shader loop
text: Anamorphic streak filter: tent-weighted horizontal blur (80 taps, quarter-res) has exact analytic result — a linear gradient centered on source. Implement as single gradient fill per emitter instead of fragment shader loop. Matches reference look at fraction of cost; works in headless Canvas 2D.
how: In any canvas VFX block (compose_lab.py effects), replace multi-pass blur loops with gradient primitives. For horizontal streaks: createLinearGradient(x-len,0,x+len,0) with stops at 0, 0.5, 1. Alpha carries intensity; hue stays full precision.

title: Quarter-resolution buffer + bilinear upscale for soft glows
text: Draw streak/glow primitives at 0.25× resolution (480×270 for 1080p), then ctx.drawImage with imageSmoothingQuality='high' to full frame. Gives natural vertical falloff without extra blur passes. Cost: 1/16 pixels.
how: In compose_lab.py glow/streak effects: create offscreen canvas at W*0.25, H*0.25; draw primitives; upscale with high-quality bilinear. Add config RES_SCALE=0.25. Applies to lens flares, neon glows, particle trails.

title: Gain swell envelope for organic intensity over clip
text: gain(t) = 0.75 + 0.35*sin(π*t/duration). Starts at 0.75, peaks at 1.1 at mid-point, returns to 0.75. Prevents mechanical constant-intensity feel. Multiply into per-emitter alpha each frame.
how: Add utils/easing.py: function gain_swell(t, dur, base=0.75, amp=0.35). Apply in compose_lab.py to any time-varying effect intensity (particle brightness, line width, glow radius). Parameterize per block.

title: Auto light/dark label text by background luminance
text: For each data value, compute normalized t = (val-min)/(max-min). If t < 0.35 use light text (#fef3c7), else dark (#0f172a). Works with any sequential color scale. No extra CSS classes needed at render time.
how: Add utils/label_contrast.py: function pick_label_color(value, min_val, max_val, light_hex, dark_hex, threshold=0.35). Use in compose_lab.py for stat counters, chart labels, map tiles, HUD readouts.

title: SVG-foreignObject fallback for HTML→texture capture
text: When drawElementImage unavailable: clone panel, wrap in SVG foreignObject, serialize to SVG data URL, draw to Image, then to canvas. Works in headless Chrome without special flags. Used in liquid-background for panel textures.
how: Add rasterizePanelFallback(panelEl, W, H) in compose_vfx.py. Use as fallback when gl.texElementImage2D fails. Ensures VFX blocks render in CI/Cloudflare Workers without canvas-draw-element flag.

title: Multi-wave vertex displacement with matching UV distortion
text: Vertex shader: three sine waves (large slow horizontal, medium diagonal, small fast ripples) summed for Z displacement. Fragment shader: matching UV distortion (sin/cos on UV + time) so texture stretches consistently with geometry. Add specular highlight from displacement magnitude and vignette.
how: Port the vertex/fragment shader pair from vfx-liquid-background into a reusable HyperFrames block (liquid-bg.html). Drive uWaveIntensity, uRippleIntensity, uMix via GSAP timeline. Use for Kaise Tech section transitions or Puraan Ki Katha dream sequences.

title: Procedural environment map + ACES tone-mapping for PBR
text: Generate 1024×512 equirectangular env map in 2D canvas: linear gradient with color stops + screen-blend scanlines. Feed to PMREMGenerator for prefiltered envMap. Renderer: ACESFilmicToneMapping, exposure 1.08, sRGBEncoding. Gives realistic reflections on glass/metal without HDRI files.
how: Add env-map utility in compose_vfx.py. Use for any Three.js block with MeshPhysicalMaterial (glass, metal, liquid). Zero external assets, fully deterministic.

title: Post-process composer: UnrealBloom + seeded grain shader
text: EffectComposer chain: RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass (strength 0.32, radius 0.4, threshold 0.86) → custom GrainShader (time-varying noise, strength 0.024, gamma crush 0.985). Grain uses seeded noise (fract(sin(dot(v+time,vec2))) * 43758.5453).
how: Wrap composer setup in a reusable function in compose_vfx.py. Apply to all Three.js blocks for consistent filmic look. Grain time uniform driven by GSAP timeline for determinism.

title: Chromatic aberration edge highlights (cyan/pink offset)
text: For glass/metal edges: create three LineSegments from EdgesGeometry. White (opacity 0.3–0.44), cyan (0x72e8ff, opacity 0.18, offset +0.008/-0.002/-0.008), pink (0xff6f8d, opacity 0.14, offset -0.009/+0.003/+0.006). Animate opacity with shatter/reveal intensity.
how: Add edge-highlight helper in compose_vfx.py. Apply to any ExtrudeGeometry props (cards, tokens, UI panels) in lab look for premium feel.

title: Gaussian warp + chromatic aberration shader on live HTML
text: Fragment shader: sample texture at displaced UV (Gaussian falloff exp(-dist²*20)*0.04*strength). Split RGB channels: R at displaced+aberDir*0.3, G at displaced, B at displaced-aberDir*0.3. Toggle attract/repel via direction sign. Texture uploaded via texElementImage2D each frame.
how: Create magnetic-distortion.html block for hook transitions: warp a stat card or headline toward/away from simulated cursor. Drive strength/repel via GSAP. Use texElementImage2D (requires Chrome flag) with 2D canvas fallback.

title: Deterministic physics via reset-and-simulate pattern
text: Shatter block achieves deterministic physics by resetting each shard to initial state and simulating forward with fixed `dt=1/30` steps up to current time on every frame. Uses seeded PRNG for initial velocities. Guarantees identical renders across runs.
how: Apply in compose_lab.py for any physics-driven animation (falling counters, particle bursts): store initial conditions, on each frame re-simulate from t=0 with fixed step. Add to doctor.py as reproducibility check.

title: Graceful degradation overlay for experimental APIs
text: All experimental blocks include an `#error-overlay` div that becomes visible if `canvas-draw-element` or WebGPU is unsupported, showing exact `chrome://flags` command. Prevents silent black frames in preview.
how: Add to preflight.py: before rendering any composition using experimental blocks, run feature detection in headless browser; if missing, inject error overlay frame and flag in review.py. Document required flags in playbook.md.

title: Portal transition block
text: 10-second shader transition between two HTML panels (light/dark mode) with expanding portal, chromatic aberration, radial distortion, glow ring, energy sparks, and camera push-through. Requires `canvas-draw-element` flag. Install via `npx hyperframes add vfx-portal`.
how:
Use for major scene changes in Kaise Tech: install block, place two panel HTML inside (e.g., before/after UI), then add `
` at transition point.

title: Text cursor dramatic reveal block
text: 8-second hook: logo ray-marches from bottom with chromatic shadow rays, then "HTML" types letter-by-letter with cursor glow, slides to center, supporting words cascade in, then "Now available in HyperFrames" slides in. WebGL shader with spectral color edges. Install via `npx hyperframes add vfx-text-cursor`.
how: Use as Kaise Tech cold open: install, customize `htmlText` variable and logo SVG, place at `data-start="0"`. Falls back to 2D canvas animation if WebGL unavailable.

title: Data-driven bounce speed mapping
text: Map a numeric data value (e.g., merges, views, revenue) to horizontal speed in px/s (floor 10, leader 300). Use closed-form bounceX(distance, span) = triangle wave so position is a pure function of time; works with GSAP seek and requires no per-frame state.
how: In compose_lab.py add a data-driven motion block: parse JSON rows, compute speed = lerp(FLOOR, LEADER, value/max), render(t) sets transform: translateX(bounceX(speed*t, laneWidth)). Use GSAP driver object with setter calling render(t) for frame-perfect seeks.

title: Phone UI mockup animation pattern
text: Scroll list → highlight target row (scale 1.035 + blue outline) → tap dot ripple (scale 0.25→2.15, fade) → button press (scale 0.82→1) → detail view rises (y 620→0, scale 0.92→1) → install ring stroke-dashoffset 69→0 + big progress arc 440→0 with percent text updates (18/52/87/100%) → button turns green, shows OPEN → checkmark pops → phone exits with speed lines + snap shadow grow/shrink → white wipe.
how: Adapt in compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech app demos. Build reusable 'app-install' scene: store-view scroll, detail-view with progress ring, shield status. Use GSAP timeline with labeled sections for easy timing tweaks. Pair with SFX track.

title: Fit text at heaviest weight to prevent overflow
text: Measure text width at maximum weight (wght 1000) using canvas measureText. Decrement font size from base (132px) until width ≤ max line width (1760px). Clamp minimum (40px). Ensures crest widening never causes reflow or clipping.
how: Apply in thumb.py for thumbnail titles and compose_lab.py for kinetic titles. Compute once per composition at startup. Store fitted fontSize in composition variables.

title: Responsive font sizing from container height
text: After layout, measure row height. Set avatar = clamp(36, 96, rowH*0.62), name font = clamp(18, 36, rowH*0.26), count font = clamp(13, 16, nameFont*0.48). Initials font = avatar*0.4. All via CSS variable --wim-avatar and inline styles.
how: Use in our data-driven blocks (leaderboards, stat grids) in compose_lab.py. Compute after DOM mount, before animation starts. Ensures consistent visual hierarchy across 1920×1080 and 1080×1350.

title: Variable-font weight/slant wave
text: Animate a traveling crest across a headline: each character's wght and slnt axes interpolate from rest (400, 0°) to peak (1000, -12°) based on distance to crest. Bundle a subset font (Recursive wght+slnt) with MONO/CASL/CRSV pinned. Fit font size at heaviest weight to prevent overflow.
how: Add variable-font asset pipeline (woff2 subset). Create kinetic-title block in compose_lab.py: split text into spans, GSAP timeline drives crest position, onUpdate sets font-variation-settings per span. Use for Hinglish/English hook lines in Kaise Tech and Aage Suno.

title: Font-loading probe via ink rasterization
text: After document.fonts.ready, draw test string 'HAMBURGEFONSTIV' at min/max weight (300/1000) to offscreen canvas. Count non-transparent pixels; variable font must show >1.2× ink at max vs min. Also check document.fonts.check(). Fail loud if static font substituted.
how: Add to preflight.py as a font gate before render. Probe each @font-face used in composition. Log ink ratios and fontLoaded status to brain.jsonl. Prevents silent weight-wave failures in lab look titles.

title: Swap-concentrated easing function
text: phraseEase(progress) = a/(a+b) where a = (progress*0.38)^easing, b = ((1-progress)*0.62)^easing. Concentrates velocity at 62% of progress (the letter swap moment), with slow preparation and soft settle. Easing parameter 1–8 controls snap. Used for phrase transition but applicable to any binary swap (color, position, scale).
how: Add to our easing library (pace.py or motion utils). Use in plan.py for hook transitions: e.g., problem→solution text swap, before/after metric flip, map zoom transitions. Replace generic power2.inOut with this for snappier, more deliberate swaps.

title: World choropleth with stagger reveal
text: D3 Natural Earth projection + TopoJSON countries, colored by GDP per capita (green→teal→cyan→white). Countries fade in with 0.02s stagger from center. Top-5 countries pulse (brightness + white stroke) sequentially. Tooltip on hover (for preflight), legend, source citation. 14s duration.
how: Create a `world-choropleth` block in compose_lab.py for data-driven shorts (e.g., AI adoption by country). Feed CSV/JSON from research.py into variables. Use GSAP stagger from center for reveal. Pulse top-N via timeline. Render via HyperFrames; preflight.py can snapshot tooltip frames for QC.

title: Camera push-through transition with exit FX
text: At t=6s, camera pushes through letterforms (push: 0→1 over 1.6s, power2.in). Simultaneously exitFx ramps (zoom blur 3.2×, brightness 1.6×, contrast 1.25). A white plate fades in over 0.95s, becoming fully opaque for the final hold. Letters fly past camera (Z offset up to 38 units) with reading-order stagger. No backward travel or opacity dissolve — pure perspective fly-through.
how: Implement as a reusable `portal-exit` transition block in compose_lab.py. Use between major sections in Kaise Tech (e.g., problem → deep dive). Drive from timeline labels. Requires 3D letter meshes with depth; fallback to 2D scale+blur for non-3D titles.

title: Perspective bow (CRT curvature) via CSS transform
text: Subtle CRT monitor bow: container gets perspective(950px) rotateX(6-7deg). Applied to text wrapper (#yt-pt-bow, #yt-lcd-bow) so entire line curves. Works on transparent root — no 3D context needed. Deg parameter configurable (6-7°).
how: Add bow.enabled/bow.deg to our title block config. In compose_lab.py, enable for all lab-look titles (Kaise Tech). Disable for classic look (Puraan Ki Katha). Single CSS line, zero JS cost.

title: Chromatic fringe title with blur-focus entrance
text: Title renders three layers (red fringe, blue fringe, main fill) on a transparent root. Entrance: 0–18px blur focus-in over 0.84s while fringe copies settle from 4× offset to resting 4px over 1.44s (power2.out). Ambient: slow 3.5% scale breath + ±1.4px fringe wobble (sine.inOut, yoyo, repeat=1). Perspective bow via perspective(950px) rotateX(6deg).
how: Add to compose_lab.py as a new title block: generate HTML with three layered divs, drive GSAP timeline from plan.py scene timings. Use --yt-prism-r/--yt-prism-b tokens for brand-consistent fringe colors. Replace current kinetic title underline with this for lab intros.

title: Agent cursor component for AI-agent demos
text: Cursor arrow with accent name tag that types status steps (comma-separated), moves to percentage targets (semicolon-separated x,y), clicks with expanding ring, ends with checkmark. Tag slides left/right of tip based on target position (averaged over 0.3s for seek-safe flip). Envelope: enter 0.55s, read 0.4s, per target 1.35s (type 0.35s, move 0.5s, dwell 0.2s, click 0.28s), done 0.4s, exit 0.5s. All durations scale with composition length.
how: Install as compositions/components/agent-cursor.html. In plan.py, emit a scene with data-variable-values for agent_name, steps, targets, accent. Perfect for Kaise Tech 'AI agent does X' shorts — shows cursor navigating UI while VO explains.

title: ASCII render pass with coarse-to-fine resolve
text: Rasterizes a slotted scene (via SVG foreignObject snapshot) to luminance grid once at mount, then draws glyphs from density ramp charset (default ' .:-=+*#%@') on canvas. Resolution ladder: 5 steps (4×, 2.83×, 2×, 1.41×, 1× final) over 1.2s smoothstep, per-cell hash shimmer decays to zero on final step. Holds legible-fine until cut. Exit options: none/fade/up. Deterministic: no Math.random, stateless hash per cell/step.
how: Add as compositions/components/ascii-render-pass.html. In compose_lab.py, wrap terminal/code scenes with <template data-slot="ascii-render-pass-scene">. Set grid=med, resolve_at=1.4, accent=green for brand. Use for 'under the hood' tech explainers showing code executing as ASCII.

title: Vertical media filler for 9:16→16:9 with three fill modes
text: Handles portrait images in widescreen: mode=scale (big blurred bg + sharp fg), mirror (flanked mirrored copies blurred), copy (flanked straight copies blurred). FG gets contrast 1.06, brightness 1.03, saturate 1.08 lift. Optional 28px grid overlay. Ken Burns: fg scales 1.05→1 over duration. Images only inside block (runtime never seeks media in sub-compositions); for live footage keep media in host root over fg slot (left:656px, width:608px).
how: Install yt-vertical-fill.html. In compose.py/compose_lab.py, use for Shorts sourced from vertical Muse/FLUX generations. Set mode=mirror for aesthetic fill, mode=scale for documentary feel. Feed representative still to block, keep live footage in host.

title: Animated bar chart component with CSS-variable growth
text: Compact card: 7 bars driven by --hf-grow (0→1) and --hf-dash (900→0) custom properties. GSAP: tl.fromTo('.bar', {'--hf-grow':0,'--hf-dash':900}, {'--hf-grow':1,'--hf-dash':0, duration:1.2, ease:'power3.out'}). Bars use --hf-l1..l4 ink tokens for theming. Deterministic, seek-safe, no JS math in paint path.
how: Add animated-bar-chart.html as component. In plan.py, when script has data comparisons, emit a scene with this component and drive --hf-grow/--hf-dash from scene timeline. Use for Kaise Tech benchmark shorts (e.g., 'Model A vs B on 7 tasks').

title: Arc motion path primitive with GSAP MotionPathPlugin
text: Two SVG paths (cubic Bezier) with autoRotate chips that follow curve. Integration: gsap.registerPlugin(MotionPathPlugin); tl.to('.chip', {motionPath:{path:'#id', align:'#id', alignOrigin:[0.5,0.5], autoRotate:true}, duration:2.4, ease:'power1.inOut'}). Seek-safe, deterministic, works as sub-composition.
how: Install arc-motion-path.html. In compose_lab.py, use for 'data flowing through pipeline' visuals: chip = data packet, arc = processing stages. Replace straight-line ribbon flows with curved arcs for more organic lab feel.

title: Logo intro with kicker swap and accent arrow chip
text: 6s sequence: logo pops (back.out(1.5) from scale 0.55, y:24). Kicker text (LET'S DIVE IN) appears at 40px, 0.22em tracking, then swaps to title (74px, -0.015em) at 2.62s with power3.out. Accent arrow chip (red bg, white SVG) springs in (back.out(1.6)) at 2.9s. Background lines with seeded distortion (see item 8). Hard kill at DUR-0.02s.
how: Install yt-logo-intro.html. Use as channel-branded intro for Kaise Tech series episodes. Configure logoText/logoSrc, kicker, title per episode via CONFIG. Replaces generic 'Kaise Tech' slate with dynamic branded open.

title: Deterministic beat-sting primitive with sync event
text: beat-accent fires a single impact flash, scale pulse, and shake at a declared sync point (IMPACT_AT = 0.25s into IN) and dispatches a bubbling hf:sfx CustomEvent {id: 'impact-hard', t: IMPACT_AT} for audio routing. All motion scales with envelope compression; intensity (0.5–2) drives flash opacity, scale peak, and shake distance as one knob.
how: Add to compose_lab.py as a reusable 'sting' layer; in mix.py, listen for hf:sfx events to trigger corresponding SFX stems. Use for beat-synced visual punctuation on music hits in Kaise Tech shorts.

title: Authored S-curve ASCII grid reveal
text: ascii-trail-reveal sweeps a luminous actor along a cubic Bézier S-curve (4 control points) across a 24×14 deterministic ASCII grid. Cells flip away (rotationY 88°, scaleX 0.3) in column-progress order with distance-from-path lag and index jitter (index*37%11*0.009s). Trail width (narrow/wide) adjusts lag multiplier. No randomness—glyphs, timing, order all from row/col/index math.
how: Install via npx hyperframes add ascii-trail-reveal; use in compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech intros: set label to episode topic, accent to brand green, trail_width narrow. Duration 4s default; IN_BASE 3.2s, OUT_BASE 0s.

title: Deterministic avatar cloud with SVG link drawing
text: avatar-cloud places 6–16 lettermark avatars on an elliptical orbit (radiusX 356±24, radiusY 194±18) with index-derived sine jitter. Center hub shows proof label (default '50k builders'). SVG lines draw from hub to each avatar (stagger 0.025s) plus every 3rd avatar-to-avatar link. Avatars drift on sine.inOut during HOLD (amplitude ±0.85cqw/±1.15cqh). Envelope: IN_BASE 2.2s, OUT_BASE 0.5s, sync point at 2.15s (network-formed).
how: Install avatar-cloud; use in Kaise Tech for community/social-proof scenes (GitHub stars, Discord members). Set avatarCount from data, label from script. Mount as mid-ground layer; links use currentColor with 22%/14% opacity for depth.

title: Surface-aware notification badge micro-interaction
text: badge-pop renders a bell button (76px, 22px radius) with a count badge (30px min, 999px radius) that scales from 0 with back.out(2.4), then pulses 1.18× (power1.inOut, yoyo repeat 1). Accent token (red/blue/green/violet) rides composition tokens (--accent, --brand, --accent-2) with ink fallback. Surface light/dark swaps button chrome via CSS vars. Count max 4 chars.
how: Install badge-pop; use in tech demos for 'new feature', 'update available', '3 bugs fixed' callouts. In compose_lab.py, trigger via timeline at script cue: button fade-in 0.35s, badge pop 0.7s, pulse 1.15s. Set surface per scene background (lab=dark).

title: Elastic Hold Pacing
text: A pacing logic where IN and OUT durations are fixed/compressed, while the HOLD phase is elastic. This ensures that visual comparisons or complex UI states remain perfectly still and readable for the majority of the scene duration.
how: Apply this to research.py notes and plan.py. Ensure Gemini-planned scenes with high information density (like charts or code) use this 'fixed-ends, elastic-middle' timing logic.

title: Slot-Based Before/After Wipe
text: A comparison component with two full-bleed content slots and a persistent divider. It features a configurable resting split percentage and a 'wipe-land-soft' SFX trigger. Supports images, video, or HTML templates as slot content.
how: Integrate into compose_lab.py. We can use this to compare 'Old Tech vs New Tech' or 'AI vs Human' by passing two Muse-generated images into the before/after slots.

title: Token-Native Device Chrome
text: A 'Browser Device Stage' that draws browser, window, or phone frames using theme tokens (no external assets). Includes an address pill, title bar, and a screen slot that supports a timed 'fade-through' swap to a second screen.
how: Build as a reusable block in compose_lab.py. This replaces our basic UI panels with professional-looking browser/phone mockups for showing app features or website screenshots.

title: Per-Pixel Auto-Inverting Captions
text: Using `mix-blend-mode: difference` on white text to create auto-inverting captions that flip to black on light backgrounds and stay white on dark ones. Requires `isolation: isolate` on the parent container to prevent blending with the browser background instead of the video footage.
how: Update the caption CSS in `compose.py`. Add `isolation: isolate` to the root composition div and apply the `difference` blend mode to caption spans to ensure legibility over busy or high-contrast footage.

title: Editorial Emphasis Typography Pair
text: A dual-font system for storytelling (e.g., Puraan Ki Katha) using a Sans-serif (Inter) for normal flow and a large, high-contrast Serif (Playfair Display) for emphasis words. Emphasis words are scaled significantly larger (e.g., 180px vs 86px) to create a dramatic editorial look.
how: Update the script for Puraan Ki Katha to tag 'emphasis' words in the Gemini prompt. Our `compose.py` can then apply the Serif font and larger scale to these tagged tokens.

title: Procedural Camera Shake with Overscan Solver
text: A deterministic camera shake system using 9 measured profiles (handheld, telephoto, rig buzz). It uses a closed-form function of time (no random/accumulators) and includes an overscan solver that calculates the minimum scale needed to prevent frame-tearing based on peak translation, roll, and keystone distortion.
how: Add to `compose.py` and `compose_lab.py`. Implement the `cameraShake` helper to wrap the main content 'rig'. Use the overscan logic to automatically set the `scale` of the container based on the selected intensity.

title: Causal Camera Scan Gate
text: A UI primitive for a 'scan -> lock -> confirm' sequence. Features a viewfinder sweep, four L-shaped corner brackets that tighten on a target (lock-at 0.68s), and a confirmation pulse with a label. Dispatches a custom `hf:sfx` event for the lock chime.
how: Integrate into `compose_lab.py` as a transition or a 'verification' scene for Kaise Tech videos. Use it when explaining security, QR codes, or AI recognition beats.

title: Group timing from pause thresholds, not fixed counts
text: Groups split on punctuation, pause ≥0.1s, or max 3–4 words; group start leads first word by min(entryDur, gapToPrev). Eliminates hard-coded group boundaries, adapts to speech tempo.
how: Replace fixed 3-word grouping in plan.py/caption builder with makeGroups(words) logic using PAUSE_THRESHOLD=0.1 and MAX_WORDS_PER_GROUP=3; test on existing Hinglish transcripts.

title: Keyword-triggered emoji insertion
text: Map a small keyword set (e.g., "AI", "code", "India", "myth") to specific emojis; inject the first matching emoji per caption group above the text line, sized 56px, centered horizontally.
how: In compose_lab.py caption builder, add WORD_EMOJI dict and emoji span creation before line assembly; reuse existing group timing.

title: Per-word gradient fill animation
text: Clip a multi-stop gradient (e.g., Siri spectrum) to each word via background-clip:text; animate background-position from 100%→0% over the word's spoken duration, with a 1.04× scale pop at word start.
how: Add gradient-fill variant to compose_lab.py: compute per-word font size, set CSS background/background-size, drive GSAP timeline from Whisper timestamps.

title: Parallax depth layers (behind/front)
text: Two caption layers: behind layer — large red stroked serif (220px) vertically stretched scaleY(2.8) at top; front layer — normal/italic white serif (130px) at bottom. Blocks switch together per phrase.
how: New compose_parallax.py using Instrument Serif; behind-stage at top:40px, front-stage at top:700px; block timing from transcript phrases; adds cinematic depth for mythology pages.

title: Weight-Shift Narrative Emphasis
text: An elegant transition where two lines of text swap font weights (300 to 700) as the VO moves from the first line to the second. Creates a sophisticated 'focus' shift without moving the camera.
how: Apply in plan.py for 'Aage Suno' stories. When a scene has two distinct sub-points, the second prompt can flag the weight-shift timing for the renderer.

title: Pill-Container Karaoke Captions
text: Groups words (max 4) into a pill-shaped container with a light background. Active words transition from a muted color to dark charcoal. Includes logic to split lines and fit font size within the pill's safe zone.
how: Integrate into compose.py as a new caption style. Use the provided measureLineWidth and splitLines logic to ensure text never overflows the pill container.

title: Texture-Masked Typography
text: Applies a flowing texture mask (lava, metal, wood) to large uppercase text using -webkit-mask-image and mask-mode: luminance. Animates the mask-position to create a 'living' texture effect inside the glyphs.
how: Create a new component in compose_lab.py. Use Cloudflare FLUX to generate the 6 base textures (metal, lava, etc.) and apply the CSS mask-position animation for high-impact titles.

title: Card Expansion Primitive
text: A layout transition where a compact card (330x132) expands into a detail panel (560x210) using CSS variables for width/height. Includes internal element fades and y-axis shifts for a 'layered' reveal.
how: Add to compose_lab.py as a 'UI Detail' block. Useful for tech explainers when moving from a high-level concept to a specific data point.

title: Caret-Swap Text Replacement
text: A gradient caret expands to cover a phrase, collapses to the left, and then 'types' a replacement phrase. Uses grapheme segmentation for accurate multi-language typing speeds and a blinking terminal cursor.
how: Implement as a 'Correction' or 'Evolution' block in Kaise Tech. Perfect for showing 'Old Way vs AI Way' in tech explainers.

title: Char Slam Reassembly
text: Headline glyphs start in a deterministic scattered state (random rotation/offset) and slam together into a composed word with a 3-frame landing shake. Uses a fixed LCG table for reproducibility.
how: Use as a high-impact hook in research.py. The first 2 seconds of tech videos can use this 'Slam' effect for the main title to grab attention.

title: Chart Story Primitive
text: A multi-mode chart component (bars, line, donut, progress) that builds in reading order. Features staggered growth, area-fill line drawing, and a 'pop-and-settle' accented value callout on a specific datum. Uses authored frame sets for number rolling to ensure deterministic renders during seeks.
how: Implement in `compose_lab.py` as a new data-viz block. Use the logic from `chart-story.html` to handle the `emphasize` index and the `unit` suffix for tech benchmark shorts.

title: Prefix-Driven Chat Thread Scene
text: A full-fidelity conversation scene with status bars, avatars, and iMessage-style tails. Supports message types via string prefixes (recv:, sent:, emoji:, img:, card:). Crucially, it measures element heights at mount to generate precise scroll choreography so any length of thread fits the viewport.
how: Update our chat story template to use this prefix logic. Add the mount-time measurement script to our chat render logic to handle varying text lengths without manual keyframing.

title: Typed-prompt law: build chars-at-time table once
text: Pre-compute a complete rows[] array mapping time → character count during synchronous construction. The timeline only reads this table (via charsAt(time)) on every frame, guaranteeing identical rendering in forward/reverse seeks and eliminating per-frame text measurement.
how: In compose_lab.py terminal scenes, replace per-frame typing logic with a pre-built rows table. Use the same LCG seed for human cadence chunks (1–3 chars) and gaps. Store table in scene metadata for doctor.py replay.

title: Proportional schedule compression, never timeScale
text: If natural end (typing + execute + outputs + tail) exceeds maxEnd (duration – OUT – stillness), squeeze the entire post-TYPE_START schedule by a single factor. Extra duration becomes HOLD (solid caret, subtle drift). IN/OUT scale together only when duration < IN_BASE+OUT_BASE.
how: In plan.py and compose_lab.py, adopt the envelope constants (TYPE_START, EXEC_BEAT, LEAD_BEAT, OUT_STEP, TAIL_GAP, PRINT, STILLNESS). Implement squeeze(t) = t <= TYPE_START ? t : TYPE_START + (t-TYPE_START)*factor. Apply to all event times.

title: Integer-cycle caret blink with phase pin
text: Caret blinks via sine cycles across typing window: cycles = round(typeEnd/0.9). Phase runs 0→2π*cycles with ease:none. At typeEnd, pin opacity=1 (solid). At execAt, hide. Math.sin(phase)>=0 keeps phase 0 identical to initial state for seek parity.
how: Update terminal block in compose_lab.py: replace random blink with integer-cycle sine. Ensure caret element appended after text nodes so it hugs visible end. Test with doctor.py seek regression.

title: Cue overrides for output lines
text: Accept comma-separated seconds (cues variable) to pin each output line's appearance. Uncued lines follow previous line + OUT_STEP. Clamp each cue to [execAt+0.05, maxEnd-PRINT] and enforce minimum 0.05s gap. Falls back to authored even spread.
how: Add cues field to terminal block schema. In compose_lab.py, parse cues, map to output lines, integrate with schedule compression. Allows script-driven timing for key reveals (e.g., error line at exact VO word).

title: CSS @property for conic progress ring with synced count
text: Register --ring-progress as <percentage> with initial-value 0%. Animate the property via GSAP; onUpdate derive center label from same percentage (ratio = fill/target). Radial mask cuts ring. Fill and count never drift.
how: Add conic-progress-ring component. In compose_lab.py, use for data proofs (e.g., benchmark completion, model accuracy). Pass progress, thickness, label variables. Replace manual counter + arc animations.

title: Deterministic count-up with tabular numerals & optical affix trim
text: Pre-compute every displayed integer into a frameRows array using sine.inOut easing over COUNT_BASE (1.72s scaled). Render with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to prevent width jitter. Apply optical lift to prefix/suffix: currency glyphs (−0.31em), math-axis glyphs (+, −, ±, ×, =, ~, <, >, −) at −0.36em, others 0. Font size fits via min(150/charCount cqw, 34cqh). Landing pulse: scale 1→1.07→1 over 0.165s each side. Exit modes: none (hold), fade, or up.
how: In compose_lab.py stat-counter block, replace current counter with this frame-row method. Add affixLift() for ₹, %, +, −. Use container-query units (cqw/cqh) for responsive sizing. Register paused GSAP timeline keyed 'count-up'.

title: Three-part CTA lockup with subtle hold drift
text: Action line (power3.out, 0.5s) → capsule pop (back.out(1.7), 0.6s at 0.56s) → microcopy fade-up (power2.out, 0.42s at 1.18s). HOLD phase gets one sine.inOut drift cycle (−0.35cqh yoyo over HOLD/2) so longer mounts breathe. No OUT — lockup holds until cut. Capsule has accent shadow: 0 2.2cqh 6cqh color-mix(accent 28%). Border-radius 50cqh for pill.
how: Add as new end-card variant in compose_lab.py for videos needing supporting microcopy (e.g., 'Free while in beta'). Map variables: action_line, button_label, microcopy, accent. Use existing brand CSS vars (--brand, --accent, --accent-2).

title: Context-menu cursor choreography for UI demos
text: Cursor glides to target file (0.5s), right-clicks (press 0.1 depth, hold, overshoot release), menu blooms from tip (expo.out, 0.22s) flipping left/up if off-frame. Hover highlight tracks item under tip as cursor travels down (power2.inOut, 0.45s). Click chosen item (press 0.12 depth), menu collapses (0.14s), action executes: duplicate (copy slides in), rename (name becomes editable), trash (target scales 0.92, fades), toast (other actions). Cursor steps aside below window, holds.
how: Add as 'cursor-demo' block in compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech software tutorials. Variables: items (comma list), pick (index), tone (light|dark). Pre-build file grid with thumbnails (PDF, video, MD, JPG, WAV). Use layout-space offsetIn() for cursor positioning independent of host transforms.

title: Frame-accurate hit detection via high-FPS pre-walk
text: At 240 FPS, pre-compute first frame each tile is touched by marquee rect during drag (tiles.forEach: for f=dragStart to dragEnd, if touches(rectAt(f/FPS), tile.box) { tile.at=f/FPS; break }). Runtime just checks t >= tile.at.
how: Add to preflight.py for any collision-triggered animation: caption word highlight on voice word, chart bar pop on beat, card reveal on scroll. Pre-walk at 240 FPS during plan.py → store hit times in scene JSON → render.py reads exact frame numbers.

title: Marquee rectangle with independent 1px edge scaling
text: Rect has 5 parts: fill (scaleX+scaleY), top/bottom edges (scaleX only), left/right edges (scaleY only). All transform-origin 0 0. Edges stay 1px thick at any rect size. Opacity fades in 0.06s, out 0.18s.
how: Build into compose_lab.py as SelectionRect primitive for 'area highlight' scenes: data range selection, map region zoom, code block focus. Variable-driven start/end percentages. Use accent color from brand tokens.

title: Auto-zoom cursor camera for screen recordings
text: Camera pushes to each click (spring-trailed cursor), marks clicks with expanding ring, eases back out. Built-in dashboard fallback if no screenshot supplied. Three configurable click points (% based), zoom 1.2–2.6×, 5.8s default.
how: Add `cursor-zoom-follow` to compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech app walkthroughs. Feed screenshot from Muse/FLUX, set click coords from script beats. Spring simulation pre-baked at load for seek-safe renders.

title: Curtain-reveal transition with content slot
text: Two pleated velvet curtains gather outward (fixed fold widths, closed-form scalloped hem), optional pelmet and warm spotlight bloom. Stage is a slot (<template data-slot="curtain-reveal-stage">) accepting img/video/HTML. 2.4s default, elastic hold.
how: Install `curtain-reveal`; use in Puraan Ki Katha/Aage Suno for scene changes. In compose.py, wrap next scene's root in the slot template. Tone/pelmet/spotlight via variables for branding.

title: Dart Cursor motion primitive
text: A bold outlined arrowhead that dives from camera depth, flies nose-first with motion blur along its path, squashes on two clicks, and whips out. Configurable tone (dark/light), two click targets (x/y %), entry/exit edges (left/right/top/bottom), and blur strength (0–1.5). Uses SVG filter for directional motion blur and depth via scale.
how: Add as a reusable HyperFrames component in compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech UI demos; expose variables via shot config (target_x, target_y, enter_from, exit_to, blur, tone).

title: Device Frame Stage prop
text: Phone/tablet mockup staged as a physical prop with a screen slot for arbitrary reconstructed UI. Rises onto stage (1.08s), settles, then idle float (3.2s period, ±0.6cqh). Variables: device (phone/tablet), cutout (none/island/notch), body (graphite/silver). Fires 'device-settle-soft' SFX event at settle sync point.
how: Add as UI-demo primitive in compose_lab.py; screen slot accepts nested HyperFrames compositions for app UI. Map cutout to match installed content safe area.

title: Extended keyframe ease with creep tail
text: Ease covers reach=0.87 of distance by at=0.20 of duration, then creeps remaining 13% over 80% of time (tau≈0.29). Velocity rises in ramp=0.04, peaks once, decays monotonically (gate: zero rises after peak, max frame-to-frame drop <50%). Exit starts at next(duration)=0.6*duration while creep still moving.
how: Replace current arrival eases in plan.py/hook logic with EK.ease({reach:0.87, at:0.20, ramp:0.04, slow:0.10, tau2:0.29}) for kinetic titles, stat reveals, hook text. Sequence: next arrival at previous exitAt (0.6*duration).

title: Adaptive echo count with edgeSpacing for smooth rotation
text: Base count from measured-point travel (half-frame). If edgeSpacing>0, count = max(count, ceil(extent/edgeSpacing)) where extent = max corner shift between pose at t and t−streak_length. Ensures spinning element's outer edge moves ≤edgeSpacing (1.5px) between copies. 0 = AE exact count (visible steps).
how: When implementing echo-smear, always set edgeSpacing:1.5 for rotating/scaling elements (spinners, dials, scaling cards). For pure translation, edgeSpacing:0 saves DOM copies. Expose as variable in component schema.

title: Onion-skin ghost trail with opacity decay
text: Deep-clones subject into N ghosts (2–6), each at t − i*delta (delta 0.03–0.3s). Ghost opacity = base * clamp01(distance_to_lead / 2.2), so ghosts invisible at start/rest, collapse to zero at hold. Path presets: sweep/rise/arc. Per-ghost scale step 1.5% for depth. Lead entrance 0.22s fade-in.
how: Create echo-trail component in HyperFrames catalog; mount via data-slot for any subject (card, token, chart bar). Use in Kaise Tech to demo motion paths, in Puraan Ki Katha for mythic object trails.

title: Low-poly facet morph with per-facet lighting
text: 36 triangles (18 outer + 9 inner vertices) interpolate between authored silhouettes (blob/mark/badge). Each facet flat-shaded per frame: pseudo-normal = outward + fixed tilt; shade = dot(normal, light_from_upper_left) + tilt. Lit facets mix toward pale accent-tinted white (85%), shadow toward near-black (78%). Wobble amplitude ramps in/out via sine-in-out.
how: Add facet-morph as HyperFrames component for intros/transitions. Author 3–5 silhouettes per brand (Kaise Tech: circuit→chip→logo; Puraan: om→trishul→lotus). Drive via single linear driver tween; render() pure function of time.

title: Elastic Schedule Compression
text: A rule for handling variable video durations: define fixed IN/OUT phases and an elastic HOLD. If the total duration is too short, compress IN/OUT proportionally rather than using timeScale, ensuring the 'beat' of the animation remains intact.
how: Update `plan.py` and our GSAP templates to calculate `phaseScale` based on `root.dataset.duration` instead of letting animations overflow or clip.

title: Focus Rack Transition
text: A technique to shift viewer attention between two cards at different apparent depths. Uses synchronized blur, dimming, scale, and parallax over a ~0.7s duration to simulate a camera focus pull.
how: Add to `compose_lab.py` as a new 'compare' mode. When showing two tech stats or options, use this to highlight the 'winner' or the current topic of discussion.

title: Mobile Gesture Tap
text: A motion primitive for mobile UI demos. Features a contact circle (finger proxy) that performs a press/release sequence, triggering a button label swap, accent color fill, and a response pulse.
how: Use in tech explainers when showing how to use a specific app or AI tool. Implement in a new `ui_demo.py` component within the HyperFrames stack.

title: Fade Through Wash
text: A transition that fades a scene out into a colored 'wash' (flat or bloom) before revealing the next scene. More sophisticated than a standard crossfade.
how: Update `compose_lab.py` transitions. Use the 'ink' wash for dark lab scenes and 'accent' wash for high-energy tech news segments.

title: Focus Blur Resolve
text: A typography entrance where text pulls from a heavy Gaussian blur into a crisp state, combined with a slight scale-down (1.08 to 1).
how: Apply to 'kinetic titles' in `compose_lab.py`. It’s more 'lab-appropriate' than standard pop-ins for introducing technical terms or section headers.

title: Grade Split Reveal Slider
text: A WebGL-powered comparison slider showing flat vs. graded footage with a hard-edge sweep and labels. Uses real grading blocks rather than CSS filters for render parity.
how: Integrate into `compose_lab.py` for 'Before/After' segments. Use it to showcase AI image enhancements or camera quality comparisons in tech explainers.

title: Ambient Grain Field
text: A loopable procedural background with drifting dots and luminance wash. Uses CSS gradients and container units for a designed, textured surface look.
how: Add as a background option in `compose_lab.py`. Use it behind stat counters or UI panels to add depth to the 'dark lab' aesthetic without using video assets.

title: SVG Turbulence Grain Overlay
text: Animated film grain using a feTurbulence SVG filter and CSS keyframe transforms. Provides a non-repeating analog character to hide AI artifacts.
how: Update the grain layer in `compose_lab.py`. Replace static textures with this SVG-driven noise for a more organic, high-end film look.

title: Staggered Icon Card Assembly
text: Cards with thin-line icons that 'draw on' (SVG dash-offset) as they slide into a grid. Includes deterministic text fitting for labels and body text.
how: Add to `compose_lab.py` for feature lists or 'capability' scenes. The icon draw-on effect adds high-quality motion polish to tech explainers.

title: Halftone Dot Dissolve
text: A transition where Scene A dissolves into B via a growing halftone dot field. Dots pop as accent ink before opening into windows onto the next scene.
how: Add as a premium transition in `compose.py`. Use for high-energy scene changes in 'Kaise Tech' videos to maintain a tech-heavy aesthetic.

title: Curvature-Adaptive Pen Ease (hwPenEase)
text: A drawing ease where speed is inversely proportional to curvature (speed ∝ 1/(1+k*curvature)), floored at 0.22. It samples 25–75 points along a path to simulate a real pen slowing down into tight curves and accelerating on straights.
how: Integrate into compose.py and compose_lab.py. Use this ease for all 'draw-on' SVG animations (like arrows or underlines) to replace standard power2 eases with human-like drawing motion.

title: SVG Stroke Texture Matrix
text: A system to apply four distinct textures to SVG paths: 'plain', 'soft' (blur), 'sharp' (dry marker via dasharray), and 'spray' (deterministic dots). Sharp and spray modes use a mask-clone for draw-on animations so the texture remains static while the path reveals.
how: Add the hwStrokeApply helper to our visual stack. Use 'spray' for Puraan Ki Katha (folk look) and 'sharp' for Kaise Tech (whiteboard/lab look) annotations.

title: Travel-Aligned Arrival Stretch
text: For pointers/arrows: an arrival animation that stretches the arrowhead along its travel direction. Uses a nested 'rig' (outer group rotated to travel, inner group counter-rotated) so scaleX acts along the path without distorting the head's orientation.
how: Implement in hwArrowOn helper. Use for callouts in tech explainers to draw the viewer's eye exactly where the arrow is pointing at the moment of impact.

title: Wobbled Path Generators (Rect/Ellipse)
text: Functions to generate SVG path strings for rounded rectangles and ellipses with seeded, hand-drawn wobbles. Uses quadratic Bezier chains (Q) for ellipses and multi-segment lines (L) for rectangles to create organic edges.
how: Add hwWobbleRect and hwWobbleEllipse to our procedural prop factory. Use them to generate unique, non-perfect containers for captions and labels in storytelling videos.

title: Closed-form blob animation (no physics state)
text: Each blob row: dirX/dirY, spread, size, birth/die fractions of IN, wobbleAmp/Phase/Freq. At time p∈[0,1]: grow=easeOutCubic(clamp((p-birth)/0.34)), die=easeInOut(clamp((p-die)/(0.97-die))), radius=size/2*grow*(1-die), reach=spread*grow*(1-die), wobble=sin(p*2π*freq+phase)*wobbleAmp*grow*(1-die). Position = center + dir*reach + wobble*perp(dir). All params fixed at timeline construction.
how: When building organic bleed/spread effects (e.g., ink, fire, growth), precompute a parameter table per element during plan.py → compose_lab.py handoff. In the onUpdate painter, evaluate closed-form position/scale — no velocities, no integration, no per-element tweens. Guarantees deterministic renders and trivial seek/repair.

title: Slot pattern for custom mark content
text: Caller supplies content via an inert <template data-slot="ink-bleed-reveal-mark"> at host document level. On mount, the component queries ownerDocument for the template, imports its content into the mark container, replacing the default monogram. Templates never render; host clip children are wiped on mount so slot lives at document level.
how: Adopt this slot pattern in our HyperFrames components (compose_lab.py blocks). Define a data-slot name per component. In the component's mount script, look up hostDoc.querySelector('template[data-slot="..."]') and importNode into the designated container. Allows planners to inject custom SVGs, text, or HTML into reusable primitives without modifying component code.

title: Icon swap via CSS custom properties
text: Icon swap primitive animates --hf-icon-scale, --hf-icon-blur, --hf-icon-rotate on .from/.to spans via GSAP. Timeline: .from {opacity:0, scale:0.55, blur:8px, rotate:-18deg} 0.18s power2.in; .to {opacity:1, scale:1, blur:0, rotate:0} 0.26s back.out(1.7) staggered 0.12s. Variables (tone, size, shape, blur) write CSS custom properties at mount; unrecognised values fall back to defaults.
how: Add icon-swap as a UI-state block in compose_lab.py for toolbar/action demos (e.g., mic→mute, play→pause). Use the CSS variable animation pattern — it's lightweight, themeable via --brand/--accent tokens, and works with our existing GSAP timeline. Map our icon SVGs to .from/.to spans.

title: Inline marker highlight via CSS scale variable
text: Wrap target text in .hf-inline-highlight. Animate --hf-highlight-scale from 0→1. Pseudo-element ::after sits behind text (z-index:-1), height=0.38em (configurable thin/standard/thick), background=tint (yellow/green/blue/violet riding --brand/--accent/--accent-2), transform-origin=left/right/center. Stagger multiple highlights 0.12s, duration 0.55s power2.out.
how: In plan.py → compose_lab.py, when scripting emphasis words in captions or titles, wrap them in <span class="hf-inline-highlight"> and add a tl.to(".hf-inline-highlight", {"--hf-highlight-scale":1, stagger:0.12, duration:0.55, ease:"power2.out"}) call. Tint/thickness/origin set globally via data-composition-variables or per-span via inline style overrides.

title: Staggered Keyframe Card Stack
text: An anime-inspired motion pattern for stacks of cards. It uses CSS variables (--i) and GSAP staggers to animate Y-offset, scale, and opacity. The cards follow a 'back.out' easing curve to create a snappy, physical feel as they settle into a stack.
how: Use this in tech news summaries (scout.py) to present multiple headlines or GitHub repo cards in a single scene before expanding them.

title: Staggered Line-by-Line Blur Entry
text: A typography primitive that slides text lines from the side with a synchronized blur-to-sharp transition. It uses a custom property (--hf-line-axis-x) to easily toggle between left-to-right and right-to-left entry directions without changing the core animation logic.
how: Improve our kinetic titles by adding the blur filter and stagger. Update compose_lab.py to use this for multi-line technical definitions or code snippets.

title: Masked Line Swap
text: A typography primitive where Line A exits upward through an overflow-hidden mask while Line B enters from the bottom on the same beat. Includes an optional accent underline that draws left-to-right under a specific word after landing.
