how: Add to `compose_lab.py` as a transition for 'compare' or 'versus' scenes. Use a 0.72s swap span with 'power4.out' easing for the entrance to create a high-end editorial feel.

title: Locked Nucleus Orbit
text: A central nucleus node anchors 3-6 satellite chips that orbit and decelerate into a fixed lockup. Uses deterministic index-based phases so the final layout is always centered and balanced.
how: Integrate into `compose_lab.py` for 'Kaise Tech' explainers to visualize tech stacks or feature lists (e.g., 'Core AI' surrounded by 'Vision', 'Voice', 'Logic').

title: Impact Logo Sting
text: A high-impact reveal where a wordmark slams from 1.15x scale to 1x, triggering a single-frame white flash and an expanding accent ring (scale 0.34 to 2.4).
how: Update `thumb.py` or the start of `compose.py` to include this 0.95s 'sting' for brand intros. The 1-frame white flash is key for the 'slam' sensation.

title: Staggered Social Proof Wall
text: A grid of placeholder or branded logos that assembles using a deterministic per-cell stagger (20-75ms). Each cell fades and scales from 0.94x to 1x into its slot.
how: Add to `compose_lab.py` for 'Kaise Tech' videos when mentioning partners, tools, or 'trusted by' segments. Use a 3x5 grid default with 'power2.out' easing.

title: Wide-Tracked URL Breathe
text: A mono-spaced URL line that enters with a scaleX transition (1.06 to 1) instead of letter-spacing to avoid sub-pixel stuttering during frame-by-frame video capture.
how: Use this in the end card of all channels. Animating `scaleX` on a centered mono block is safer for our HyperFrames/Puppeteer render pipeline than animating `letter-spacing`.

title: Background Emphasis Type texture
text: Oversized (260px), low-contrast (rgba 0.07), uppercase word drifts slowly behind subject as typographic texture. aria-hidden, data-layout-allow-overflow. Helpers mkEmphasisIn/Out handle fade + sine drift. 97 lines.
how: In plan.py, add optional 'bg_emphasis_word' field per scene. In compose_lab.py, render a positioned .mk-emphasis div behind main content with drift -100px over 5s. No new block needed — just CSS + GSAP snippet.

title: Marker Checklist Card component
text: Paper card with Permanent Marker headline, hand-drawn underline, ellipse around one word, and three rows (Courier Prime label + marker value + self-drawing check). Rotated -3.03°, container-query sized, 4.5s timeline. Ships two OFL fonts.
how: Install via npx hyperframes add marker-checklist-card; use in Kaise Tech for feature lists (WRITE HTML → RENDER 4K → SHIP TODAY) or Puraan Ki Katha for story beats. Variables map directly to script fields.

title: Matrix Decode scramble-to-text
text: Monospace cells (up to 32 chars) show '0' then stagger-reveal target text left-to-right. Configurable size (24–160px), accent (green/blue/violet), glow (none/standard/strong). 128 lines, no timeline inside — caller drives stagger via GSAP.
how: Wrap as a HyperFrames block; call from plan.py for cold opens (e.g., 'HYPERFRAMES' → 'AI AGENT'). Use 0.18s stagger, 0.035s delay. Fits lab look with mono HUD aesthetic.

title: Hairline Arc Gauge (stat counter)
text: Thin circular gauge (r=92, 3px stroke) draws on while centered percentage counts up 0→target. Single helper mkArcIn(tl, sel, at, value) drives both stroke-dashoffset and numeral. Recolor via --mk-arc-color. 159 lines.
how: Adopt in compose_lab.py for 'stat counters' spec. Replace current kinetic number counter with this circular variant for percentages (CPU usage, model accuracy, mythological stats). Call mkArcIn from scene timeline.

title: Micro Transitions UI pack
text: Six CSS-custom-property-driven micro-interactions in one file: badge pop, dropdown reveal, modal open, tab indicator slide, tooltip appear, success-check draw. Single --hf-micro-progress (0→1) drives all; --hf-micro-tab for tabs. Travel scale (close/standard/far) adjusts entry distance. 264 lines.
how: Install as block; use in Kaise Tech app-demo segments. Map badge count, tooltip text, tone via variables. Drive --hf-micro-progress from scene timeline at precise beat. Replaces ad-hoc UI animations.

title: Silhouette Reshape Transition
text: Swaps two elements by morphing their silhouettes using scaleX/scaleY transforms instead of width/height tweens. This ensures layout-free, seek-safe, and deterministic transitions. Includes 'condense' (shrink-fade) and 'reshape' (silhouette match) modes for swapping different sized components.
how: Use this in compose.py for 'Compare & Contrast' scenes. It's ideal for switching between two different tech specs or two mythological artifacts in Puraan Ki Katha while maintaining visual continuity.

title: Measured human keystroke rhythm for typing
text: notes-typing uses a measured KEY_GAPS array (30 values: 0.033–0.2s) cycled per character, plus LINE_PAUSE=0.85s between paragraphs. Speed multiplier scales gaps. Caret rides right edge of each landed character (measured via getBoundingClientRect) and jumps down at line breaks. Fonts-ready gate ensures metrics are stable.
how: In our typing effects (compose_lab.py or a new typing block), replace uniform pace with a measured gap table. Add a fonts-ready promise before measuring caret positions. Store KEY_GAPS and LINE_PAUSE as constants; apply speed multiplier. Use for confession-style hooks in Kaise Tech or Puraan Ki Katha.

title: Accelerating arrival cadence with decay and floor gap
text: notification-pileup accelerates notification arrivals: gap_n = max(FLOOR_GAP, BASE_GAP * GAP_DECAY^(n-1) / speed) with BASE_GAP=0.78, GAP_DECAY=0.78, FLOOR_GAP=0.09. Raw gaps sum to rawGapTotal; if exceeding available IN window, all gaps scale by gapScale = available/rawGapTotal. Each arrival pushes existing stack down by STACK_STEP.
how: For any 'pileup' or accelerating sequence (e.g., incoming alerts, stacking evidence), implement gap decay with floor and global scaling to fit IN phase. In compose.py, add a helper that returns arrivalTimes array given count, baseGap, decay, floor, speed, and IN duration.

title: Token-derived color variations via oklch color-mix
text: multiplayer-cursors assigns each cursor a tone (0-5) and derives --mc-color via color-mix in oklch longer hue: e.g., tone 2 mixes brand 72% + accent 28%, tone 3 mixes 44%/56%. This yields harmonious, perceptually uniform variations from two brand tokens (--brand, --accent) without hardcoding hex values.
how: In our lab look color system (plate-based), define --brand and --accent tokens. For multi-element scenes (stat counters, device screens, chart series), assign tones and compute colors via CSS color-mix(in oklch longer hue, var(--brand) X%, var(--accent)). Use in thumb.py and compose_lab.py for consistent palettes.

title: Single-owner transform pattern (Wave K L1)
text: native-notification-pop ensures banner y has exactly one owner at any time: spring sampler (onUpdate) → rest pin (tl.set at at+DROP) → exit tween (tl.to at OUT_START). No two tweens fight for the same property. The drop cue is clamped so spring always settles before OUT begins. Prevents glitches on seeks or mid-motion redirects.
how: Audit our GSAP timelines in compose.py/compose_lab.py for properties animated by multiple tweens (e.g., y, scale, opacity). Restructure so each property has a single timeline segment: sampler → pin → exit. Add a lint rule in preflight.py to flag overlapping tweens on same target/property.

title: Number Pop-In entrance
text: Digit-by-digit stagger (0.055s) with blur (8px→0), lift (24px→0), and scale (0.82→1) driven by CSS custom properties (--hf-number-y, --hf-number-scale, --hf-number-blur). Four lift ranges (close/standard/far) and three tones (ink/paper/accent). Unit suffix rendered in small size same color family.
how: Wrap as a reusable stat-counter entrance in compose_lab.py: generate spans per character, apply the CSS vars, and drive via GSAP stagger fromTo on the custom properties. Use for subscriber counts, metric reveals, or data points in Kaise Tech shorts.

title: Outline Draw proof callout
text: Rounded rectangle outline draws clockwise via conic-gradient (--od-progress 0→100%) with 0.5deg seam overlap. Hollow center achieved by mask-composite: exclude (padding-box vs border-box). Variables: progress (0–100%), thickness (0.1–2.0 cqw), radius (0–8 cqmin). Envelope: 0.8s IN (power2.out), elastic HOLD, 0.4s OUT fade. CSS @property registers --od-progress for direct GSAP tweening.
how: Add as a 'proof' primitive in compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech: when a claim is verified, draw outline around the claim card or evidence region. Expose progress, thickness, radius; use accent color for the outline. The hollow center keeps content readable.

title: Page Slide Transition Pattern
text: Two full-bleed panels (old slate, new gradient) slide horizontally inside a rounded frame. Outgoing slides left + scales down 94%; incoming slides from right. Accent gradients: green/blue/violet. Corner radius: square/soft/round. Timeline recipe: 0.74s power3.inOut pan, label fade-in at 1.24s. Variables drive CSS custom properties only; no JS animation logic.
how: Adopt the CSS-variable-driven pattern in our transition library. In compose_lab.py, create a 'page_slide' block that emits the same markup/CSS and applies the GSAP timeline from the integration note. Use for app-screen transitions in Kaise Tech (Dashboard → Analytics). Keeps animation logic in timeline, styling in CSS.

title: Overwhelm Surround Agitation Effect
text: 8–24 chips (tasks, pings, alerts) accelerate radially inward around a calm center label, peaking at density set by intensity (0.5–2). Fixed IN (2.2s) with power-law arrival stagger, elastic HOLD at peak pressure, fixed OUT (0.5s) fade. Deterministic angular layout, no random. Chips have three kinds (task/alert/ping) with distinct styling.
how: Add as compositions/components/overwhelm-surround.html. In ideas.py/research.py, tag topics like 'notification overload', 'AI tool fatigue', 'multitasking myth' to trigger this block. In compose_lab.py, mount with count/intensity driven by script beat density. Use as cold-open agitator before solution reveal.

title: Pan Stations Camera Move
text: Camera pans laterally across 3–6 feature station cards (configurable labels), dwelling 0.2–2s at each. Fixed IN (0.45s) to first station, then sequential pans (0.25s each) + dwells in elastic HOLD, fixed OUT (0.4s) fade. Stations are full cards with kicker, glyph, mock UI lines, and large label. Cross-shelved: same mechanic reads as 'exhibit' (features) or 'agitate' (broken tools).
how: Add as compositions/components/pan-stations.html. In Kaise Tech scripts, use for multi-feature walkthroughs (e.g., 'Capture → Edit → Render → Share'). In compose_lab.py, map script sections to station labels; dwell driven by VO duration per section. Replaces static grid cuts with a continuous spatial journey.

title: Parallax zoom/unzoom grid transitions
text: Grid cards with data-row/col attributes. Focus card scales 6× while siblings translate radially outward (push 900px) and fade. Unzoom reverses: focus starts at 6×, siblings start pushed out, all converge to 1× grid. Single CSS custom property (--pz-progress/--pu-progress) driven 0→1 by GSAP. Auto-computes dx/dy per card from grid distance to focus.
how: Add parallax-zoom.html and parallax-unzoom.html as catalog blocks. In plan.py, add scene type 'grid_zoom' and 'grid_unzoom' for list→detail→list flows. Use for myth story character grids or tech tool comparisons.

title: Pendulum swing entrance with damped oscillation
text: Content rotates about pivot (top-center/left/right) via transform-origin. Single unitless property --hf-swing-angle eased 1→0 with custom ease: 1 - exp(-2.3p) * cos(3.5πp). Amplitude enum sets max angle (18/34/52deg). Direction flips sign. Tone sets bg/fg pair for contrast. No layout thrash—pure transform.
how: Add pendulum-swing.html as motion primitive. In compose_lab.py, create 'pendulum_entrance' block for titles, stat cards, or myth character names. Variables map to our variable system (pivot, amplitude, direction, tone).

title: Nonlinear rubber-band resistance formula
text: displayed = (distance * 0.55) / ((distance * 0.55) / 640 + 1). Maps raw pull to displayed offset with diminishing returns; RESISTANCE=0.55, REFERENCE=640. Self-contained, no external physics lib.
how: Use in any drag/pull animation (e.g., swipe transitions, interactive demos) by calling rubberBand(raw) in GSAP onUpdate to set transform y in cqh units.

title: Timeline integration recipe in comments
text: RGB Glitch Text includes a commented timeline recipe: tl.to('.comp', {opacity:1, duration:0.01}, start); tl.to('.comp', {'--hf-glitch-red':'-8px', '--hf-glitch-blue':'8px', duration:0.06, repeat:5, yoyo:true, ease:'steps(1)'}, start+0.1). Shows exact GSAP calls to drive the component.
how: In each component HTML, add a <!-- Timeline integration: --> comment block with the exact GSAP timeline code needed to trigger it. In compose.py, parse this block to auto-generate the mounting timeline. Reduces integration errors.

title: Baked position geometry for seek safety
text: Radial Surround computes ring positions (cos/sin) once before timeline registration, stores in --rs-ox/--rs-oy CSS vars. Close-in tweens those vars, not transform. GSAP misconverts vertical cq units to px mid-tween on seek; keeping calc() in stylesheet and interpolating var strings avoids this. Positions are deterministic at any seek.
how: In compose_lab.py, for any layout that positions elements on a curve/grid, precompute positions as CSS custom properties (--ox, --oy) during setup. Animate the vars, not x/y. Add a comment warning about GSAP cq-unit seek bug.

title: CSS token mapping for enum variables
text: Enum variables (accent, tone, direction) map to distinct CSS custom properties via a lookup object (e.g., accentColors = {green: 'var(--brand)', blue: 'var(--accent)', violet: 'var(--accent-2)'}). Root sets --rs-accent = accentColors[accent]. Components consume the token, not raw colors. Themes swap tokens globally.
how: In thumb.py and compose_lab.py, define a TOKEN_MAP for each enum variable. In the component script, root.style.setProperty('--comp-token', TOKEN_MAP[value]). Update CSS to use var(--comp-token). Ensures dark/lab themes work without component changes.

title: Slot pattern for component customization
text: Radial Surround uses <div data-slot="center">. If the slot already has children (custom subject), the default token card is skipped but chips, cues, close_in, exit still apply. The center never moves. This allows forks without code duplication.
how: In compose.py, when mounting a component HTML, check for data-slot elements. If our composition provides custom children for that slot, skip default content generation. Document slot names in component metadata (add to brain.jsonl).

title: Variable validation with fallback helper
text: A tiny pick(table, value, fallback) function: returns value only if table hasOwnProperty(value), else fallback. Used for every enum (intensity, accent, tone, style, exit). Unrecognized inputs silently revert to declared default. No crashes, predictable behavior.
how: Add pick() to shared JS utils (or Python equivalent in plan.py). Wrap all enum variable reads: intensity = pick(reaches, vars.intensity, 'standard'). Log a warning if fallback used. Apply to ideas.py scoring enums too.

title: Seek-Safe Transform Pattern
text: Avoids using Container Query (cq) units inside GSAP tweens, as they can cause resolution errors during rapid seeks. Instead, set container dimensions once in cqh/cqw at mount, then use percentage-based transforms (yPercent) for all animations to ensure deterministic rendering.
how: Update `preflight.py` to audit HTML templates; flag any GSAP `to/from` calls that attempt to animate values containing 'cqw', 'cqh', or 'cqmin'.

title: Skeleton Post Cycle
text: For background feeds or data streams, use 4-6 skeleton variants (list, card, chart, detail) that cycle by index. This ensures adjacent items never look identical without requiring unique assets for every background element.
how: Add a `get_skeleton(index)` helper to our UI generation scripts to provide variety in 'Kaise Tech' background panels without increasing asset load.

title: Camera-Servo Parallax Law
text: Centralizes all camera and layer state into a single progress object (cam.t). Every depth layer's transform is a pure function of this state, calculated by a single writer function. This ensures that any seek in any order reproduces the exact frame across multiple parallax layers (far, mid, foreground).
how: Add to `HyperFrames` core. Use a single `applyCamera()` function in our HTML templates to drive all `translateY` offsets based on a master progress variable instead of independent tweens.

title: Doomscroll Flick Rhythm
text: Simulates realistic social media scrolling using a 'thumb flick' profile: a near-instant start followed by a power3.out decay to a settle. This is combined with a read-pause (rest) between flicks, with the total travel covering exactly one card cycle for loop compatibility.
how: Add as a preset in `compose_lab.py` for 'phone UI' scenes. Map `cues` from the script to trigger these specific power3 flick durations (approx 0.4s).

title: Frame-sampled spring motion table
text: Sheet Spring-Up uses a 23-keyframe table (time, y-offset, opacity) sampled from reference footage — not an ease. The sheet overshoots −192 px, settles in 0.72 s. Play verbatim for reference feel; retime proportionally to keep spring character.
how: In motion design docs, add pattern: for critical UI arrivals, capture reference motion at 30 fps, export keyframe array, drive GSAP via tl.set(props, startTime + t) per row. Replace power2/back eases with sampled data for hero transitions.

title: Seek-safe progress reveal via CSS custom property
text: Separator component uses --hf-separator-progress (0→1) on a span width/height; GSAP animates the custom property directly. Works for horizontal/vertical, thickness 1/2/4 px, tone neutral/accent/warning. No layout thrash, deterministic at any seek.
how: Adopt pattern for any linear reveal (bars, underlines, scanlines): animate a single CSS custom property from 0 to 1, bind to width/height/clip-path in CSS. Use in preflight.py stills audit to verify progress at key timestamps.

title: Power2.inOut measured superior to fitted bezier for blurred motion
text: Shutter-slam author tested a bezier fitted to reference bbox centres vs power2.inOut. Bezier rendered 1.3 dB worse on horizontal slam, 1.0 dB worse on vertical turn, 0.25 dB worse overall. Reason: blurred bbox centre is shutter-window average, not instant; on accelerating segments the fit measures its own blur. Power2.inOut measured best on the integrated-blur reference.
how: In plan.py and compose_lab.py, default to power2.inOut for any fast transform under motion blur. Document in playbook.md as the measured-best easing for shutter-integrated motion. Audit existing GSAP tweens in lab look for bezier eases on blurred elements.

title: Skeleton-loader pulse-then-crossfade transition pattern
text: Skeleton shimmers via background-position: 0%→100% over 0.7s (linear), then skeleton fades 0.22s, content fades in 0.24s (total 1.14s). Light/dark tone via CSS custom properties (--hf-sr-surface, --hf-sr-bar, --hf-sr-ink, --hf-sr-muted). Content revealed: primary + secondary line. No JS animation — pure CSS + GSAP timeline integration.
how: Add skeleton-reveal as a transition block in compose_lab.py for UI demo scenes (app walkthroughs, dashboard reveals). Use tone variable for dark lab aesthetic. Timeline recipe: tl.to(skeleton, {backgroundPosition:'100% 0'}, 0.7) → tl.to(skeleton, {opacity:0}, 0.22) → tl.to(content, {opacity:1}, 0.24).

title: Beat amplitudes as container fractions for responsive slam
text: Shutter-slam amplitudes: SLAM_X = 32.1cqw, SLAM_Y = 30.5cqh (measured from 617px/329px on 1920×1080 reference). Scale punch 4.04× and 0.466× overflow intentionally; clip crops. Beat durations: 0.3s per slam (4×), 0.6s per 3D turn, 0.733s for Z turn. Total beats 5.97s. Elastic hold = max(0, D - BEATS - OUT). Beat clock compresses if D shorter; never timeScale.
how: In compose_lab.py, express all kinetic-title and stat-counter amplitudes in cqw/cqh fractions measured from reference designs. Adopt elastic-hold envelope (fixed beat durations, hold stretches, compress only if needed) for all lab-look blocks. Add beat-duration constants to playbook.md.

title: CSS custom-property driven slot-machine counter
text: Vertical reel rolls characters via --hf-slot-y transform on <i> elements. Direction (up/down), size (48/74/104px), tone (ink/paper/accent) set as CSS vars. Roll distance scales with row height so landing is always exactly one row. GSAP animates --hf-slot-y from 0 to -row with stagger 0.06s, power3.inOut, 0.52s duration.
how: Adopt in compose_lab.py for stat counters, metric reveals, or Hinglish number animations. Replace current kinetic-number-counter with this reel mechanic; supports multi-character results (e.g., "1.2M"). Expose result, direction, size, tone as block variables.

title: Proxy-based timeline registration trap for deterministic mount
text: Object.defineProperty on window.__timelines wraps the registry in a Proxy; set trap calls sweep() immediately when a timeline is registered. Also polls every 32ms for 250 ticks (8s) to catch async sub-composition mounts. Elements marked with data-hf-motion-blur are claimed once; nested targets rejected. Prevents double-registration with different timelines (warns).
how: Adopt in our HyperFrames runtime (compose.py) for any block that needs timeline attachment (motion blur, canvas repaint, audio sync). Replace current manual timeline registration with this proxy + poll pattern to guarantee blocks attach before first render frame. Add to doctor.py as a health check for stuck compositions.

title: Phase-Opposed Idle Float
text: To keep a scene 'alive' during a hold, use barely-there vertical floats (±0.6cqh) that are phase-opposed (Card A goes up while Card B goes down). Each cycle must be an explicit tween (not a loop) that starts and ends at rest to ensure seek-safety and a clean transition to the exit.
how: The planner (plan.py) should specify 'idle float' for static comparison scenes. The composer should implement these as sine-eased half-cycles during the 'HOLD' phase of the video.

title: Interruptible Spring (L1 Law) Redirect
text: A motion logic where in-flight animations can be redirected mid-tween while preserving instantaneous velocity. Uses an analytic cut to compute current value/velocity, then continues with a cubic Hermite ease (h'(0)=m, h'(1)=0). This prevents 'snapping' or 'popping' when a new cue triggers before the previous one settles.
how: Implement in a new `physics.js` helper for HyperFrames. Use it in `compose_lab.py` to handle rapid-fire UI updates or chat bubbles that need to shift as new messages arrive without jarring stops.

title: 3D Book-Open Split Tilt
text: A comparison layout using two cards with mirrored 3D rotateY tilts (+18deg and -18deg) under a shared 120cqw perspective. Includes outward-falling box-shadows and inner-edge spring-pop badges. The layout uses `preserve-3d` on parent containers to ensure the tilt reads through nested GSAP transforms.
how: Add to `compose.py` for 'Choices' or 'Compares' scenes in Puraan Ki Katha (e.g., comparing two warriors or paths). Use CSS `perspective` on the stage and `rotateY` on the card elements.

title: Deterministic Granular Blob
text: A canvas-based 'AI orb' material using a grain table computed once from a fixed LCG seed (0x50f7b10b). Specks drift on integer-cycle sines (zero at start/end) and deform toward a touch point using an exponential falloff. Layered radial gradients create a soft, non-linear 'attraction bulge' effect.
how: Integrate into `compose_lab.py` as a background or 'AI Thinking' prop for Kaise Tech. Use the provided Canvas 2D paint loop to ensure the 'lab' look remains high-tech and organic.

title: Scripted Spotlight Mesh
text: A card effect using three radial gradients on a blurred 'mesh' layer, driven by CSS variables (--hf-x1, --hf-y1, etc.). A separate 'spot' element with `mix-blend-mode: screen` follows a scripted path to simulate a flashlight or cursor highlight. Lit borders are achieved via `color-mix` with the accent color.
how: Apply in `compose_lab.py` for 'Product Showcase' scenes. When explaining a new gadget or UI feature, use the spotlight to guide the viewer's eye to specific text blocks or icons.

title: Fractional Star Rating Fill
text: A star row (1-10 stars) where a colored layer sweeps from left-to-right using a clip-path (inset) to represent a rating (e.g., 4.8). Includes synchronized numeric count-up and per-star scale pops.
how: Integrate into `compose_lab.py` for 'Kaise Tech' verdict scenes or app reviews. Pass the rating value from `research.py` directly to the `rating` variable.

title: State Chip Rail Machine
text: A horizontal rail of status chips (Pending, Active, Done) that advances via deterministic attribute snaps (`tl.set`). Active chips use brand accents; done chips dim via color-mix to avoid opacity conflicts.
how: Use in `compose_lab.py` to visualize multi-step tech processes (e.g., 'Reading', 'Processing', 'Done'). Map the `times` variable to the scene's VO timestamps for perfect sync.

title: Deterministic Snap Machine Pattern
text: Using GSAP `tl.set` for instantaneous attribute flips (like `data-state`) instead of transitions. This ensures backward seeks restore the prior state exactly, making the UI state machine seek-safe.
how: Update `compose_lab.py` UI logic to use `tl.set` for all state changes (active/inactive tabs, toggle switches) instead of CSS transitions or standard `.to()` tweens.

title: Sticky Mock Swap
text: A pinned UI mock that cross-fades between skeleton states while captions rise and exit beside it. Captions move along a shallow arc (two-segment GSAP tween) rather than a straight line.
how: Apply in `compose_lab.py` for feature tours. The 'pinned' mock stays constant while `plan.py` generated captions cycle through the adjacent slot.

title: Strikethrough replace with origin control
text: Draw a strike line across old text from left, center, or right (transform-origin), then fade in replacement. Thickness: thin 3px, standard 6px, thick 10px. Tint: red/amber literal, blue/violet ride --accent/--accent-2. Tone: ink (near-black) or paper (near-white). Strike progress 0→1 in 0.28s power2.out; replacement fades up 0.24s later with y:14→0.
how: Create a reusable strikethrough block in compose_lab.py for myth/fact or before/after transitions (Puraan Ki Katha, Kaise Tech). Drive via GSAP timeline: fromTo '--strike-progress' 0→1, then fromTo replacement opacity/y. Variables map to CSS custom properties for instant theming.

title: Success Check Primitive
text: A checkmark animation featuring a ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotation. Includes variables for tint (green, blue, violet, amber), size, and 'spin' intensity to control the swing-in distance.
how: Add to `compose_lab.py` as a reusable component for 'verdict' or 'success' states in tech explainers. Implement using the provided GSAP back.out(1.8) easing for the pop.

title: SVG Mask Reveal
text: A wordmark reveal where token-colored media is visible only through an SVG text mask. A soft alpha band (feathered edge) sweeps across the mask from left to right to reveal the content.
how: Create a new effect block for title sequences in Kaise Tech. Use CSS @property for the sweep-x percentage and mask-image: intersect to combine the text mask with the linear-gradient sweep.

title: SVG Stroke Trace with Closed Fill
text: Draws an authored SVG path based on its measured length (getTotalLength). Crucially, it detects if a path is closed (regex /[zZ]\s*$/) and applies a restrained 16% opacity fill after the stroke completes.
how: Integrate into `compose_lab.py` for technical diagrams. It ensures that signatures stay as lines while shapes like boxes or circles get a professional fill automatically.

title: Swipe Rail Gesture Simulation
text: A horizontal card rail that follows a visible 'contact circle' (touch point). Features a fast initial drag, momentum decay, and a physical 'back.out' snap to the next card in the sequence.
how: Build as a new scene type for app/UI demos. Use the provided logic where the rail x-position is calculated as -(index * step + width / 2) to keep the active card centered.

title: Telemetry HUD
text: A framing HUD with four corner brackets that draw on and up to 8 'label:value' readouts. Features deterministic ticking where values roll through same-class stand-ins (digits for digits) before resolving.
how: Primary upgrade for `compose_lab.py`. Replace current static UI panels with this bracketed frame. Use the provided LCG-seeded stand-in logic to ensure value ticks are seek-safe.

title: Tabs Slide Indicator
text: A pill-shaped indicator that slides between text labels. Uses a clever linear-gradient background-clip on the buttons to change text color from muted to white as the pill passes under them.
how: Add as a UI primitive for 'Kaise Tech' to show switching between different modes or steps in a process. Use the `--hf-tab-highlight` clamp logic for the text color transition.

title: Terminal Simulator Chrome
text: A full terminal window simulation including a top chrome bar with traffic-light dots, a file-tree sidebar, and a main editor area with animated 'code lines' and a typing terminal prompt.
how: Upgrade the current 'terminal typing' in `compose_lab.py` to this full window look. Use the staggered scaleX animation for the 'code lines' to simulate code being written.

title: Avatar slot pattern (initials fallback, image replaceable)
text: Avatar disc is a named slot (data-slot='avatar'). Default child: initials span (first two name parts, uppercase). User replaces slot content with or
how: In compose_lab.py, when rendering person cards, emit slot markup. Provide initials via variable; allow asset manifest to supply image URL. Add to component library as reusable 'avatar-disc'.

title: Elastic hold envelope standard
text: All primitives use fixed IN_BASE, OUT_BASE, HOLD = max(0, D - IN - OUT). If D < IN_BASE+OUT_BASE, scale IN/OUT by D/(IN_BASE+OUT_BASE), HOLD=0. Never timeScale the timeline. OUT_START = IN + HOLD. Sync points (quote-readable, cut-at) defined as fractions of IN_BASE, compress with scale.
how: Standardize in compose.py base class. Add helper compute_envelope(duration, in_base, out_base) returning {in, hold, out, out_start, scale}. Use in all new blocks; audit existing blocks for compliance.

title: Deterministic font-size fit via 1/sqrt(chars)
text: Quote font-size = clamp(3.8, 7.2, 46 / sqrt(character_count)) cqmin. Ensures 2-3 lines at any card width without layout shift. Applied via CSS var --tq-font-size before tokenization.
how: Add to compose_lab.py text sizing utility. Use for any dynamic quote/headline block. Prevents overflow in 9:16 shorts where container width varies.

title: Ticker Takeover Component
text: Mono ticker rolls 4-6 words, locks on final_word with accent flash, promotes to full-frame headline. Variables: options (csv), final_word, accent (green/blue/violet). Envelope: fixed IN/OUT, elastic HOLD only, compresses if duration short.
how: Integrate into plan.py as hook template. Use for "signal" style opens: ticker cycles keywords, locks on key term, promotes to headline. Map accent to brand colors. Duration auto-fits via envelope scaling.

title: CSS custom property driven per-character stagger animation
text: Top-down letters uses --hf-char-y (driven by timeline) and --hf-char-distance (variable multiplier) on each span. GSAP animates the custom property: tl.fromTo('.span', {'--hf-char-y':'-42px'}, {'--hf-char-y':'0px', stagger:0.035}). Keeps animation logic in CSS, reduces GSAP targets.
how: Refactor kinetic titles and sentence captions to use CSS custom properties for per-character transforms. Define --char-y, --char-opacity, --char-scale on .caption-word spans. Animate properties via GSAP stagger, letting CSS handle transform composition. Reduces DOM thrashing.

title: True hold (dead still) as intentional design, not blank stretch
text: Titlecard lockup: 'TRUE hold: dead still. No drift, no breath; sub-perceptual motion reads as noise at 1080p, and the stillness is the point.' Review.py must distinguish intentional holds (zero motion by design) from frozen frames (bugs). Hold phase has zero tweens, just timeline pause.
how: Update review.py blank-stretch scan: accept stretches where timeline has no active tweens and composition metadata marks 'intentional-hold'. Add hold metadata to plan.py output. Doctor.py should not repair intentional holds.

title: Sub-composition mount contract with variable inheritance
text: Components live in separate HTML files, loaded via data-composition-src. The runtime clones only <template>, discards <head>, sizes root to host box (inset:0, container-type:size), reads variables via window.__hyperframes.getVariables() (merged defaults + per-instance overrides), and registers one paused timeline under a hardcoded key matching data-composition-id.
how: Refactor compose.py/compose_lab.py to emit mountable component files (compositions/components/*.html) with this contract. Update plan.py to reference components by ID and pass data-variable-values. Add CLI install like 'npx hyperframes add <component>'.

title: hf:sfx CustomEvent for decoupled sound cues at fixed timeline offsets
text: Primitives dispatch root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hf:sfx', {detail:{id:'click-soft', t:FLIP_AT}}, bubbles:true)) at exact timeline times (never inside elastic HOLD). Host composition's mix stage listens and routes to catalog SFX. Keeps animation and audio separate.
how: Extend mix.py to register an hf:sfx listener on the root during render. Map SFX IDs to our SFX library. Update all component scripts to emit cues at sync points (e.g., toggle flip, touch down, beam arrival).

title: UI prop reference primitive with physicality (overshoot, crossfade, press)
text: Toggle flip demonstrates binary state change: thumb travels 150% with back.out(1.9) overshoot, track color crossfades via CSS color-mix on --tf-mix (0→100), soft press-compress (scaleX 0.94, scaleY 1.06) before flip, ambient glow breathes during HOLD. Dispatches hf:sfx at FLIP_AT.
how: Add toggle-flip component to lab look for Kaise Tech settings/feature demos. Extend compose_lab.py to support 'ui-prop' block type with direction, label, size variables. Use for 'Auto-save', 'Dark mode', 'Notifications' toggles in tech explainers.

title: Tracing beam: SVG path dash follower with sequential node highlight
text: Glowing dash (stroke-dashoffset) follows authored SVG path through 3 anchored nodes. Each node brightens (opacity 0.48→1, lift -2.2cqh, halo pulse) on beam arrival, dims after delay. Final node drifts subtly during HOLD. Beam exits via strokeDashoffset to -routeLength. Fixed 3s IN, 0.55s OUT.
how: Add tracing-beam for Kaise Tech multi-step workflows (Search→Preview→Export). Author SVG path per composition. Use labels variable for step names. Integrate with existing UI panel blocks to highlight active step in flow diagrams.

title: Trust Strip for Social Proof
text: Monochrome row of 3–7 wide-tracked uppercase mono wordmarks (letter-spacing 0.32em) that fade in left-to-right with 0.15s stagger, then hold dead still. Variables: `marks` (comma list), `tone` (muted/ink), `accent` (10% tint: green/blue/violet), `exit` (none/fade/up). Wraps to second row gracefully.
how: Create `trust-strip.html` component. In `plan.py`, add trust-strip scene after hook for credibility. Feed `marks` from `brain.jsonl` partner logos. Use `tone: muted` for lab look, `accent: green` for brand tint.

title: Typing Indicator Chat Bubble
text: Three-dot iOS-style bubble (124px default, scales 80–220px) with pop-in: scale 0.6→1, alpha 0.4→1 over 0.10s power2.out. Two shrinking tail circles anchor to sender side. Variables: `size` (px), `tone` (dark/light), `tail` (on/off). Dots hold still by reference; optional bounded wave (5 repeats) seek-safe.
how: Add `typing-indicator.html` for chat story templates (Aage Suno page). Trigger via `hf:sfx` cue when AI reply pending. Use `tone: dark` for lab look, `size: 100` for 9:16 vertical.

title: Complete axis list for stable font interpolation
text: When animating fontVariationSettings, both from/to strings must include every axis (wght, wdth, opsz) in identical order with explicit values. Omitting even unchanged axes silently disables interpolation. Example: '"wght" 700, "wdth" 100, "opsz" 96' → '"wght" 900, "wdth" 100, "opsz" 96'.
how: Update any variable-font code in compose_lab.py to always compose full axis strings. Add validation in preflight.py to check fontVariationSettings completeness.

title: Design-tool app chrome primitive
text: Ready-made dark vector editor UI: topbar (window controls, doc name, live dot, zoom), left toolbar (pen/shape/type tools with active state), central canvas with grid + artboard, right inspector (layers, properties). Path draws via stroke-dashoffset, anchors/handles/selection frame reveal sequentially. Sync point at path finish (1.05s) fires hf:sfx. Holdable for variable scene lengths.
how: Add vector_editor_rig block to compose_lab.py. Use for Kaise Tech AI coding tool demos, design workflow explainers. Variables: tool (pen/shape/type), pathLabel. Style via --brand token.

title: Vox-style keyword annotation with connector callout
text: A keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker (highlight/circle/underline/scribble) while a thin SVG connector draws to a mono callout label — all as one choreographed beat. Uses measured stroke-dashoffset with explicit fromTo for seek safety; marker, connector, label timings are fixed phases (marker 0.60s, connector 0.45s from 0.36s, label 0.30s from 0.66s) with keyword pop on ink landing.
how: Add vox-annotate.html as a HyperFrames block in compose_lab.py; map script keywords to keyword variable, note to callout text, draw_at to VO timestamp. Use accent enum for brand colors. Replace static highlight boxes with this dynamic annotation for tech/mythology explainers.

title: Five-shot rail with physics throw and snap settle
text: Five cards on a rail whip in on power4.out throw (0.78s), then back.out(1.7) snap (0.62s) to center hero index. Non-hero cards dim/scale down; hero gets accent border, glow, and breathing aura (sine.inOut yoyo) during elastic hold. All motion via CSS custom properties (--vts-throw-x, --vts-tilt) driven by single GSAP timeline; duration compresses if clip shorter than 1.4s IN.
how: Add velocity-throw-snap.html for 'top 5 tools' or 'mythology character select' segments. Map hero_index to research.py's top pick, accent to page brand, card_label_prefix to 'Tool'/'Character'. Use in compose_lab.py as a feature-tour block; replaces static card grids with kinetic selection.

title: Wordmark Tiles Reveal
text: A wordmark resolves from a grid of deterministic color-noise tiles via a spatially modulated wave. Variables: text (≤12 chars), columns (8–14), waveStagger (15–50 ms). Uses fixed-seed LCG for noise assignment, sorts tiles by computed waveRank (col + row*0.68 + sin(row*1.7+col*0.42)*2.15) for organic wave order. IN=4.8s, OUT=0.5s, elastic HOLD. Mountable sub-composition with data-composition-variables.
how: Add as lab-look title block in compose_lab.py: install via CLI, mount in composition with data-variable-values for each video's brand/section title. Replaces static text reveals with premium raster wave.

title: On-Screen Display Effect
text: Two CSS classes: .yt-screen-warp3d (perspective(1400px) rotateY(-3.5deg) rotateX(1.6deg)) on media wrapper, and .yt-screen-fx overlay (sheen gradient + scanlines repeating-linear-gradient 0deg 1px/3px + pixel grid 90deg 1px/4px + inset box-shadows). Helpers: ytScreenOn/Off(tl, target, at) for fade.
how: Integrate into lab-look 'device frame' props. In compose_lab.py, wrap any footage/include with .yt-screen-warp3d and append .yt-screen-fx. Use for phone/laptop screen recordings, dashboard captures — makes flat footage read as physical display.

title: Zoom Through Transition
text: Scene push transition: outgoing scene drifts back/scales down/blurs (--hf-from-x, --hf-from-scale, --hf-from-blur) while incoming scene wipes in via clip-path inset (--hf-clip-right 100%→0%) with accent ring (--hf-accent). Variables: from-label, to-label, depth (close=0.55/standard=1/far=1.7), accent (blue/green/violet). PUSH=0.9s, START=0.35s clamped. Includes fx shear sweep and RGB strobe (repeat 3, yoyo, steps(1)).
how: Add to lab-look transition palette (currently 3 rotating transitions). Install component, mount between scenes in index.html with data-variable-values per episode. Depth knob lets us tune intensity per context; accent rides theme tokens.

title: GSAP Helper Function Library
text: Each yt-* component exposes window.ytCameraMove, ytCircleOn, ytHighlightIn, etc. as pure timeline builders (tl, target, at, opts). They gsap.set defaults, then tl.to at offset. Self-contained, no side effects. Pattern: copy helpers into host script, call with timeline and absolute time. Enables composition of complex sequences from primitives.
how: Create motion_primitives.js with our common moves: labTitleReveal, statCounterPop, chatBubbleStream, terminalType, panelShine, kineticTitleUnderline. In compose_lab.py, import and call from scene timeline builder. Keeps plan.py declarative, motion reusable.

title: Semantic Catalog Search with On-Device Embeddings
text: Catalog search uses bge-small-en-v1.5 ONNX (384-dim, 33MB) for meaning search ("make pace faster" finds relevant blocks). Word-match fallback. Model pinned to revision ea104dacec62c0de699686887e3f920caeb4f3e3. Vectors rebuilt in batches of 16 for reproducibility. Runs locally, no query leaves machine.
how: Integrate into ideas.py: when scoring 10 ideas, also search catalog for relevant visual blocks. Use --on-device --yes in CI to pre-download. Helps scout.py find existing patterns instead of reinventing.

title: Reviewed Changelog Process with Draft Regeneration
text: Stable releases require reviewed releases/vX.Y.Z.md and docs/changelog.mdx sync. release:prepare drafts then exits non-zero for review. Rerun after rewrite to tag. Weekly digest generates editorial drafts (internal + public weekly-updates.mdx). Group changes: Breaking, Features, Fixes, Performance, Docs, Catalog, Internal.
how: Adopt for studio pipeline: maintain CHANGELOG.md in repo. ideas.py/research.py/compose.py changes get entries. Weekly digest feeds brain.jsonl lessons. Use bun run changelog:weekly for 09:00 report content.

title: Template Migration Pattern: Remotion inputProps → HyperFrames Variables
text: Direct mapping: defaultProps → variable defaults, inputProps → --variables, props.x → data-var-text/getVariables().x, renderMediaOnLambda → renderToLambda. Declare allowed values in composition, pass only per-render data, keep large media outside payload (URLs). 256 KiB Step Functions limit.
how: When adapting external templates (e.g., from Remotion examples), convert to HyperFrames variables. Use in compose_lab.py for lab-look templates. Enforce --strict-variables in render.py to catch typos early.

title: Composition Variables with Types, Defaults, and Portrays
text: Declare variables on composition root with id, type (string/number/color/boolean/enum/font/image), label, default, description, and portrays (semantic role like subject_name, subject_logo). Bind via data-var-text, data-var-src, or CSS custom properties. Enables templating without code changes.
how: Add data-composition-variables to index.html in compose.py/compose_lab.py output. Create variable registry in plan.py. Use --variables CLI flag for batch renders. Portrays helps AI agents fill slots correctly.

title: Batch Rendering from JSONL with Variable Overrides
text: Render same composition N times with different variables via JSONL file (one object per line with outputKey and variables). CLI handles project upload once, then fans out renders. Supports --max-concurrent, --strict-variables, --dry-run validation.
how: Add batch mode to render.py: accept recipients.jsonl, loop hyperframes render --batch. Use for Kaise Tech/Puraan Ki Katha variants (Hinglish/English) or A/B thumbnail tests. Reuse project upload via content-addressed site ID.

title: Canary Rollout System with Sunset Enforcement
text: Register features at 0% in canaryRegistry.ts with owner and sunsetAfter date. Ramp via percentage edits (0→5→25→100). Evaluator is pure (no FS/network). Override via HF_CANARY_<NAME>=on/off. Weekly sunset workflow fails CI if past sunsetAfter. Cohorts bucket on install-state.json seed.
how: Add canary registry to doctor.py for pipeline features (new transition, TTS voice, caption style). Gate with isCanaryEnabled() in compose_lab.py. Use for safe rollout of experimental visual blocks. Auto-fail if not cleaned up by sunset date.

title: Catalog Registry with Params, Dependencies, and CDN Assets
text: Registry items (blocks/components) have manifest with params (color/text/number/select), registryDependencies, minCliVersion, deprecated. Binary assets uploaded to CDN via host:registry-assets, replaced with content-addressed URLs. Installer resolves deps transitively, rejects cycles.
how: Create registry/blocks for reusable HyperFrames patterns (stat counter, chat bubble, terminal typing). Define params for brand colors, durations. Use hyperframes add in init.py. Share blocks across Kaise Tech, Puraan Ki Katha, Aage Suno pages.

title: Content-Addressed Project Uploads (Sites) for Reuse
text: hyperframes lambda sites create hashes project tree (SHA-256) → siteId. Files stored once in CAS bucket (cas/sha256/), shared across sites/renders. 30-day TTL refreshed on use. Render with --site-id skips upload. Same pattern works for Cloud Run.
how: Add sites create to publish.py for Telegram approval flow: upload once, then render variants (Hinglish/English, different thumbnails) with same siteId. Saves bandwidth and time for multi-language shorts.

title: CLI Local Testing Workflow (Link, Direct Call, npm Pack)
text: Three methods: bun link (persistent), node dist/cli.js (direct), npm pack + npx ./tgz (release candidate). Test against external project. Verify args, errors, --json output, preview, render output (ffprobe), cleanup. Kill orphan preview servers on port.
how: Add test-local.sh to CI: build, link, run hyperframes lint/check/render on fixtures. Verify doctor.py self-repair works. Use before merging compose.py/compose_lab.py changes. Prevents regressions in HyperFrames render pipeline.

title: Release Channels: Stable on main, Prerelease on next/alpha
text: main = stable/releasable (npm latest). next/alpha = prerelease branches (npm dist-tag alpha/beta/rc). Prerelease tags only from main/next/alpha. Stable requires reviewed PR from release/vX.Y.Z branch, approved by second maintainer. Alpha tags pushed by admins only. CI enforces boundaries.
how: Apply to studio: main branch = production pipeline. next branch = experimental visual blocks (new GSAP transitions, caption styles). Protect main with required reviews. Deploy preview from next for owner feedback via Telegram before merge.

title: Project templates for new series scaffolding
text: Templates: kinetic-type (type-led promos/intros), decision-tree (explainable diagrams/tutorials), nyt-graph (editorial charts/data stories), swiss-grid (technical/structured), product-promo (multi-scene showcases), vignelli (bold portrait announcements), warm-grain (branding/lifestyle), play-mode (energetic social). Each gives a complete project structure via `npx hyperframes init --example <name>`.
how: Map templates to series: kinetic-type → Kaise Tech intros; decision-tree → Puraan Ki Katha explainers; nyt-graph → data-driven shorts; swiss-grid → Aage Suno structured stories. Use blank for agent-generated custom work.

title: Component inspector snippets for debugging animation issues
text: With check-review inspect:true + findingFrames:true, the component inspector runs on each finding's element (by data-hf-id or selector) and returns: results (element, GSAP animation count targeting it) and snippets (source id file:start-end, kind: html opening tag / matched CSS candidate / animation creation, exact code). Only GSAP animations seen (not CSS/WAPI/canvas). Selector matching multiple elements → inspection failure.
how: When review.py detects visual anomalies, run `hyperframes check` with inspect capability on that composition. Parse finding.inspect.snippets to pinpoint offending HTML/CSS/GSAP code. Feed into brain.jsonl as lessons for compose_lab.py patterns.

title: 4K supersampling via --resolution 4k flag
text: Render existing 1920×1080 compositions at 3840×2160 by adding `--resolution 4k` (or portrait-4k/square-4k). HTML text, SVG, CSS shapes, gradients re-rasterize at 4K; canvas/WebGL limited by intrinsic dimensions. 4× pixels → more render time/memory, use `--quality draft` for review.
how: Add `--resolution 4k` to render.py for final outputs; keep 1080p for draft. Ensure lab look assets (charts, kinetic titles, stat counters) use vector/SVG sources. Verify with ffprobe.

title: Share editable project files with Telegram approvals
text: `hyperframes share --public --include-source` uploads authored HTML, scripts, styles, assets, Studio edit metadata to a review page (excludes .env, node_modules, .git, render outputs). Recipients can inspect/edit source. Use `--video-only` to omit source. Portable project policy blocks credentials; `.hyperframesignore` excludes scratch files.
how: Modify publish.py: after render, run `hyperframes share --include-source` for Telegram approval (Studio360). Store share URL in approval message. On approval, use same share for multi-platform publish. Add `.hyperframesignore` for temp files.

title: Events NDJSON for pipeline observability and artifact tracking
text: Set HF_TOOL_CONTEXT.events.transport (ndjson-file path) to receive artifact.created events: frame (PNG), contact-sheet (JPEG grid), check-report (JSON), finding (crop). CLI appends one JSON/line; never creates parent dir; write failure warns but doesn't fail command. Multiple commands append to same file.
how: In doctor.py / render pipeline, set HF_TOOL_CONTEXT with events path per run. Parse events.ndjson to feed dashboard (stats.py) with render artifacts, check findings, frame counts. Auto-attach contact sheets to Telegram approvals.

title: Project lock to prevent concurrent browser renders
text: `hyperframes check` and `snapshot` take a file lock (.hyperframes/project.lock) before starting browser. HF_TOOL_CONTEXT project-lock.waitMs (e.g., 90000) makes a second command wait up to waitMs for lock, then fails naming holder. Lock from dead process is taken over; .project.lock.break from killed process requires manual delete.
how: Wrap render.py and preflight.py (which uses browser for stills) with HF_TOOL_CONTEXT project-lock.waitMs=120000. Set waitMs below doctor.py's 10-min cycle. On lock timeout, doctor.py can clean .project.lock.break and retry.

title: Determinism rules: no Math.random, Date.now, setInterval, repeat:-1 without finite root duration
text: Cloud renderer seeks frame-by-frame; non-deterministic animation fails. Banned: Math.random() (use seeded PRNG), Date.now()/performance.now() (use hard-coded timing or tl.time()), setInterval/setTimeout/requestAnimationFrame (use timeline tweens + onUpdate), repeat:-1 without finite root data-duration (use repeat: Math.max(0, Math.floor(duration/cycle)-1)), stagger:{from:"random"} (use "start"/"center"/"end"), async timeline construction (build synchronously at load).
how: Add a determinism lint in preflight.py: scan GSAP timeline code for banned patterns. In compose_lab.py, enforce synchronous timeline build and finite repeat counts derived from scene duration. Document in AGENTS.md for any human/agent editing animations.

title: Font anti-monoculture: banned fonts, dramatic weight contrast (300 vs 900), min sizes 60px/20px/16px
text: Banned fonts: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Noto Sans, Lato, Poppins, Outfit, Sora, Fraunces, Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, EB Garamond, Syne, Cinzel, Prata, Bodoni Moda, Nunito, Source Sans, PT Sans, Arimo. Banned pairings: Fraunces+JetBrains Mono, Inter+anything, Playfair+Lato. Require dramatic weight contrast (300 vs 900, not 400 vs 700). Minimum sizes: headlines 60px+, body 20px+, labels 16px+. Use font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums on number columns.
how: In thumb.py and compose_lab.py, replace any default font stacks with curated pairs (e.g., Space Grotesk 300/700 + JetBrains Mono). Add a font validator in preflight.py that flags banned fonts and checks min sizes. Store approved pairs in brain.jsonl for reuse across pages.

title: Mid-scene activity patterns catalog (counter, SVG draw, character stagger, breathing float, bar-chart fill)
text: Every visible element must keep moving after entrance. Required patterns per scene: counter animation (number 0→target via onUpdate), SVG stroke draw (strokeDashoffset 0), character stagger (per-char y/autoAlpha with stagger.each 0.12), breathing float (yoyo repeat 1, sine.inOut), bar-chart fill (scaleY 0→1 staggered 0.15s). At least 2 patterns per scene; scenes >4s need continuous motion.
how: Add a pattern library in compose_lab.py: register reusable GSAP snippets for each pattern. In plan.py, tag each scene element with its mid-scene pattern. During render, compose_lab.py applies the pattern tweens after entrance tweens. Use the exact code from Section 8 of the guide.

title: Open-Weight Model Alternatives
text: DeepSeek V4 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Max are now ranked as top-tier models for writing HyperFrames code, often matching Claude/Gemini performance for video-specific tasks.
how: Update 'scout.py' to track these models. If Gemini free credits are exhausted, we can switch our 'plan.py' and 'research.py' logic to DeepSeek V4 via Ollama or a local API to maintain zero-cost operations.

title: HDR 10-bit Render Path
text: Render in BT.2020 PQ or HLG using 10-bit H.265. HyperFrames automatically detects HDR media and composites SDR DOM layers (text/captions) into the HDR space without losing brightness metadata.
how: Add an '--hdr' flag to our render command in 'doctor.py'. This allows us to produce high-dynamic-range tech shorts that stand out on mobile screens supporting high peak brightness.

title: Non-Destructive Media Treatments
text: Apply 'data-color-grading' attributes for effects like ASCII, Halftone, and Tape Damage. These are applied at render time via shaders, meaning the original source files (from Muse/Cloudflare) remain untouched.
how: Expand our 'lab look' in 'compose_lab.py' to include a 'treatment' variable. The agent can now choose 'halftone' for a print look or 'crt' for a retro-tech vibe by just adding a JSON string to the video tag.

title: Figma-to-Code Asset Bridge
text: Use 'hyperframes figma asset' to pull logos and vectors directly from Figma URLs. It handles auto-rasterization of complex vectors and maintains idempotency via a manifest, ensuring assets only update when the design changes.
how: Integrate the Figma CLI into our 'research.py' phase. If a client provides a Figma link, we can automatically pull brand-accurate SVGs instead of relying on AI-generated approximations.

title: Deterministic Frame Source Registry
text: Register non-GSAP animation (like custom Canvas or Three.js draws) using 'window.__hyperframes.registerFrameSource'. This ensures that even complex procedural code stays perfectly synced with the global timeline during seeks.
how: Use this in 'compose_lab.py' for our background particle systems and flow charts. It replaces manual 'onUpdate' loops with a cleaner, seek-safe rendering contract.

title: Per-Word Media Effects
text: The source suggests using 'data-color-grading' on media, but the same logic applies to text layers. We can use the 'Halftone' or 'ASCII' treatments on our 3-word captions to match the 'lab' aesthetic.
how: Update 'compose_lab.py' to apply subtle 'chromatic-aberration' or 'grain' filters directly to caption containers using the 'effects' schema.

title: Product launch video from live site
text: Give a product URL; agent captures real screens, palette, fonts, and builds a launch video: hook (problem) → 3 feature beats with UI captures + 1-line captions → end card (logo + CTA). Can also do 20s vertical teaser (9:16) or site tour. Uses captured brand tokens, not invented colors.
how: Add a launch_video.py that takes a URL, runs the capture workflow, and emits a HyperFrames project. Integrate with sponsor intake: when a sponsor provides a URL, auto-generate draft for approval.

title: Path-traced 3D for lab-look hero shots
text: Use the path-traced-3d example (Three.js + three-gpu-pathtracer) to render 3D scenes with real global illumination, soft shadows, and reflections. Preview in raster (ms/frame), export with `--variables '{"renderer":"path","samples":64}'`. Deterministic via seeded RNG and frozen clock during render.
how: Add a new compose_3d.py that scaffolds a HyperFrames project from the path-traced-3d template, drives camera/object animation via poseAt(t), and renders via CLI. Use for Kaise Tech GPU/benchmark explainers.

title: Local background removal (free, no API)
text: Run `npx hyperframes remove-background subject.mp4 -o subject.webm --background-output plate.webm` on Apple Silicon (macOS 14+) or Intel (macOS 13.3+). Outputs transparent WebM for HyperFrames and a background plate with person-shaped hole. Stack: plate → text/graphics → cutout. Model optimized for people, not held objects.
how: Add a bg_remove.py wrapper used by compose.py when a scene needs titles behind a presenter. Cache cutouts by source hash. Fallback to cloud (HeyGen) only if local fails.

title: Transparent overlay rendering (WebM/MOV)
text: Render transparent VP9 WebM (`--format webm`) for browser overlays (lower thirds, subscribe cards, logo stings) or ProRes 4444 MOV (`--format mov --prores-profile 4444`) for NLE handoff. Composition must leave html/body background unpainted. Verify alpha with `ffmpeg -c:v libvpx-vp9 -i overlay.webm -frames:v 1 -pix_fmt rgba frame.png`.
how: Add overlay.py that renders a standalone composition (lower third, CTA card) as transparent WebM. Use in publish.py to burn overlays onto main video via FFmpeg filter_complex, or deliver separately for Instagram Reels remix.

title: Video Wrapper Animation Rule
text: Never animate 'width', 'height', 'top', or 'left' directly on a <video> element as it can cause the video to freeze. Always wrap the video in a <div> and animate the wrapper's dimensions/position instead.
how: Update `compose.py` and `compose_lab.py` templates to ensure all video assets are injected inside a styled wrapper div before applying GSAP transitions.

title: Timed Visibility (class='clip')
text: All elements using `data-start` and `data-duration` attributes must also have `class='clip'` to ensure they are hidden when outside their active time range.
how: Add a check in `preflight.py` to audit the HTML for any element with `data-start` that lacks the 'clip' class.

title: Native Audio Looping
text: Use the native `loop` attribute and `data-duration` on <audio> elements to repeat short music tracks for the length of a scene without manual concatenation.
how: In `plan.py`, if a background track is shorter than the scene, instruct the HTML generator to add the `loop` attribute to the audio tag.

title: Network Restriction Security
text: Set `PRODUCER_RESTRICT_PAGE_NETWORK=true` in render environments. This prevents the render browser from reaching private/internal IP addresses, allowing only project files and public internet assets.
how: Add this environment variable to our Cloudflare/server render environment to harden the studio against malicious script injection in user-generated content.

title: Render Wait Optimization (data-no-timeline)
text: Add the `data-no-timeline` attribute to composition roots that do not use GSAP. This bypasses a default 45-second poll/timeout for a registered timeline, significantly speeding up renders for static or CSS-only scenes.
how: Modify the composition generator to detect if the `animations` object is empty; if so, append `data-no-timeline` to the root <div>.

title: WebMCP Agent Tools
text: Enable WebMCP tools (`studio_look`, `studio_inspect`, `studio_frame`) to allow an AI agent to inspect and edit the composition live in a browser environment. This allows for 'verified' edits where the agent sees the result of its change.
how: Expose the `document.modelContext` in our preview environment so Gemini can use tools to fix layout issues identified during `review.py` vision checks.

title: Output Dimension Guard
text: Set `expectedOutputDimensions` in the render job config. The producer will fail the job with `OUTPUT_DIMENSIONS_MISMATCH` if the compiled composition doesn't match the target resolution, preventing wasted render time.
how: In `compose.py`, pass the target resolution (e.g., 1080x1920) into the render job configuration to ensure strict adherence.

title: Reference Background Detection
text: Capture the `reference_background` metadata (solid RGB, none, or unknown) from the render result. This confirms the 'Lab Look' (black background) is correctly applied before publishing.
how: Update `review.py` to check the render metadata for `{"reference_background":{"kind":"solid","rgb":[0,0,0]}}` for Kaise Tech videos.

title: Persistent Timeline 'Wire'
text: A visual device where a single continuous line (the 'wire') threads the entire film. It morphs from a code underline to a chart baseline, a map route, and a 3D coil, providing a 'spine' for the video.
how: In mythology and tech stories, use a constant SVG path in the background. Instruct compose.py to anchor all props (icons, cards, charts) to this path's coordinates to create a unified journey.

title: Automatic HEVC Media Proxying
text: A system to prepare browser-compatible preview versions of HEVC/H.265 video files. Ensures that high-quality clips from Muse/image-to-video don't show as black frames in the Studio/browser preview while still rendering correctly in FFmpeg.
how: Add a pre-processing step in research.py or scout.py that uses FFmpeg to generate a low-bitrate H.264 proxy for any HEVC assets. Update compose.py to use the proxy for preview and the original for render.

title: SDK Headless Editing Layer
text: The @hyperframes/sdk allows agents to inspect and edit composition HTML via JSON patches and typed methods (setText, setStyle, setTiming) without a browser UI. Supports undo/redo and persistence adapters.
how: Refactor doctor.py and review.py to use the SDK for 'self-repair'. Instead of re-writing whole files, the AI can dispatch specific 'setStyle' or 'setTiming' patches to fix layout overlaps or voice-sync issues.

title: Local GSAP Mirroring
text: The studio-server can mirror GSAP and its plugins locally (HYPERFRAMES_GSAP_BASE_URL). This prevents external CDN downtime from failing our automated render jobs.
how: Download GSAP 3.15.0+ and plugins to our server's /vendor/npm/ directory. Set the environment variable in our Dockerfile/runner to ensure all renders use local assets.

title: Matte separation for subject/background grading
text: Grade the room while protecting the face: use the original clip as background plate (not a subject-removed plate) and a clean cutout layer. If the cutout ships premultiplied alpha, rebuild with ffmpeg alphamerge from original + matte to avoid black outlines. The subject gets only gentle skin-softening + 1/3 stop exposure; the background gets halftone screen + bloom ramped from zero.
how: In compose_lab.py's media treatment, add a 'matteGrade' mode that splits a talking-head clip into two layers with this exact structure. Use for Kaise Tech host segments to keep the presenter photographic while the lab background degrades.

title: Two-ink press look for archival/mythology style
text: Collapse the entire frame to two explicit hex colors (e.g., near-black navy #0a1220 and warm cream #f4efe6) at mid dot size. Ramp from untouched to two-ink over 4s. Dense small type is the harshest test — if it survives the dot screen it reads as print, if it muddies it fails. Payload takes explicit hex array; named palettes are rejected.
how: Add a 'twoInk' preset in compose_lab.py for Puraan Ki Katha: define brand hex pair in frame.md, apply as a grade on archival artwork slides. Test with Devanagari caption density to ensure legibility.

title: Analogue degradation as three distinct recipes
text: Tape = rolling horizontal wave (tapeTracking + tapeDamage), noise, scanlines, chroma bleed. Tube = barrel curvature, scanlines, phosphor bleed, chromatic aberration, crushed shadows, lifted highlights, bloom, grain, vignette. Camera = crushed shadows/blacks, lifted highlights/whites, muted saturation, restrained bloom, film grain, vignette, static interlacing, subtle RGB split (chromatic aberration). Mixing them muddles the period; pick one.
how: Create three reusable grade presets in compose_lab.py: 'tape', 'crt', 'camcorder'. Use 'crt' for Kaise Tech 'lab monitor' establishing shots; 'camcorder' for Puraan Ki Katha 'found footage' beats. Ensure preflight validates only one analogue family per scene.

title: Absolute-target iteration protocol
text: Relative corrections oscillate ("2x finer" → too fine → "a bit bigger" → too big). State targets as absolute values: "dot radius = 25% of row spacing, clear gaps between dots" or "glow at ~35% peak opacity, always subtler than orb". Freeze settled axes explicitly: "framing and motion are right — don't touch; only change dot size."
how: Add to review.py feedback loop: when human/auto review requests changes, require absolute targets in the correction prompt. In doctor.py, log which axes were frozen vs changed per iteration. Update Telegram approval flow to show absolute-target template.

title: Audio groups for narration clips
text: Group all narration clips into one `<hf-audio-group id="voiceover">` so carve, EQ, and dynamics apply to the whole bus. A carve pointed at a group picks up new clips automatically; pointed at individual clips it misses the sixth clip added later. Also gives one fader/mute for the whole VO.
how: In plan.py, assign all TTS segments to a single audio group ID. In compose.py, wrap narration `<audio>` elements with data-audio-group="voiceover". In mix.py, target carve and voice-clean preset at the group, not individual clips. Update review.py to verify group membership.

title: Color groups for multi-clip grading consistency
text: Grade a whole camera lane (e.g., talking head cuts) once via `<hf-color-group id="tamer-cam" data-color-grading='{"preset":"skin-soft","intensity":0.7}'>` and point each clip with data-color-group="tamer-cam". Clip's own data-color-grading overrides group for exceptions. Groups don't nest; membership held by member.
how: In plan.py, assign color_group_id per scene for multi-clip sequences. In compose.py, emit <hf-color-group> and data-color-group on clips. In mix.py/color grading step, apply preset to group. Preflight verifies all clips in group share grade unless overridden.

title: Master bus truepeak limiter for delivery compliance
text: Add truepeak limiter on composition root (master bus) with ceiling -1.5 dBTP, lookahead 3ms, release 80ms. Runs once over sum of all clips/groups after their chains. Render fails whole mix if master chain unreadable. Export keeps file under -1 dBTP; if peak still over, lowers whole mix and prints audio_lowered warning.
how: In compose.py, inject data-fx-chain on root div with truepeak node. In mix.py, verify master chain before render. In review.py, add loudness/truepeak check on rendered audio. Doctor.py validates master chain JSON syntax.

title: Linked clips for grouped timing
text: Clips sharing a `data-link` value are edited as a single unit in the browser editor; they must have identical `data-start`, `data-duration`, `data-media-start`, `data-playback-rate`. Lint rule `linked_clips_out_of_sync` warns if they drift.
how: When compose.py creates multi-clip sequences that must stay locked (e.g. video+audio pair, or multi-angle cuts), assign the same `data-link` UUID and ensure timing attributes are copied identically.

title: Speed ramps for beat-synced cuts
text: A `rate` lane in `data-automation` lets you curve clip playback speed (0.1–10×) per clip with log-scale interpolation; pitch is preserved. Points use clip-relative time `t` and multiplier `v`. Preview and render share the same `sourceTimeAt` function so frames match exactly.
how: Add a `rate` lane generator to compose_lab.py that aligns speed changes to beat timestamps from the music bed; write the lane into the clip's `data-automation` JSON before render.

title: Embedded override mode for series templates
text: Open a base composition with a sparse `OverrideSet` delta (text, attr, style, variable values, added/removed elements). Edits accumulate into the same delta; `getOverrides()` returns the updated set for storage. Sub-composition elements use scoped IDs (`host/leaf`). Font/image variables are objects with `name/source` or `url/alt/fit`.
how: Create a `series_template.py` that stores base HTML + override JSON per series/character; at render time, call `openComposition(baseHtml, {overrides: storedDelta})` via a Node helper or embed the logic in compose.py.

title: Project-level asset validation in doctor
text: Lint rules `missing_local_asset`, `duplicate_audio_track`, `texture_mask_asset_not_found`, `audio_src_not_found`, `inaccessible_media_url` (async) verify every referenced file exists, remote URLs return 2xx, and no two audible clips overlap on the same track index.
how: Add a `validate_assets()` function in doctor.py that runs the project lint checks (via `@hyperframes/lint` package) and the async `lintMediaUrls()`; alert on Telegram if any missing/duplicate media found.

title: Media treatment capabilities query
text: Run `npx hyperframes media-treatment --capabilities --json` to get the current preset/effect/color-space surface instead of hard-coding. The output includes all supported keys, ranges, and defaults for `data-color-grading`.
how: Add a startup step in the render worker that caches the capabilities JSON; compose.py reads it to validate any grading preset/effect before writing `data-color-grading`.

title: Structured element queries
text: find({tag, text, name, track, composition}) returns scopedIds ("hf-HOST/hf-LEAF" for nested) with AND logic; replaces manual DOM filtering in compose scripts.
how: Use in compose.py/compose_lab.py to select elements by data-name, track, or sub-composition instead of custom selectors.

title: Timing API with live GSAP labels
text: getElementTimings() returns {enterAt, exitAt, labels[]} parsed fresh from GSAP script each call; setElementTiming(map) batches sparse updates.
how: Use in review.py for alignment checks: verify enterAt/exitAt match script labels; batch timing fixes in one atomic op.

title: Atomic batch edits
text: batch(() => { setText(); setStyle(); setTiming(); }) coalesces into one undo entry, one persist write, one patch event; throws roll back all mutations.
how: Wrap multi-step scene builds in compose.py (e.g., title+style+timing) so doctor.py sees atomic changes and retries are cleaner.

title: Elastic hold API
text: setHold(id, {start, end, fill: "freeze"|"loop"}) freezes or loops a timeline window without changing clip duration; formalizes true holds.
how: Add to compose_lab.py for static frames between animated segments (e.g., stat counter pause) instead of manual duration hacks.

title: GSAP tween CRUD via SDK
text: addGsapTween/setGsapTween/removeGsapTween with typed GsapTweenSpec (method, position, duration, ease, properties, stagger, repeat, yoyo) returns animationId.
how: Replace direct GSAP timeline manipulation in animation code; use typed spec for chart draws, counter bursts, panel reveals.

title: Keyframe animation helpers
text: addWithKeyframes(selector, pos, dur, [{percentage, properties, ease}]) and replaceWithKeyframes(oldId, ...) for CSS-keyframe tweens; position in seconds only.
how: Use for precise bar-chart fills, number counter pops, logo stings where per-keyframe eases matter; replace raw @keyframes authoring.

title: Filesystem persistence with versioning
text: createFsAdapter({root, maxVersions: 20}) writes on every mutation, keeps rolling snapshots with timestamp-counter keys; flush() drains queue before exit.
how: Replace manual asset manifest in preflight.py; auto-save composition HTML per render job with 20-version history for audit/recovery.

title: Dry-run validation with can()
text: comp.can(op) returns {ok: true} or {ok: false, code: E_TARGET_NOT_FOUND|E_NO_GSAP_TIMELINE|...} without mutating; gate before dispatch.
how: Add to preflight.py: validate all setTiming/addGsapTween ops before render; catch missing timelines or bad targets early.

title: Headless adapter for CI renders
text: createHeadlessAdapter() returns no-op PreviewAdapter (elementAtPoint→null, isProvablyEmptyAt→false); use when no preview surface needed.
how: Pass to openComposition in doctor.py and render workers for pure headless editing sessions without iframe overhead.

title: Element handles for curried mutations
text: comp.element(id) returns handle with setText/setStyle/setTiming/setAttribute/removeElement; holds only ID string, no stale DOM refs.
how: Refactor compose.py: const title = comp.element("hf-title"); title.setText(...).setStyle(...).setTiming(...) for cleaner multi-prop edits.

title: Brand kit structure with roles and rules
text: Brand kit defines colors with semantic roles (Main, Secondary, Accent, Text, Background, Neutral), logos (Main leads titles/end cards), text styles, files, and plain-language rules. Agent reads kit per message; files copied to project assets/brand-kit for portability.
how: Extend knowledge/brain.jsonl with brand_kits per page (Kaise Tech, Puraan Ki Katha, Aage Suno); add role-based color variables; store logos/files in assets/brand-kit; inject rules into plan.py prompt.

title: 91 caption styles library with word-level editing
text: Studio app offers 91 caption styles; editor supports word-level drag/resize/rotate, color/opacity/font-size/weight/family per word, saved to caption-overrides.json. Styles live in Catalog under Captions category.
how: Browse HyperFrames Catalog caption components; port top 10 styles (karaoke, highlight, typewriter, bounce) to our caption system; add word-level override JSON to our render pipeline for per-word effects.

title: CompositionVariable with FontValue/ImageValue objects
text: FontVariable holds {name, source} (Google Fonts CSS URL); ImageVariable holds {url, alt, fit: cover|contain|fill|none|scale-down}. Variables store full objects, not raw strings — preserves metadata through overrides and reopens.
how: Update our variable system: font variables store {name, source} for @font-face injection; image variables store {url, alt, fit} for object-fit CSS. Ensures cross-platform font parity and responsive image behavior.

title: PatchEvent with inverse patches for rollback
text: PatchEvent emits forward + inverse JsonPatchOps (add/remove/replace) per commit. Inverse patches enable instant undo. ORIGIN_APPLY_PATCHES sentinel prevents loops when mirroring. Format versioned for compatibility.
how: In review.py, after render, capture PatchEvent from compose mutations; store inverse patches. If vision review fails, apply inverse patches to revert HTML to pre-render state before rewrite. Adds safety net.

title: Voice correction preset library
text: Named presets map symptoms to chains: rumble-cut (HP 80 Hz), Tame Boominess, Reduce Mud, Add Clarity, Soften Harshness, Even Out Levels (compressor Evenness), room-gate, voice-clean (rumble + mud cut + leveling + clarity + peak ceiling), voice-broadcast (denser), voice-warm (adds body). Presets append; re-applying replaces their own nodes. Expand preset to see nodes and avoid double-cutting (e.g., voice-clean already includes mud reduction).
how: Add a voice_preset.py module that selects a preset based on TTS quality flags (boomy, muffled, harsh, uneven). Apply after Gemini TTS in the voice gate step. Store preset chains as reusable HyperFrames audio effect racks. Log which preset was used per clip for debugging.

title: Even Out Levels for drifting narration
text: Even Out Levels measures the track's own speaking passages and writes a gain envelope targeting that track's 80th percentile — an already-even track is left alone. Use for passage-level drift across a take; use compressor Evenness for word-to-word dynamics. Remove levelling reverts it.
how: In voice gate (after TTS), run Even Out Levels on each narration clip if RMS variance across scenes > 6 dB. Store the generated envelope as an automation lane. Add a review.py check: narration loudness per scene within ±2 LU of target.

title: Catalog showcase layouts: film rows, remix shelves, versus grids
text: Three proven patterns: .hf-film-rows (dual opposing infinite tracks, drag-to-scroll, mask-image fade edges), .hf-remix-shelf (CSS columns 2-3, break-inside:avoid for masonry), .hf-versus (2-col comparison). All responsive to 1-col <640px. Film cards have gradient label overlay, focus-visible ring, dialog fullscreen.
how: Add three new block types to our catalog: film-rows (for series episode shelves), remix-shelf (for UGC/community showcases), versus (A/B hook comparisons). Implement in compose_lab.py with GSAP drag scroll for film-rows. Use for Kaise Tech series page and A/B thumbnail tests.

title: Structured catalog taxonomy with tags and nested groups
text: docs.json catalog nav uses hierarchical groups with 'tag' counts (e.g., 'Text & captions' tag 74 → Captions 17, Typography 45, Lower Thirds 12). Each leaf is a block path. Tags enable filtering and 'expanded' state. Redirects map legacy URLs permanently.
how: Enhance our brain.jsonl catalog index: add 'tag_count' and 'parent_group' fields to each block entry. Build a CLI filter (catalog-search.py) by tag (e.g., 'caption', '3d', 'transition'). Use tag counts to surface popular categories in ideas.py freshness scoring.

title: Portrait video constraint pattern for 9:16 shorts
text: .hf-portrait-video and .hf-docs-video-block[data-portrait] constrain width to min(100%, 18rem) and height to min(32rem, 68vh) with aspect-ratio 9/16. Centered via margin auto. Landscape blocks stay full-width. Prevents portrait clips from dominating desktop layout.
how: In thumb.py and compose_lab.py, add portrait-mode flag: when rendering 9:16, apply max-width: 18rem; max-height: 68vh; aspect-ratio: 9/16 to preview embeds. Ensures Telegram approval cards and dashboard previews don't overflow on mobile.

title: Redirect map for legacy URL permanence
text: docs.json redirects: 60+ entries with 'permanent: true' for SEO. Maps old guide paths (/guides/prompting → /prompting/overview, /studio/tour → /studio). Single source of truth for documentation moves.
how: Create redirects.json for our studio site (hyperframes.studio) and any landing pages. Add to publish.py: when deploying, inject _redirects file for Netlify/Cloudflare Pages. Track in brain.jsonl so doctor.py can verify no broken links after restructure.

title: Semantic variable portrays for asset auto-selection
text: CSS shows --hf-video-accent, --hf-brand, --hf-chip, --hf-glass used consistently across components. Dark/light modes swap entire palette via :root/.dark.
