Variables namespaced --hf- to avoid Mintlify collisions. Portrays concept: variable 'portrays' asset type (e.g., --hf-video-accent portrays 'accent-on-dark').
how: Formalize our variable system's 'portrays' field (already in brain): each CompositionVariable.portrays ∈ {accent-on-dark, surface-on-paper, glass-overlay, chip-bg, border-hairline}. Update compose_lab.py to auto-pick correct token by portray. Prevents hardcoded color mismatches in dark mode.

title: Dynamic docs menu labeling via MutationObserver
text: docs-menu-label.js watches sidebar for first-page anchor to detect current section (Studio app / Developers / Make a video), then rewrites the navbar button's text node in-place (React-preserving). Runs on every page change via MutationObserver + rAF debounce. Zero config beyond SECTIONS array.
how: Adapt for our dashboard (dashboard.html): observe #sidebar-content for active nav item, update top-bar breadcrumb label ('Ideas → Script → Visuals → Review') without React re-render. Add to doctor.py health check to verify label matches route.

title: Focus-visible rings using brand accent for accessibility
text: All interactive elements (copy buttons, film cards, video controls, nav tabs) use outline: 2px solid var(--hf-brand); outline-offset: -6px; border-radius: 14px on :focus-visible. Brand is #3ce6ac (dark) / oklch(0.45 0.096 164) (light). Meets WCAG 2.4.7.
how: Add a global focus-visible.css to HyperFrames base: *:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hf-brand); outline-offset: -4px; border-radius: 8px; }. Apply to all blocks via compose.py base template. Test with doctor.py accessibility audit.

title: Code block copy button with 44px touch target and plate hover
text: .code-block [data-testid=copy-code-button] uses ::before plate (26px) inside 44x44px target, margin -9px to keep layout. Hover/focus states transition background-color and icon color in 100ms. Copied state shows brand-green check via [data-copied=true]. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
how: Copy this exact pattern for our 'copy prompt' and 'copy script' buttons in dashboard and Telegram approvals. Use data-testid for E2E tests. Add to compose_lab.py code-snippet block. Ensures 44px touch target on mobile approval flow.

title: Ranked List Re-Rank Animation (1:1)
text: Three competitor rows enter, then step down by one slot (y: +142px) when brand slides in from right (x: 96→0). Rank numbers stay fixed to slots. Pushed-out row fades via mask gradient (408→448px). Brand row gets accent border, accent tile fill, and checkmark stroke-dashoffset draw. Typing uses KEY_GAPS with squeeze factor to fit duration. 1080×1080, 9s.
how: Create compose_rank.py block. Variables: prompt, lead, rowA-C, brand, brandRank (enum 1-3), accent, ink, ground. Use portrays for competitor_name/subject_name. Integrate with scout.py playbook for 'top 3 tools' videos. Mask gradient technique reusable for any list push-out.

title: CONFIG object pattern for block parameters
text: Beat-freeze-cut places all editable values (beat times, labels, intensity) in a top-level CONFIG object, separating configuration from timeline logic for easy tweaking without code hunting.
how: Adopt in block authoring guide (AGENTS.md) and compose_lab.py variable defaults; enforce CONFIG at top of each block script.

title: UI panel state machine for AI interactions
text: Four panel states (empty, full, thinking, result) crossfade with scale/position shifts; shows AI interaction flow: placeholder → user prompt → thinking animation → result with action button.
how: Build in compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech AI demo shorts; trigger state changes from script tokens in plan.py.

title: Font-gate fallback for imported blocks
text: The catalog ships a font-gate fallback: when the runtime has no web-font gate, scripts tagged text/hf-after-fonts are replaced with executable scripts after fonts resolve — inline scripts first, then deferred/module ones — and a console warning is emitted. This stops composition scripts from measuring text before the real font is ready.
how: Add the same shim to our HyperFrames template as a shared JS include so any block copied from the catalog runs after fonts; keep our existing fonts-ready gate as the primary path and surface the warning in preflight output.

title: Quintic Hermite Handoff
text: Use Quintic Hermite interpolation to transition between procedural motion and idle states. By calculating position, velocity, and acceleration at the handoff point, you can achieve seamless, physically plausible transitions without visible snapping.
how: Add a Quintic Hermite solver to our GSAP helper library for complex motion handoffs between active and idle states.

title: Deterministic Transform Serialization with Fixed Precision
text: Render loop writes transform string with toFixed(2) for translate, toFixed(3) for rotate, toFixed(5) for scale. Opacity clamped 0-1. Guarantees identical string output across renders for caching and diffing.
how: Enforce in our HyperFrames Python renderer: format all CSS transforms with fixed decimals; add to preflight.py layout audit.

title: Keyframe flags for linear/ease detection
text: Flags string (e.g., '02020000') and check for '0101' prefix to distinguish linear vs eased segments without extra fields.
how: Adopt in plan.py/keyframe schema: store flags per keyframe; use in aeCurve to choose linear or cubic Bezier.

title: Word spacing for kinetic typography
text: Use consistent word gap (margin-left: 0.26em) and per-word overflow hidden for clean stagger animations.
how: Add .word + .word { margin-left: 0.26em; } to lab CSS; ensure kinetic title blocks use this spacing.

title: Jitter factor for z-fighting avoidance
text: Apply a tiny per-card scale jitter (1 + (index % 2) * 0.01) in orbit rig to prevent z-fighting when cards occupy similar depths.
how: In compose_lab.py's orbit rig, multiply card scale by jitter factor before transform; add as optional variable.

title: Parent coordinate system for nested rigs
text: Path rig supports a parent transform (anchor, position, rotation) so carousels can be nested inside other 3D groups.
how: Extend pathRig in compose_lab.py to accept parent object; apply rotation/translation hierarchy before camera projection.

title: Y-angle 3D tilt with mirror
text: Add perspective tilt (rotationY) based on horizontal distance from center, with mirrorY to flip tilt on left side.
how: Add yAngle3d and mirrorY controls to orbit rig; apply in pose calculation before camera-facing rotation.

title: Binary search for path position lookup
text: Locate progress on path via binary search on cumulative length array (O(log n)) instead of linear scan.
how: Implement locate(pct) in path rig using bisect on precomputed cum lengths; use in compose_lab.py path follow.

title: Converge entry animation
text: Cards start at larger radius and converge to orbit positions over staggered duration with easing (power3.out).
how: Add ring.entry='converge' with from, stagger, duration, ease; apply convergeFactor in render loop for first seconds.

title: Auto-Detect Chained Drive Mode
text: If keyframe end value ≠ start value (|delta| > 1e-6) for Move Carousel or Rotation XYZ, use "accumulate" mode (cumulative cycles); else "pingpong". Removes manual mode config.
how: Port logic to our chained drive helper in motion utils; simplifies plan.py keyframe authoring for carousel loops.

title: Registry Variable Binding Pattern
text: Declare registry: {imageVars: ["image1"...], textVars: {line1, line2}, speedVar: "speed"} in composition JSON; runtime binds variables to data cards, text layers, and motion.speedScale automatically.
how: Adopt in our block schema (blocks/*.json) so plan.py can inject assets/text via variables without template string replacement; mirrors HyperFrames variable system.

title: Async Image Decode Before Render
text: await img.decode() after setting src ensures bitmap is ready; catches corrupt/failed AI-generated images (Muse/FLUX) before they hit the render pipeline.
how: Add decode step in compose.py/compose_lab.py image loading; on failure, swap to placeholder and log warning for doctor.py to flag.

title: Deterministic 3D Camera Projection
text: The source demonstrates calculating 3D camera-facing rotation (yaw/pitch) using atan2 and camera distance, ensuring elements always face the viewer even when moving along complex paths.
how: Apply this projection logic when building 3D-carousel or orbit-style blocks to ensure consistent element orientation without relying on complex CSS preserve-3d nesting.

title: Depth-based visibility culling for 3D cards
text: In orbitRig, behindCam = z ≤ camZ × 0.92 (camera at -camZ). Culled cards get visible=false → opacity 0 in render(). Path rig uses endFade on open paths: alpha ×= min(pct, 1-pct)/endFade. Both prevent rendering off-screen/behind-camera geometry.
how: In carousel_rig.py render(), add behind-camera check for 3D families. In compose_lab.py, pass cameraDistance to rig. Reduces GPU overdraw in 3D carousels with many cards; essential for 12+ item orbits on mobile GPUs.

title: Predictive text row swaps at word boundaries
text: Three predictive suggestions (start/mid/end) swap via autoAlpha crossfade (0.06s out, 0.08s in) triggered at specific char indices (e.g., after ' ai ', at last char). Adds realism to typing without extra complexity.
how: In plan.py typing scene, add predict_stages variable (array of 3 strings per column). At charT indices matching word boundaries, schedule crossfade. Use existing GSAP timeline. No new code, just planner logic.

title: State proxy pattern for canvas/WebGL render
text: GSAP animates plain object {t: 0} → {t: DUR}. onUpdate reads st.t, calls renderScene(). No requestAnimationFrame. Render is pure function of time. Works for cinemagraph (steam) and shader transitions (progress).
how: Adopt in doctor.py for any canvas/WebGL block: define state proxy, animate with ease:'none', onUpdate=render. Ensures deterministic frame-at-time. Document in AGENTS.md for block authors.

title: Bubble flight from composer to thread slot
text: User bubble born at composer text position (keyboard-up), flies to thread slot (dy = 526.7 - 48 + 10 - bubbleTop) with scale 0.94→1, power3.out 0.34s. Transform-origin 100% 50% for right-aligned exit.
how: Add bubble_flight() in compose_lab.py for message-thread template (Aage Suno). Compute dy from layout anchors (preflight.py measures). Use existing GSAP fromTo. Portrays: 'user_bubble', 'thread_slot'.

title: Citation chips inline in streaming text
text: Render citation markers (e.g., {HeyGen}) as styled inline chips with rounded bg, small font, distinct color during word-by-word reveal. Chips are tokenized like words but get a cite class and no bold styling.
how: In compose_lab.py, extend the word-split loop to detect {...} tokens, wrap in <span class='cite'>, and add CSS for chip styling. Reuse existing per-word GSAP stagger.

title: Visual keyboard simulation with key press highlights
text: Draw an iOS-style keyboard (3 rows + bottom bar) as positioned divs. On each typed character, flash the corresponding key (bg #5f5f5f → #404040) using a seeded key-index map. Spacebar maps to wide key.
how: Add keyboard.html partial to lab look. In plan.py, when script includes a typing scene, emit keyboard markup and GSAP key-flash timeline synced to TTS char timestamps.

title: WebGL resource cleanup on teardown
text: Register beforeunload handler that traverses scene: dispose geometries, materials, textures (including map and uniform textures), then renderer.dispose(). Prevents GPU memory leaks in long-running Studio sessions.
how: Add disposeGL() to doctor.py's cleanup routine and to each Three.js block's bootstrap. Call on job completion and beforeunload. Mirrors HyperFrames pattern.

title: Multi-octave seeded noise field
text: Shader noise: n = noise(uv*16+seed)*0.6 + noise(uv*48+seed*1.7)*0.3 + noise(uv*120+seed*2.3)*0.1. Hash-based 2D noise (integer lattice + smoothstep interp). Seed from block config (×13.37). Creates organic, non-repeating dissolve edges without textures.
how: Copy noise() and hash() into our shader library. Use for any organic reveal/wipe (maps, data charts, scene transitions). Parameterize octaves/weights via uniforms for art direction.

title: Chromatic aberration dissolve fringe
text: At dissolve front: band = reveal*(1-reveal)*4; off = band*0.01; sample R at uv+(off,0), G at uv, B at uv-(off,0); glow = vec3(0.3,0.72,1.0)*band*0.9 added to color. Fringe peaks mid-transition, zero at start/end. Single pass, no post-process.
how: Add to dissolve shader and any threshold-wipe transitions (halftone, blob). Tune off multiplier (0.01) and glow color per brand. Gives high-end 'lab' feel cheaply.

title: Per-particle random delay stagger
text: Each particle gets aDelay ~ U(0,1) from seeded RNG. Vertex shader: p = clamp((uProgress - aDelay*(1-span))/span, 0,1); p = p*p*(3-2p) (smoothstep). span=0.62 means last particles start at 38% progress. No CPU stagger loop needed.
how: Adopt in our GPU particle blocks (aurora, blob, logo). Pass aDelay attribute, drive via single uProgress uniform. Simplifies timeline — one tween controls entire swarm.

title: Code scroll editor UI
text: Pure HTML/CSS VS Code–style editor: titlebar with traffic lights, gutter with line numbers, code surface with token-colored spans. Scroll-to-target-line (spec.line) with smooth power2.inOut, highlight box on target line, other lines dim to 0.35 opacity. 6s, 30px font, 46px line-height.
how: Add compose block 'code-scroll' for line-by-line explanations. Token data from Shiki bake. GSAP timeline drives scroll Y + highlight + dim. No WebGL — lighter weight for simple walkthroughs.

title: Spatial-hash shadow casting for instanced tiles
text: CodeSliceShadows uses a uniform grid (bucketSize ≈ tile width) to map casters/receivers into buckets, then only tests pairs within neighboring buckets. Each frame: rebuild buckets, iterate casters, query nearby receivers, compute analytic shadow quads, upload to single instance buffer, draw with polygonOffset for depth precision. O(n) instead of O(n²).
how: Add to compose_lab.py as a WebGL2 block for 3D card grids, particle fields, or HUD elements that need grounded shadows. Implement bucket hashing in JS, expose shadowStrength/shadowSoftness as composition variables.

title: Precomputed per-tile motion windows for render culling
text: Each tile stores motionStart/motionEnd (entry/exit of cursor influence + flip duration). At render time, tiles outside [motionStart, motionEnd] are skipped entirely (set to rest pose). EvaluatedTiles stat tracks actual work. Eliminates per-frame bounds checks for thousands of tiles.
how: In compose_lab.py grid/particle blocks, compute each element's active time window during build (using analytic cursor/field formulas). In render loop, early-continue for elements outside current time. Add renderStats for monitoring.

title: Chromatic aberration via per-channel refraction indices
text: Glass limb effect: refract view vector through sphere normal with three IORs (1.09, 1.13, 1.17) for R/G/B channels. Sample starfield at each refracted direction, combine with Fresnel term (pow(1-z, 1.8)). Produces realistic color fringing at sphere edge without post-process.
how: Add as an optional shader snippet in compose_shader.py for any spherical/glass object (AI orb, planet, lens). Control via variable "chromaticAberration" (0-1).

title: Variable precedence: CSS custom property → runtime bag → declared default
text: cosmic-orb reads variables in order: (1) CSS --var on root, (2) window.__hyperframes.getVariables(), (3) data-composition-variables default. Single source of truth in the HTML attribute; JS never duplicates defaults. Allows host page, runtime, or author to override without code changes.
how: Adopt this precedence in our variable system (compose_lab.py, variable resolver). Document in AGENTS.md. Ensure thumb.py and publish.py respect the same order.

title: Sub-composition readiness: register timeline only after fully built
text: The code-typing engine registers window.__timelines[id] = tl only inside fonts.ready, after all tweens are added. It then calls window.__hfForceTimelineRebind() to re-nest the child composition. This prevents the parent from nesting an empty timeline (which would never re-nest). The runtime treats "key present" as "ready".
how: Update our HyperFrames integration (compose_lab.py, render pipeline) to follow this pattern: build full paused timeline → register → call rebind. Add a test in doctor.py that verifies no composition registers an empty timeline.

title: Flash-through-white WebGL shader transition for dark backgrounds
text: Fragment shader crossfades two scene textures via white midpoint: fromScene brightens to white (0-0.45 progress), toScene emerges from white (0.55-1 progress). Smoothstep bands prevent hard edges. Scenes captured as textures via 2D canvas drawImage of HTML elements (including text rendering). Works where dip-to-black fails on dark bg.
how: Add to compose_lab.py as 'flash_white' transition block. Capture scene A/B via offscreen canvas (reuse html-in-canvas capture). Shader as string constant. Drive progress from GSAP timeline.

title: Flowchart Decision-Tree Block
text: A 12-second composition: root question node → two branch labels (Yes/Not sure) → four leaf nodes. Connectors draw via stroke-dashoffset (1000→0) over 0.4-0.5s. Nodes scale in with back.out(1.7) stagger (0.15s gap). Branch labels fade in at connector midpoints. Leaf nodes get selection-border highlight on cursor click, squiggly red underline on typo, per-character typing correction (50ms/char), and thumbs-up emoji pop (back.out(2), 0.15s). Ends with white fade overlay.
how: Add compose_flowchart.py using this HTML as template. Expose variables: rootQuestion, branchLabels[], leafNodes[] (text, color, position), typoIndex, correctionText. In plan.py, detect 'decision tree' topics and emit this block. Reuse existing SVG connector drawing (stroke-dashoffset) and node scale-in patterns.

title: Motion-blur shutter snippet (sub-frame seek)
text: A complete GSAP motion-blur system: on each frame it seeks the timeline to N sub-frame times across the shutter window (default 360°/16 samples), reads resolved transforms, and draws clones with mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter at 1/N opacity. Handles sharp/hide mode, per-composition fps, late-mounted compositions via polling, and nested target guards. Zero external deps.
how: Add the shutter snippet (from gooey-split) to compose_lab.py's HTML head. Tag any fast-moving lab element with data-hf-motion-blur='{"shutterAngle":360,"sharp":0}'. The snippet auto-attaches to the composition's timeline via __timelines proxy. Test on kinetic titles, counter rolls, panel slides.

title: Measured motion law from reference footage
text: heygen-avatar-promo-card: belt conveyor speed measured at 93.601 px/s constant leftward. Belt entry easing captured as 21 keyframe offsets (0 to -80px over 0.8s) from reference, replayed as 0.04s linear segments. Header waterfall timings measured (logo 0.0s, title 0.1s, subhead 0.5s). Eliminates guesswork for 'that feel'.
how: Add `motion_analyzer.py` to toolkit: given reference MP4, extract element trajectories via template matching, export keyframe tables. Use for replicating viral transition styles in scout.py playbook.

title: Highlight-sweep scalar for word-by-word karaoke
text: In hw-title: `mix = gsap.utils.interpolate(FAINT, FULL)`, scalar `st={p:0}` tweened over sweep window. On each hwOnUpdate tick: `k = st.p * wordCount`, each word gets `f = clamp(k - i, 0, 1)`, `color = mix(f)`. Cleaner than per-word timelines, coexists with boil on same dispatcher.
how: Add `sweep_highlight(words_el, faint_color, full_color, start, end)` helper to caption module. Use in lab-look kinetic titles and Hinglish word-emphasis captions.

title: Scribble overlay transition with solid backstop guarantee
text: 7 horizontal fat zigzag bands (stroke-width ~85% band height) stagger-draw in 0-0.85s alternating directions. At 0.8s solid color backstop snaps to opacity 1 (guarantees full coverage for host hard-cut at 0.9-1.4s). Bands stagger-draw out 1.42-1.92s opposite direction, backstop fades 1.42s. Hard-kill root at 2.17s (last visual frame, not duration).
how: Add `hw-scribble-transition` to transition library in compose_lab.py. Use for high-energy scene changes in Kaise Tech. Parameterize color, bands, duration.

title: Flowchart pipeline with wobbled boxes + tapered arrow connectors
text: hw-pipeline: N boxes (wobbleRect) centered horizontally, labels centered in each. Connectors: quadratic curves with seeded control-point jitter, arrowhead barbs aligned to curve tangent at end (`atan2(ey-qy, tx-qx)+PI`). Sequence: box draw (0.65s) → label fade (0.35s) → connector draw (0.45s) per step. All elements boil together.
how: Add for Kaise Tech 'how it works' sections. Parameterize nodes[], boxW/H, gap, y, fontSize. Use hw-runtime utilities.

title: ACES tone-mapping in transition shaders prevents highlight blowout
text: Shader applies ACES filmic curve to overexposed leak color before mixing with target scene. Formula: clamp((x*(2.51x+.03))/(x*(2.43x+.59)+.14),0,1). Keeps warm leak highlights controlled while preserving perceptual brightness. Critical for dark lab background where overexposure looks cheap.
how: Add ACES helper to our shader library (compose_lab.py). Apply to any additive transition (flash-burn, overexposure, light-leak). Document in brain.jsonl as 'ACES tone-mapping for transition highlights'.

title: Rounded-rect SDF with bevel height field for glass thickness
text: rrSDF(p, b, r) returns signed distance; bevelHeight(d, zR) = sqrt(d*(2*zR-d)) for d in [0,zR]. Surface normal derived from 5-point height sampling (center, ±2px X/Y) → N = normalize(-hGrad, 1). Depth = smoothstep(0, zR, inside). Enables refraction proportional to thickness, fresnel from |N.z|, specular from Blinn-Phong. zRadius (--lg-z-radius) controls bevel depth (default 40px).
how: Document in brain.jsonl as 'Glass Bevel SDF' for planner reference; use in future 3D glass morphing blocks.

title: Edge-weighted blur mix for performance/quality balance
text: Sharp texture (original background) and blur texture (6-pass 9-tap Gaussian) sampled simultaneously. edge = smoothstep(maxD*0.35, 0, inside). edgeMix = 1 - edge*0.15. Final color = mix(sharp, blur, edgeMix) — center stays sharp, edges blur. Blur radius = blurAmount * 2.5px per pass (6 passes = 15px max).
how: Implement in our WebGPU blur pipeline; add blurAmount CompositionVariable (0-1) mapped to --lg-blur.

title: Multi-light specular + fresnel + inner stroke for glass realism
text: 4 lights: L1(0.4,0.7,1) exp90, L2(-0.3,-0.5,1) exp50*0.3, L3(0.1,0.3,1) exp6*0.1 (diffuse-like), L4(0,0.9,0.4) exp120*0.6 (sharp highlight). Fresnel = pow(1-|N.z|,4)*fresnel. Inner stroke: smoothstep(-borderW-1,-borderW,sdf)*(1-smoothstep(-1,0,sdf)) biased toward top (0.4+0.6*topBias). Rim = edge*edgeHL*0.22, innerGlow = smoothstep(5,0,-sdf)*edgeHL*0.15. Env reflection = (N.y*0.5+0.5)*fresnel*0.08. Final mix with white at fresnel*0.2.
how: Bake these light directions/exponents as constants in our glass shader; expose specular, fresnel, edgeHighlight as CompositionVariables.

title: Shadow system for floating glass panels
text: Outer shadow: Gaussian falloff exp(-shadowD²/spread²)*0.65, contact shadow: exp(-shadowD*0.08/spread)*0.35. shadowD = max(sdfShadow-1,0) where sdfShadow uses same RR SDF offset by shadowOffsetY. Combined * shadowOpacity. Rendered only where sdf>0 (outside panel). spread = max(shadowSpread,1).
how: Add shadowOpacity, shadowSpread, shadowOffsetY as CompositionVariables; ensure preflight.py checks shadow clipping at canvas edges.

title: Device pixel ratio aware capture and transform parsing
text: _getElementPosition() reads getBoundingClientRect, computed styles (left/right/top/bottom/margin), parses CSS lengths (px, %, calc()), and transform (translate/translateX/translateY/translate3d). Returns {x,y,w,h} in CSS px. Render multiplies by devicePixelRatio for capture region. _captureRegion draws canvas subset to sceneCanvas at integer pixel bounds. Suppresses glass chrome (background, border, box-shadow, filter) during content draw.
how: Integrate into our HyperFrames render path for accurate DOM→texture capture; add to review.py vision check for transform mismatches.

title: WebGPU pipeline initialization with texture caching and fallback
text: GlassRendererGPU.init() requests adapter/device, creates 3 pipelines (blit, blur, glass) with bind group layouts, quad/panel vertex buffers, uniform buffers (16/16/112 bytes). Caches render targets per resolution (Map<string,{bg,blurA,blurB}>). uploadAndBlur() copies background via 2D canvas → externalImageToTexture, blits to bg target, blits to blurA, runs ping-pong blur passes if blurAmount>0. renderGlassPanel() writes 28-float uniform buffer, binds bg+blurA views, draws panel quad. Graceful degradation: logs warnings, returns false if WebGPU unavailable.
how: Wrap as HyperFrames SDK headless adapter; add to doctor.py for GPU health check. Ensure deterministic render: no Math.random in shaders (uses hash()), fixed 6 blur passes.

title: Catalog block metadata for HyperFrames composition registry
text: Root div has data-composition-id="liquid-glass-notification", data-start="0", data-duration="8", data-width="1920", data-height="1080". Glass canvas has layoutsubtree attribute. Window.__timelines["liquid-glass-notification"] = tl. This matches HyperFrames catalog registry pattern (CompositionVariables, Params, Dependencies, CDN Assets).
how: Adopt identical metadata attributes in our compose_lab.py output; register glass-notification block in our catalog with Variables (blurAmount, refraction, cornerRadius, etc.) and Dependencies (GSAP, Three.js, WebGPU polyfill).

title: CSS custom property → shader uniform mapping
text: A static map `_` links `--lg-blur`, `--lg-refraction`, `--lg-corner-radius`, etc. to JS config keys (blurAmount, refraction, cornerRadius). Panels declare variables inline; the renderer reads computed styles via `getPropertyValue`. Clean separation: design tweaks in CSS, engine reads numbers.
how: Adopt in compose_lab.py: define a `LAB_CSS_VAR_MAP` for panel props (blur, refraction, edgeHighlight, zRadius, bevelMode). Let plan.py write `--lg-*` vars on panel elements; preflight.py reads them for validation.

title: Accent rule draw via scaleX with transform-origin left
text: lt-accent-underline, lt-dark-card, lt-kicker-name, lt-mask-reveal (sweep), lt-side-rule all draw accent lines by tweening scaleX: 0→1 with transform-origin: 0% 50% (left) or 50% 0% (top). Cheap, no SVG, works on any div. Exit retracts with scaleX: 1→0.
how: Standardize accent underline/rule component in compose_lab.py: a div with height 4-8px, background=accent, transform-origin left center. Animate scaleX with power4.out. Use for 'Hairline Arc Gauge', 'Minimal line graph', 'Chart Story Primitive' axis draws.

title: Local woff2 fonts with font-display:block for deterministic render
text: lower-third-bild uses @font-face with local .woff2 files and font-display:block (blocks until loaded). Eliminates CDN latency, font-swap flash, and cross-origin nondeterminism. We currently use Google Fonts CDN in compose.py/compose_lab.py.
how: Download Inter, Oswald, Space Mono, JetBrains Mono, League Gothic, Archivo Black, Montserrat, Barlow Condensed as woff2. Place in public/fonts/. In compose_lab.py, generate @font-face rules with local paths and font-display:block. Update FontValue in composition variables to reference local family names. Add to preflight.py font-loading probe.

title: Multi-layer bloom with spread+blur for neon/glass glow
text: lt-neon-border builds 5 layers per arc: 3 glow layers (blur 30/15/8, spread 1/0.6/0.3, opacity 0.18/0.3/0.5), 1 hot core (blur 4, spread 0.05, opacity 0.9, color towardWhite(accent,0.78)), 1 white filament (blur 0, spread -0.012). Spread widens stroke before blur — key for emitted-light look. Layers split under/over panel for depth.
how: Create a `neonGlow` helper in compose_lab.py: given path, accent, thickness, glowMultiplier, generate SVG <defs> segments and <use> layers. Apply to 'Glassmorphism UI drawing primitives', 'Procedural environment map', 'Panel shine', 'HUD blocks'. Add variable `glowIntensity` (0-2).

title: Drop-zone wells with gradient cycle and index numerals
text: Empty media slots render as .mk-pg-well with cycled linear-gradient backgrounds (6 brand gradients) and centered numeral (1-based). Styled via CSS tokens (--mk-blob-1, --mk-blob-1-soft, etc.). Ken Burns still applies (scale 1.06→1). Provides polished placeholder without external assets.
how: In compose.py/classic look, when media missing, render well div with gradient from brand token cycle + numeral. Add to storyboard spec as fallback for missing assets.

title: Elliptical ring around first word
text: First word wrapped in span (head), rest in tail. Ring SVG sized to head glyph bounds: ringW = max(40, glyphW - 6/110*fontSize), ringH = max(40, headHeight * 150/157). Ring positioned at head.offsetLeft + pad - 44/110*fontSize, head.offsetTop - 9/110*fontSize. Ellipse cx/cy/rx/ry adjusted by fontSize ratios. Scales with fitted size.
how: Add ringFirstWord() helper in compose_lab.py for emphasis headlines (e.g., 'ONE FILE' → ring 'ONE'). Use in Kaise Tech thumbnails and end-cards.

title: Specs list with scrim for footage readability
text: Rows: label (semi-bold) + value (regular), optional underline sweep (scaleX 0→1). Left-edge scrim (linear-gradient 90deg rgba(0,0,0,0.55)→transparent) opacity 0–1 configurable. Dark scheme flips colors for footage overlay. Stagger entrance (0.18s) with x:-36→0. All via CSS tokens (--mk-ink, --mk-accent, --mk-hairline).
how: Add specs-list block to compose_lab.py for Kaise Tech spec comparisons (phone specs, AI model benchmarks). Expose scrim param for footage backgrounds.

title: News ticker with continuous scroll, flash sweep, live pulse
text: Shell enters y:260→0. Brand pill x:-80→0. Headline clipPath reveal inset(0 100%→0). Ticker track x:1260→-1120 over 6.05s (ease:none). Flash sweep x:-260→2040→4080 (skewed gradient). Live dot scale/boxShadow pulse (repeat 11, yoyo). Time/label fade in. Exit y:170→opacity 0. All in single timeline.
how: Build news-ticker block for Aage Suno breaking-news intros. Parameterize items, headline, brand colors. Use flash sweep for urgency, live pulse for authenticity.

title: Threat wash + scanline overlay (multiply blend)
text: Red wash: radial-gradient (rgba(255,59,48,0.3)→rgba(79,0,8,0.22)) + linear-gradient 90deg. Scanline: repeating-linear-gradient 0deg rgba(65,0,0,0.12) 1px/7px. Both mix-blend-mode: multiply, opacity animated (0→1→0.82). Creates tension without obscuring map details.
how: Add threatWash() and scanlineOverlay() primitives to compose_lab.py. Use for Puraan Ki Katha conflict scenes, Kaise Tech security alerts. Control via timeline opacity.

title: Corner brackets framing
text: Four 84×84px divs at 86px from edges, 5px borders (TL: top+left, TR: top+right, BL: bottom+left, BR: bottom+right). Border color rgba(17,17,17,0.62). Fade in 0.28s stagger 0.035s from 0.42s; dim to 0.38 at 5.82s. Cinematic framing for documentary/map shots.
how: Add cornerBrackets() to compose_lab.py. Parameterize size, inset, border color/width, fade timing. Apply to full-screen map/footage scenes in all pages.

title: Brand strip separate from main card
text: Card ends at y=1708; brand strip sits at y=1742 (212px below). Contains logo (52px height) + domain (Courier Prime 27px, letter-spacing 4px, opacity 0.62). Keeps card geometry pure; sign-off adapts to variable logo/domain. Logo slot uses portrays:["subject_logo"] for auto-selection.
how: In thumb.py and end-card template, split card and brand strip. Pass brandLogo/brandDomain as variables with portrays. Allows series templates to swap branding without layout changes.

title: Sequential route ticks with back.out pop
text: Six ticks at fixed positions along route. Each: from scale 0.2/opacity 0 to 1/1 over 0.16s back.out(3) at 1.34 + index*0.44s, then to scale 0.6/opacity 0.18 over 0.34s power2.out. Creates marching anticipation before plane arrival.
how: Add RouteTicks component in compose_lab.py that takes tick positions array and stagger interval; use for map progress indicators in tech explainers.

title: Orbit degrees variable parameterization
text: Composition variable cardOrbitDegrees (number, default 360, min -36000, max 36000, step 1) controls card-only vertical orbit during Blender frames 150–180. Sphere keeps independent spin. Final angle holds after frame 180.
how: In orbit-card style blocks, expose orbitDegrees as CompositionVariable with type number and portrays; drive card rotation Y via GSAP using variable value * DEG2RAD over specified frame range.

title: Procedural 3D asset with canvas label texture
text: Drink can built from LatheGeometry profile (13 points) + CylinderGeometry label. Label texture: 2048×872 canvas, two faces (front/back) so wordmark reads twice per revolution. Font loaded via FontFace API, size auto-fitted to 600px width. Metalness/roughness/clearcoat for realistic finish.
how: Adapt for Puraan Ki Katha mythological objects (pot, diya, book). Write a labelTexture() helper in compose_3d.py that takes name, flavor, colors, returns THREE.CanvasTexture. Cache generated textures in brain.jsonl.

title: Research-backed parameter documentation pattern
text: Oscilloscope block comments cite research entry F#10 for phosphor decay constants, explain sweep rate is authored not measured, distinguish physical law (beam-velocity brightness) from authored dials. Every variable has provenance: measured, standard sequence (1-2-5 timebase), or authored default.
how: Adopt in plan.py prompt: require Gemini to annotate each visual parameter with source (measured/standard/authored) and uncertainty. Store in brain.jsonl for future audits.

title: Sprite culling by gain threshold for particle performance
text: Rack-focus culls point-light sprites in the vertex shader when `vGain < 0.0015` (projected size × brightness falls below half a display code value). Prevents 900+ wire splats from becoming invisible fill-rate bombs when defocused.
how: In compose_lab.py particle systems (counter particles, chart dot pops, HUD telemetry), add a vertex-shader gain estimate and `if (gain < 0.0015) gl_Position = vec4(2.0); return;`. Tune threshold per scene; log culled count in doctor.py for monitoring.

title: Portrait 9:16 dynamic blurred background from slide content
text: Share-sheet-carousel blows up the current carousel slide to 1240x2080 (overscan), applies `filter: blur(46px) saturate(1.1) brightness(0.88)` as a full-screen background. The bg cross-fades on each hard cut, keeping the palette coherent without extra assets.
how: In thumb.py and compose_lab.py for 9:16 shorts, add a dynamic_bg layer: clone the hero image/video, scale to cover+10%, apply CSS filter string above, cross-fade opacity on scene changes. Zero extra bandwidth; works with Muse/FLUX generated frames.

title: UI micro-interaction: press with elastic bounce + color flip + count increment
text: Reddit post upvote: scale 0.85 (0.12s power2.out) → scale 1 (0.4s elastic.out(1,0.4)) + arrow fill #ff4500 (0.12s) + vote count color #ff4500 + textContent increment, all at same timestamp (1.62s). Single timestamp ensures perfect sync.
how: In compose_lab.py, add a ui_press_feedback(element, color, countEl) helper that builds this exact timeline chunk. Use for CTA buttons, poll options, 'tap to reveal' clues in Kaise Tech/Puraan Ki Katha. Store in brain.jsonl as reusable micro-interaction pattern.

title: D3/Three.js Render Pipeline
text: Integration of D3 (for geo-mapping) and Three.js (for procedural point clouds) within the HyperFrames pipeline. Uses a driver object pattern to sync timeline seeking with WebGL/SVG render frames.
how: Add a Three.js/D3 adapter to our renderer to enable complex data viz (maps, galaxies) that are currently impossible with CSS/GSAP alone.

title: iOS-Style Notification Stack
text: A notification stack that uses depth-based scaling and Y-squashing to simulate a physical list. Cards behind the front-most item peek by a fixed pixel amount, occluding deeper items.
how: Replace our current 'Stacked Push-Up Notification Cascade' with this depth-aware version to improve the 'lab look' quality in tech explainers.

title: Chromatic aberration via horizontal channel offset
text: Chromatic Aberration transition shows both R/B layers at 0.6 opacity, translates R −80 px / B +80 px over 0.3 s (power2.in), swaps scenes, then converges back to 0 over 0.3 s (power2.out). Subtle, lens-like distortion.
how: Create chromaticAberrationTransition(scene1, scene2, maxOffset=80) reusing the same overlay technique as glitch but with smooth tween instead of jitter. Use for "deep dive" section headers in tech explainers.

title: Morph circle expand (single div, scale 0→60)
text: A centered 50 px circle (background accent color) scales to 60× (covering 1920×1080) in 0.5 s (power3.in), scene swap at 0.4 s, circle fades out 0.15 s. Uses xPercent/yPercent −50 for perfect centering, owned by GSAP from start.
how: Add morphCircleTransition(scene1, scene2, color=brandAccent) in compose_lab.py. Minimal DOM, high impact — use for story chapter changes in Aage Suno.

title: Consistent demo timing pattern for transition design
text: All showcases follow: 3 s title → 1.5 s hold scene A → transition (0.4–1.2 s) → 1.5 s hold scene B → 1.0 s gap → next. This rhythm (≈5 s per transition) works for Shorts pacing and gives viewers time to register the effect.
how: Adopt this timing template in plan.py when inserting transitions between scenes: allocate 5 s budget per transition (adjustable via variable), enforce via pace.py. Document in playbook.md.

title: Transition preview harness for Telegram approval

how: Add a scripts/preview_transitions.py that reads transitions/registry.json, renders each preset to a temp MP4 (using compose_lab.py with dummy scenes), uploads to Telegram with inline buttons. Integrate into doctor.py for weekly refresh.

title: Callout positioning by quadrant logic

how: Codify in compose_lab.py callout helper: compute screen quadrant, flip offsetX sign, set text-anchor; reuse for any labeled scatter/bubble chart.

title: Pulse ring highlight for key data point
text: Extra circle at max radius, stroke-dashoffset animate 0→length for draw, then attr r +30 with opacity 0.6→0, repeat 2, power2.out. Draws attention without text.
how: Add pulse-ring helper in compose_lab.py; trigger on hero stat in lab look; sync to voice emphasis via hf:sfx event at timestamp.

title: Selection ring handles for UI elements
text: Four corner handles (tl/tr/bl/br) + dimension label, absolutely positioned on target element. Pure CSS/HTML, toggled via class for 'selected' state.
how: Build selection-ring component in compose_lab.py for UI demo scenes; activate via GSAP set when card enters; useful for 'how-to' tech shorts.

title: Overflow line auto-generated from truncated data rows
text: When rows exceed rows_max, hidden rows produce a summary line: 'and N more people with X-Y merges' (or single value). If overflow variable provided, use it; else compute from hidden array. Display conditionally.

title: Composition variables with JSON array for dynamic rows
text: data-composition-variables includes rows as JSON string: '[{"name":"Ada","merges":12,"avatar":""},...]'; parsed at runtime, sorted by merges desc, capped at rows_max (default 12). Avatar falls back to initials. All styling responsive to row height (avatar 62%, name 26%, count 48% of name).

title: Tap-dot ripple micro-interaction
text: On tap: dot at (right:47px, top:52px) scales from 0.25 to 2.15, opacity 0.95→0 over 0.42s power2.out; button scales 1→0.82 (0.1s power3.in) then 1 (0.14s back.out(2)). Provides tactile feedback in UI demos.
how: Add to Micro Transitions UI pack in compose_lab.py; trigger via hf:sfx CustomEvent at timeline offset; use for 'GET' button presses in Kaise Tech app demos.

title: Deterministic Glyph Cleanup via ClipperLib for 3D Extrusion
text: Geist glyphs have self-overlapping junctions (fine for browser fill, fatal for Three.js ExtrudeGeometry + EdgesGeometry). Fix: scale paths 1000×, round to integers, run ClipperLib.SimplifyPolygons with pftNonZero, re-orient rings (outer CCW, holes CW), assign holes to owners via PointInPolygon, rebuild THREE.Shape objects. Runs once at load; adds ~50ms per title.
how: Add to font preprocessing pipeline (build step). Wrap in try/catch; on failure fall back to raw shapes. Ensures clean extrusions for any TTF used in lab look 3D text.

title: Hue-Shifted Avatar Gradient Fallback
text: When no avatar image, render initials on a diagonal gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(hue, 62%, 52%), hsl(hue+40, 62%, 42%)). Hue comes from avatarHue parameter (e.g., 210, 340). Guarantees distinct, brand-safe colors per commenter without image assets.
how: Add to avatar slot component in compose.py. Accept avatarHue variable (default: hash(username) % 360). Use in yt_comment_thread and any social-proof blocks.

title: X Post Mockup with Elastic Like Micro-Interaction
text: Pixel-perfect X card (880px wide) with avatar, verified badge, handle, tweet body (4-line clamp), timestamp, and metrics bar (reply/repost/like/views/bookmark/share). Like button: press scale 0.85 → elastic.out(1,0.4) bounce → outline heart hides, filled heart (#f91880) shows → count increments 10.9K→11.0K + color shift. Card slides in/out from bottom (power3).
how: Add to compose_lab.py as 'social_proof_x' block. Parameterize displayName, handle, avatarUrl, tweetText, timestamp, metrics. Use GSAP elastic ease for like press. Reuse avatar slot pattern from brain. Useful for 'Twitter reaction' segments in Kaise Tech.

title: YouTube Comment Card with Per-Character Typing
text: Comment cards (avatar + username + time + text + like/reply row) type on character-by-character (0.024s/char, capped at 2.2s/comment). Two schemes: 'overlay' (white text + shadow over footage) and 'light' (ink on board). Avatar falls back to initials on hue-shifted gradient. Optional full-frame scanlines. Sequential entrance: avatar pop (back.out) → meta fade → type → row fade.
how: Add to compose.py as 'yt_comment_thread' block. Accept comments[] array variable. Use existing 'Message-thread chat story template' brain item but add typing stagger and scheme toggle. Good for 'audience reaction' beats in Puraan Ki Katha.

title: Avatar group hover micro-interaction
text: Avatar-group-hover shows a stack of overlapping circular avatars (initials) that lift on hover with back.out(1.8) stagger from center, then settle with bounce.out. Variables: size (enum), overlap (enum as share of diameter), accent (enum). All styling via CSS custom properties (--hf-avatar-size, --hf-avatar-overlap, --hf-avatar-accent, --hf-avatar-font). The animation is a standalone GSAP timeline (0.5s start, 5s duration).
how: Add as a 'team/community' cue in compose_lab.py. Map size/overlap to design tokens. Use the CSS variable mapping pattern for our avatar components. Timeline registers as 'avatar-group-hover-demo'.

title: Whitespace-Preserving Regex Tokenizer for Kinetic Text
text: Splitting text by spaces and wrapping every token in inline-block spans often breaks native browser word-wrapping. Using `text.split(/(\s+)/)` partitions the string into alternating words and whitespace tokens. Wrapping word tokens in inline-block spans while injecting whitespace tokens as raw `document.createTextNode(part)` preserves natural browser wrapping and typographic hyphenation without layout collapsing.
how: In `compose_lab.py` and caption generators, update the HTML word-splitter utility to use regex whitespace grouping and pure TextNodes for spaces instead of nested spans or non-breaking spaces.

title: Balanced two-line split by minimizing width difference
text: When a group exceeds single-line width, splitLinesForGroup() tests every split point, keeps only splits where both lines ≤ maxWidth, picks split with smallest absolute width difference. Falls back to single line if any word too wide.
how: Port splitLinesForGroup() to plan.py for all caption styles. Ensures visually balanced two-line captions without manual tuning. Uses same measureWord() with FONT_WIDTH_SAFETY.

title: Neon glow keyword highlight with steps(1) opacity snap
text: caption-neon-glow shows all words dim (rgba(0,255,240,0.14)). At word.start, keyword snaps to pink (#FF0099) with multi-layer text-shadow glow over 0.06s; non-keywords snap to cyan. At word.end, all revert. Uses steps(1) for instant group show.
how: Add neonGlowCaption() in compose_lab.py: define KEYWORD set from script nouns, apply glow timeline. Use Outfit 900. Low cost, high impact for Kaise Tech 'AI', 'model', 'benchmark' words.

title: Value Callout with Exact Token Landing
text: Emphasized datum shows value callout that animates from 0 to exact supplied string token (e.g., '12.5%') using frame-authored number rows. Rolling numbers use ease-out per frame (power2.out) and settle on raw token — no floating-point rounding. Unit suffix appended via separate tspan. Callout pops at 2.35s (CALLOUT_AT) with 0.45s pop duration (back.out(1.7)).
how: Modify our data callout components (counter, stat cards) to accept raw string tokens and animate via pre-authored frame sets. Use in chart-story and any metric highlight.

title: Container Query Layout for Responsive Compositions
text: Root uses container-type:size; children use cqw/cqh units. No data-width/data-height on composition root. Layout adapts to host size automatically. Enables same component to render at 1920x1080, 1080x1920, or any aspect without code changes.
how: Update compose.py and compose_lab.py to set container-type:size on root and use cqw/cqh in all new primitives. Deprecate fixed pixel layouts for new components.

title: Compound blur via multi-level mix map
text: Pre-render text mask at 5 blur radii (fractions of maxBlur). Generate a grayscale map where white=front, black=back, with trail width behind front. For each pixel, mix blur levels by map value (linear interpolation between adjacent levels). Avoids runtime large-kernel blur; deterministic and performant.
how: Implement in colorama-wipe block: create offscreen canvases for each blur level, draw masked text, apply filter:blur(radius). Create map canvas with tilted gradient. In draw loop, read map and all blur level pixels, mix into output ImageData. Use willReadFrequently contexts.

title: iMessage tail bubbles with CSS pseudo-elements
text: Received/sent bubbles get distinctive tail circles via ::before/::after: recv uses left-bottom radius 2.2cqmin 2cqmin with #242428 background and a #000 cover; sent uses right-bottom radius with #0a80f8. Tail circles scale with bubble size (cq units).
how: Add to compose_lab.py chat-thread template: generate bubble HTML with side-specific classes and inline SVG tails or CSS pseudo-elements using cq units for responsive scaling.

title: Delivered receipt micro-interaction under last sent bubble
text: A small 'Delivered' label (color #8e8e93, 2.7cqmin) appears 0.8cqh below the last sent bubble, right-aligned with 0.7cqw padding. Controlled by variable `receiptOn`; only shows for sent bubbles.
how: In chat-thread composer, after building message items, if last item is sent and receiptOn=true, append a delivered div to that bubble's pop container. Animate opacity in with GSAP at message arrival + beat.

title: Constellation Feature Tour
text: Fixed hub with orbiting feature nodes (4–8) arranged in narration order. SVG connectors draw from hub to each node (stroke-dashoffset) while node brightens, then all settle into a readable lockup. Cues array (seconds from mount start) staggers reveals; empty cues keep authored even spread. Exit options: fade, up, or none (hold until cut). Hub pulse rotation during HOLD (1.1deg, yoyo).
how: Build 'constellation-hub' component for Kaise Tech 'Top 5 Features' videos and Puraan Ki Katha 'Character Map' intros. Variables: hub_label, nodes (comma-separated), cues, accent, exit. Integrate with scout.py playbook for recurring feature-tour template.

title: Flip-Aware Floating Panel Positioning
text: Panel blooms from trigger point (anchor). Calculates left = anchor.x + width + 6u > viewportW ? anchor.x - width - 6u : anchor.x; top = anchor.y + height + 6u > viewportH ? anchor.y - height - 6u : anchor.y. Transform-origin set to (left? '100%' : '0') + ' ' + (up? '100%' : '0') for correct scale animation.
how: Apply to all callouts, tooltips, menus in compose_lab.py. Replace current quadrant logic with this flip-aware calculation. Ensures panels never clip off-screen in 9:16 shorts.

title: Micro-Interaction State Machine for Rows
text: Row states: default → hover (bg --dd-accent, color white) → click (blink once, scale 0.98) → editing (inline rename, blue border, bg color-mix) → confirm (toast) → done. Destructive items (Trash) show confirmation toast. Hover highlight follows cursor via pointer-events:none overlay.
how: Encode as reusable 'row-machine' in compose_lab.py for any list UI (file grids, comment threads, playlist). Drive via GSAP timeline labels: 'hover', 'press', 'edit', 'confirm'. Use in Aage Suno story selection scenes.

title: Procedural SVG Thumbnail Grid
text: Generate file-type thumbnails via SVG templates (206x100 box): PDF (dark header, lines), MP4 (play button, timeline), MD (code blocks), JPG (landscape), WAV (waveform bars), MP4 copy (duplicate icon). Each uses viewBox, preserves aspect, fills with metadata text. Grid auto-layout with 1.6cqw gap.
how: Add 'file-thumb' component to compose_lab.py; feed file list from research.py (GitHub repo files, asset lists). Use in Kaise Tech episodes showing project structures. Cache SVGs as textures.

title: Trail segment cross-fade via overlap window
text: Previous segment fades over 0.3–1.5s (variable) while next segment draws; opacity = 1 - easeOut(seg(t - fadeStart, fadeDur)). Eliminates hard cuts between path sections.
how: Update hwBoil wobble system or cursor path renderer: when advancing to next waypoint, start fade timer on previous polyline; draw new polyline simultaneously. Parameterize fadeDur per project.

title: Per-tile selection micro-interaction trio
text: On select frame: ring stroke-dashoffset animate (0.3s), inset scale 1→0.94→1 (back.out 0.2s), check badge scale 0→1.2→1 (back.out 0.25s). All synced to tile's select frame, not global time.
how: Add to component library as 'tile-select-feedback' preset. In compose_lab.py, when rendering grid interactions, attach this timeline to each tile triggered by its select frame variable.

title: Procedural SVG scene library for photo-grid tiles
text: 12 distinct SVG scenes (beach, mountain, city, forest, etc.) generated via code: gradients, shapes, noise, animated elements. Each tile gets unique scene ID; no external assets. Scenes fit 250×160 viewport.
how: Adopt for lab-look placeholder grids: replace static images with procedural SVG generator (beach-sunset, mountain-lake, city-night, etc.). Add to Muse fallback pool. Parameterize palette via accent variable.

title: Numbered step markers for tutorial click sequences
text: Each click spawns a circular badge with tabular number, accent background, and white text; badge scales 0→1 with back.out pop. Trail segment fades as next move begins. Configurable accent color (green/blue/violet).
how: Add new block type 'cursor-step-trail' to lab look: accepts step positions (array of {x,y,label}), renders numbered badges on click frames. Use in Kaise Tech 'how-to' shorts for settings walkthroughs.

title: Animated pill counter for batch operations
text: Pill shows count with tabular numerals; width expands via CSS custom property --pill-count. Scale pops 0.94→1.06→1 on each increment. Background uses accent color, text white. Opacity 0→1 when count>0.
how: Build reusable 'count-pill' component in HyperFrames catalog. In lab look, use for any batch action (multi-select, bulk delete, queue length). Drive via variable bound to selection state.

title: Deterministic fold widths via sine-wave sampling
text: Curtain folds use 24-step closed-form sine sampling (fixed point count) for consistent, non-random widths; each fold gets dark/mid/light/sheens from a single crest parameter.
how: Replace any random-width stagger in compose_lab.py (e.g., card stacks, icon assemblies) with this deterministic sine-based width distribution for seek-safe, identical renders.

title: Click ring micro-interaction
text: On each click, a ring scales from 0→1 with easeOut (0.35s) and fades; ring size proportional to container fraction (responsive). Works at any cursor position.
how: Add to UI panel interactions in compose_lab.py (button presses, card taps) via a reusable GSAP timeline snippet triggered by hf:sfx custom event.

title: Toolbar fade-in on selection end
text: Format toolbar (opacity 0→1, translateY) appears only after drag-release (t=1.65s); buttons (Bold, Italic, etc.) have press scale (0.92) and active tint via CSS custom property.
how: Pattern for any context-sensitive UI overlay in compose_lab.py: bind visibility to a timeline label (e.g., "selectionEnd") rather than fixed time.

title: Dashboard UI component set (side nav, KPI cards, revenue chart)
text: Ready-made dark dashboard: collapsible side nav with hover rows, 3 KPI cards with trend icons, SVG revenue chart (path + dots), range selector (30d/90d), export button with loading states.
how: Extract HTML/CSS into HyperFrames partials (dashboard-side, dashboard-kpi, dashboard-chart); use in Kaise Tech business/analytics explainers. Data-driven via composition variables.

title: Ambient background reacts to same progress as foreground metric
text: Decline chart drives both line draw (stroke-dashoffset) and background desaturation/dim from identical progress value (0→1). Background uses filter: saturate(1−p*0.72) brightness(1−p*0.52) on layered gradients. Creates cohesive 'data feeling' without extra keyframes.
how: Apply to existing chart primitives (line graph, bar chart). In compose_lab.py chart components, add ambient layer that reads same progress variable. Use for 'metric dropping' stories in Kaise Tech / Aage Suno.

title: Local-frame noise angle for organic rotation
text: Dart cursor computes noise angle as (tip_angle − shape_centroid_angle) in local frame, not world. Keeps wobble attached to arrowhead regardless of path curvature. Implemented via SVG filter feTurbulence on group, rotated by local angle.
how: Adopt in our 'Procedural Camera Shake' and 'Onion-skin ghost trail' primitives. When adding secondary motion to a moving group, compute noise in group's local coordinate space. Update hwBoil wobble system.

title: Screen safe-area auto-padding from logical pixels
text: Device frame stage computes screen slot inset from logical pixel specs (phone 390×844, tablet 768×1024) and cutout type (none/island/notch). CSS --logical-width/height drive screen-viewport scale. Content authored in logical pixels, pre-scaled for author — never canvas pixels.
how: Add to device_frame() in compose_lab.py. Store device specs in brain.jsonl. When placing sub-composition in screen slot, pass logical dimensions; let CSS scale. Eliminates manual safe-area guesswork.

title: Sequencing rule: next arrival starts at previous exitAt
text: The extended-keyframe choreography enforces that the next element's arrival begins when the previous element's exit has cleared (exitAt = at + 0.6*duration), while the exit ignites during the creep phase. This keeps the film moving without two elements sharing the frame.
how: In plan.py, when generating scene plans for lab look, schedule entrances using exitAt from the previous element's extended arrival. Update compose_lab.py to return exitAt from entrance primitives.

title: Deterministic baking pass for motion effects
text: Both echo-smear and motion-blur-filter use a forward seek sweep (tl.time(t, true) with suppressEvents) to record transforms at sub-frame intervals, then restore original time. No Math.random, no clocks, frame-accurate.
how: Add a 'bake' step in preflight.py for any composition using motion smear or shutter blur. Run headless seek pass, serialize poses to JSON, feed to render. Ensures deterministic output across Cloudflare Workers.

title: CSS custom property → RGB resolution via probe element
text: To resolve var(--accent) to concrete RGB for SVG fills: create hidden <span>, set style.color = token, read getComputedStyle(probe).color, parse rgb() string. Falls back to literal hex if token unrecognised. Runs once at mount, zero runtime cost.
how: Use in compose_lab.py when passing CSS colour tokens to Canvas/WebGL shaders (e.g., stat counters, chart accents, glass panels). Add helper in shared utils; call during composition mount before timeline starts.

title: Diagonal Gloss Sweep Celebration
text: A compact card receives a single diagonal gloss sweep (the whole celebration). Gloss is a linear-gradient animated via CSS custom property --gs-sweep from -30 to 130 degrees. Timing: land (0.5s base) → sweep at 0.65s (0.6s, power2.out) → fade out at 0.7s (0.2s). No pulse, confetti, or exit; card holds perfectly still in confident resting state. Accent tokens (green/blue/violet) drive surface, edge, and label colors.
how: Add to compose_lab.py as a card-landing celebration variant. Trigger after card stagger assembly. Animate --gs-sweep via GSAP on the card's .gs-gloss element. Use the same accent token system (--brand, --accent) for color consistency.

title: CONFIG object pattern for component builders with validation
text: g09 convention: hwArrowBuild(target, CONFIG, seed) reads CONFIG.arrowStyle (straight/gentle/swoop), CONFIG.strokeType (plain/soft/sharp/spray), CONFIG.boil (calm/lively/off). Each validates enum, logs error, falls back. Seed derived from element id (string hash mod 96 +1) if not provided; id-less targets error and share fallback slot (duplicate mask ids cross-wire). Builder returns object with applied stroke, head rig, boil pose, seed for later wiring (hwArrowOn/Off). Durations locked for built targets (ignores legacy dur arg with error).
how: Adopt in our component registry: each HyperFrames component gets a build(config) that validates, seeds, returns rig. Use in compose_lab.py for reusable primitives (arrows, badges, charts). Enforce unique ids in plan.py scene generation.

title: Catalog demo plates show non-default control states side-by-side
text: Demo plates (hw-arrow-demo, hw-boil-demo) render every declared pose of every control simultaneously: swoop+spray+lively | gentle+sharp+calm | straight+soft+boil-off. Labels each column. Raw frantic arrow (frameDrop=1) included. Opaque root background for transparent overlay readability. This contact-sheet approach ensures visual regression testing and designer approval via Telegram.
how: Update our catalog registry (components/*.json) to include demo plates that render all non-default control combos. Use in doctor.py visual diff. Share demo plate MP4s in Telegram approvals for owner sign-off on new primitives.

title: Composition variable enum schema with bounded validation
text: icon-swap declares variables in data-composition-variables JSON: each has id, type (enum), role (style/layout/motion), label, description, default, options[]. Runtime pick() returns fallback if override not in options table. Applied via CSS custom properties (--hf-icon-bg, --hf-icon-size, --hf-icon-radius, --hf-icon-blur-scale).
how: Adopt this schema for our HyperFrames Variables in compose.py/compose_lab.py. Replace ad-hoc CONFIG objects with typed variable declarations. Enables catalog registry, Telegram approval previews, and canary rollouts.

title: Bounded controls with console errors (g09 law)
text: Every variant control (entrance, strokeType, labelPos, boil, labelAt) validates against declared enum array. Unknown value → console.error with fallback to default. Validation happens before use (hwBxPick, hwCalloutBuild). Guarantees deterministic behavior and catches typos in playbooks.
how: Add validate_enum(control_name, value, allowed, default) helper to plan.py and compose_lab.py. Wrap all variant parameters (entrance, stroke_type, label_pos, boil, etc.). Log errors to doctor.py for pipeline health.

title: Label pop with momentum absorption & contact squash
text: Callout label pops from connector tip with power2.in (accelerating into contact). Arrival velocity measured at first crossing of scale 1.0 via finite-difference on the ease curve. Squash magnitude S = min(0.08 * |vPop|/2000, 0.25) on the deform wrapper only; label rides uniform-scale pop OUTSIDE deform so glyphs never get non-uniform scale. Spring recovery uses factory duration verbatim (snappy feel).
how: Implement in compose_lab.py as hwCalloutPop primitive. Use for Kaise Tech stat callouts and Puraan Ki Katha name/place labels. Replace current static label reveals with this momentum-absorbing pop.

title: Quadratic connector with seeded wobble for callouts
text: Callout connector is a single Q curve from ellipse perimeter (sx,sy) to label anchor (ex,ey). Control point = midpoint + hwHash(21,seed)*14 vertical offset. labelAt (left/right/below) determines start point on ellipse and label placement. Connector and outline share strokeType texture via hwStrokeApply.
how: Add hw_connector_path(cx,cy,rx,ry,labelAt,seed) to compose_lab.py. Use for Puraan Ki Katha character callouts and Kaise Tech diagram annotations. Pair with scribble fill and label pop.

title: Input Feedback Micro-interaction
text: Form field with validation states: entrance, shake on error, checkmark pop on success, hint fade-in. Driven by CSS variables (--hf-fb-border, --hf-fb-chip-bg) swapped via data-state attribute. Timeline includes staggered entrance, shake (x: -12px, repeat 5), checkmark back.out(2).
how: Create reusable UI component for Kaise Tech demos (login, OTP, forms); add to lab look UI panel primitives; trigger via composition variable status.

title: Phase scaling for duration compression
text: When total duration < sum of fixed phase bases (IN_BASE+OUT_BASE), all phases scale proportionally: phaseScale = duration / (IN_BASE+OUT_BASE). Hold phase becomes max(0, duration - (IN+OUT)). Prevents broken timing on short clips.
how: Apply in compose_lab.py transition primitives. Replace fixed-duration assumptions with phase scaling. Ensure doctor.py validates timeline durations against phase bases.

title: Hamburger-to-X menu morph with pill fan
text: Three bars morph to X (rotation ±45°, middle fades) at 0.78s. Three pills fan out from bottom with back.out(1.6) stagger 0.06s. Button size variable (52-112px). Tone variable (ink/green/blue/violet) via CSS custom property.
how: Add menu-morph for Kaise Tech UI demos showing mobile menus. Drive from script: actions list, tone. Use as 3s insert in plan.py.

title: Per-character SVG stroke-dashoffset checkmark
text: SVG checkmark (path length 42) draws via stroke-dashoffset = (1-progress)*42. Driven by same --hf-micro-progress as other micro-elements. No separate timeline. Color inherits currentColor.
how: Add to caption system for 'done' indicators in listicles. Use in Kaise Tech feature checklists. Animate via existing micro-progress variable.

title: SVG Filter Text Morph
text: Word-list morphing using feColorMatrix threshold filter: two text layers crossfade with dynamic blur (blur = 8/frac - 8) creating liquid merge. Configurable morph_speed (1s) and pause (1.5s). Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Words defined in hidden <ol> with per-word font/color.
how: Use in plan.py for hook title sequences or section headers; define word list in script JSON; render via HyperFrames component with data-morph-speed/pause.

title: Exit transition enum for reusable components
text: Components declare exit: 'none' | 'fade' | 'up' with optional departure animation. Default 'none' holds final frame until frame cut. 'fade' fades root out, 'up' slides stage up. Keeps component self-contained for timeline sequencing.
how: Add exit variable to our component schema in compose_lab.py. Implement in particle primitives and pendulum swing. Ensures clean handoff to next scene.

title: Device pixel ratio aware offscreen canvas sizing
text: Canvas width/height = host box * devicePixelRatio, rounded to integer. `dpr = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1))`. Ensures crisp particle rendering on high-DPI screens without oversampling cost.
how: Apply in any offscreen canvas work (particle systems, text bitmap readback). Add utility in compose_lab.py: `sizeCanvasForDPR(hostElement, maxDPR=2)`.

title: Particle image reveal primitive
text: Seeded deterministic particle field materializes an image: particles converge from scattered positions to form the image over 2.8s IN, hold, then optional exit. Uses fixed LCG (seed 0x50a71c1e), canvas 2D, per-particle attribute table (arrival, birth, fade, offset, angle, radius, dim) computed once at mount. Image injected via SLOT pattern.
how: Add new component in compose_lab.py: particleImageReveal(density, direction, accent, exit). Use for Kaise Tech hero shots where a diagram/photo assembles from particles.

title: Cursor Arrival with Human-Like Landing Offset
text: Cursor tip lands a few pixels off the target zone center (0.55% x, 0.85% y) then compresses into lockstep. This micro-offset sells human aim without extra keyframes.
how: In any cursor simulation (agent cursor component), add a small random offset at arrival before lockstep.

title: 3D Perspective Marquee for Tech Tickers
text: A horizontal pill strip in CSS 3D perspective (rotateX 6–34°) that loops seamlessly; variables control tilt, travel distance, tone (ink/paper/accent), and word list. GSAP animates a CSS custom property for translateX.
how: Create a reusable HyperFrames component for compose_lab.py; feed words from scout.py tech news radar; use as a background ticker in lab-look scenes.

title: Pull-Back Reveal from Detail Chip to Full Context
text: Camera starts tight on a stat chip (2.4s hold), whip-pulls back to reveal headline and two supporting cards with a short drift settle; elastic hold breathes shadow on the ground plane. No exit – holds until cut.
how: Add as a scene transition in plan.py for data-reveal moments; compose_lab.py can instantiate with detail_text, headline, accent from script variables.

title: Corner-bracket chip labels for data callouts
text: Segmentation flood chips use .sgf-corner with border-left/top (tl), border-right/top (tr), etc. at 0.28 cqmin. Chip sits above region; bottom rows drop chip inside top edge so nothing leaves stage. Label text uppercase, mono, 1.9 cqmin, letter-spacing 0.12em.
how: Adopt for stat callouts in lab look: replace plain pill labels with corner-bracket chips. Add to compose_lab.py chip component. Matches 'Corner brackets framing' in brain.

title: Slot-based subject injection for AI vision
text: Segmentation flood expects caller to place a <template data-slot="segmentation-flood-subject"> anywhere in host page. Runtime clones that template into the stage so the subject lives at document level (not inside the composition). Missing slot falls back to a procedural token scene so the readout always has content.
how: Add slot injection helper to HyperFrames SDK: caller passes subject HTML/element, we clone into mount point before timeline starts. Use in Kaise Tech AI explainers for live segmentation overlays. Update compose_lab.py to accept subject slot variable.

title: HUD flicker: 2-frame deterministic toggle
text: Flicker active only while flood in flight. Pure function of frame index: flicker on when floor(frame/2) % 2 == 1. Draws full-canvas white flash at 5% opacity. Zero state, matches gsap.ticker.frame at 30 fps.
how: Add to Telemetry HUD component (already in brain) as optional flicker layer. Drive from timeline's onUpdate with frame count. Use in Kaise Tech for 'processing' moments.

title: Shimmer sweep via animated CSS custom property
text: A shimmer mask uses mix-blend-mode:overlay and a linear-gradient controlled by --shimmer-pos. GSAP animates --shimmer-pos from -20% to 120% with stagger across targets. No extra DOM, GPU-friendly, works on any text/shape.
how: In lab look, add .shimmer-sweep utility class. In plan.py, when script calls for 'keyword highlight' or 'loading', emit a shimmer-sweep block with --shimmer-color from brand accent. Animate via tl.fromTo('.target', {'--shimmer-pos': '-20%'}, {'--shimmer-pos': '120%', duration: 1.2, stagger: 0.15}).

title: Slit-scan reveal transition
text: Deterministic slit-scan transition: frame rows sample subject at offset times; subject moves on decaying sine bob, canvas draws per-slice clips with jittered offsets (LCG seed 0x51175c4e), collapse at 0.6s eased, hold then optional exit. Variables: axis (rows/cols), spread (max offset), resolve_at, accent (green/blue/violet), exit (none/fade/up).
how: Add as HyperFrames component in compose_lab.py for scene transitions; expose variables via composition-variables; use canvas renderer for per-slice drawing.

title: CSS zoom for wrapper scaling without transform interference
text: Stagger-lattice applies zoom: 1.7 on .hf-advanced-stagger-lattice wrapper to scale entire component for demo without affecting GSAP transform targets (.cell uses transform: translateY/scale). GSAP targets remain at 1:1 pixel coordinates. Host can override zoom via CSS variable.
how: Use zoom on composition root in compose.py for responsive previews (9:16 vs 16:9) instead of scaling individual elements. Add --hf-zoom variable to composition variables.

title: Elastic hold with sub-pulse inside pinned element
text: During HOLD phase (after last caption rise), mock breathes: --sms-live pulses 0.64→0.9 via sine.inOut repeat 1 yoyo. Keeps pinned element alive without new keyframes. Duration scales with available time.
how: Apply to any pinned hero (device frame, book, map) in compose_lab.py. Add subtle pulse to --hf-live variable during scripted holds.

title: Stitched text draw as thread stitches
text: Letters built from single-stroke glyph polygons (70×100 box, 40 space). Each stroke draws thread-first: needle dot leads, holes appear at boundaries, thread-tail overshoots then pulls snug. Double-dash trick: stroke-dasharray sums to 2× path length L, animate stroke-dashoffset L→0. No SVG mask, no clipPath, Chrome-safe on reverse seeks.
how: Add compose_stitch.py: convert text to glyph polygons (pre-baked A-Z 0-9), create SVG paths per stroke, apply double-dash reveal via GSAP on stroke-dashoffset attribute. Use deterministic LCG (seed 0x57174c3d) for per-stroke jitter. Integrate as lab-look 'stitch' caption style.

title: Deterministic LCG scramble for typed readouts
text: Telemetry HUD uses a fixed-seed LCG (lcgState = (1664525 * state + 1013904223) >>> 0) to generate per-character scramble frames, ensuring identical renders across runs. Characters resolve left-to-right on each tick, digits stay digits, letters stay letters.
how: Adopt in caption/kinetic text system for glitch-style reveals: precompute scramble table per word using same LCG, drive via GSAP ticker at fixed timeline offsets.

title: Terminal line stagger via scaleX transform
text: Terminal simulator animates editor lines with --hf-line scaleX 0→1 and opacity 0→1 (power2.out, 0.24s, stagger 0.08s). Lines are block spans with transform-origin left center. Terminal command fades up (0.34s, delay 0.48s).
how: Apply in tech explainer code scenes: generate line elements from script snippets, stagger scaleX for typing-like reveal without per-char overhead.

title: SVG line draw loader with stroke-dashoffset
text: Single path with stroke-dasharray=900, stroke-dashoffset animated 900→0 via --hf-dash CSS property (power3.inOut, 1.35s). Path uses cubic bezier for organic curve. No JS logic beyond timeline; fully CSS-driven.
how: Use as lightweight transition loader between sections: swap path data per video, drive via 1.35s timeline at section boundaries.

title: Gradient bar sweep at 87% progress as transition sync cue
text: A cyan→blue gradient bar (height ~12px) sweeps horizontally across the text glyphs at 0.87 of the curve progress, crossing the text center exactly at the match-cut frame. The bar follows the same cubic-bezier easing as the text motion. Serves as a visual metronome for the hard cut and a deterministic SFX trigger point.
how: In the match-cut primitive (item 1), emit a CustomEvent 'hf:sync' at progress 0.87 with {type:'gradient-bar-cross'}. Our mix.py can hook this for a subtle whoosh/SFX. Also renders a visible bar in preview mode (Telegram approval) so editors can verify cut timing.

title: Deterministic micro-drift from integer sine cycles
text: Drift uses 2 and 3 full sine cycles (2π and 3π) that end exactly at zero before authored stillness. Duration = max(0, OUT_START - STILLNESS). OnUpdate writes pointer values (p = π*2*2, etc.) so seek reproduces identical frame. No random, no timeScale.
how: Apply to any 'organic hold' in lab look (HUD panels, stat counters, floating elements). Replace current breathing float with integer-cycle drift. Implement in GSAP as tween with onUpdate applying sin(p) * amplitude.

title: Vignette breathing hold
text: After the main vignette ramp, a gentle 0.9s sine.inOut oscillation on --vignette-size (26% ↔ 32%) keeps the frame alive during the hold period. This prevents the static 'frozen' look on looped captures and matches the catalog's thumbnail sampling at ~3s (peak intensity).
how: In the vignette component, after the main to() tween, add two chained to() tweens on --vignette-size with sine.inOut, yoyo: true, repeat: 1 (or loop via timeline). Set the hold duration in the composition variable so doctor.py can adjust per video length.

title: Hero card aura selection highlight
text: The centered hero card gets a dynamic aura: border-color and box-shadow using the accent color (from variable --vts-accent) with a glow value (e.g., '0 4.2cqi 10cqi rgba(acc, 0.35)'). Non-hero cards dim to opacity 0.62, scale 0.95. The aura scales with the card (1.04x) during snap hold, then settles to 1x.
how: In the feature-rail block, bind the hero card's border-color and box-shadow to the accent composition variable via CSS: border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vts-accent) 46%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 1.4cqi color-mix(in srgb, var(--vts-accent) 14%, transparent). Animate the hero's scale to 1.04 during snap hold for extra pop.

title: Feathered Spotlight Highlight
text: Dim overlay (rgba(6,8,12,0.55)) with radial-gradient mask: ellipse hole (CSS vars --yt-hl-x/y/rx/ry) feathered 52%-88%. Helpers: ytHighlightIn(target, at, {x,y,rx,ry}), ytHighlightTo(target, at, {x,y,rx,ry}, dur), ytHighlightOut(target, at). GSAP tweens CSS vars directly. 0.5s fade in, 0.8s glide, 0.4s fade out.
how: Implement as 'spotlight' block in compose_lab.py for directing attention in tech demos, code walkthroughs, or mythology scene focus. Accept target coordinates (% or px) and ellipse size. The CSS-var approach is seek-safe and works over any content (video, HTML, canvas).

title: Enum Variable UX: Segmented Buttons ≤4 Options, Else Select
text: Catalog-detail uses segmented button row for enums with 2-4 options (e.g., depth: close/standard/far, accent: blue/green/violet). Each button shows label, highlights active with brand color. For >4 options, falls back to native select. This matches the zoom-through's depth/accent enums exactly. No custom dropdown needed.
how: In plan.py composition variable schema, add ui_control hint: 'segmented' for enums ≤4. thumb.py and any future composer tool render as segmented row. Keeps variable definitions self-describing. Already have depth/accent in zoom-through; apply to existing enums (transition-type, chart-style, caption-mode).

title: Number Variable Granularity from Default Value
text: For number inputs without declared step, step = 10^(-decimals_in_default). Example: default 0.06 → step 0.01; default 100 → step 1. This preserves author's intended precision. Unbounded numbers (no min/max) use number input, not slider, to avoid false 0-100 range. Slider shows min/max labels, live value readout on thumb, default marker at authored position (hidden when thumb overlaps). Double-click resets to default.
how: Update composition variable schema in plan.py: add min/max/step optional. In compose_lab.py, when generating HTML, compute step from default if absent. For unbounded vars (e.g., particle-count), render number input. For bounded (e.g., stroke-width 0.5-10), render slider with readout. Preflight.py validates values against bounds.

title: Reduced Motion Detection & Graceful Degradation
text: Advanced-path-grid uses matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to pause videos, remove src, call load() to abort downloads. CSS has no motion (only 100ms color transitions). Catalog-detail removed all scale/spring animations, keeping only color transitions. This respects accessibility and prevents stuck downloads on low-end devices.
how: In compose.py/compose_lab.py, add prefers-reduced-motion media query: disable Ken Burns, particle float, grain vignette, complex transitions. Replace with simple cuts/fades. In review.py, add reduced-motion render variant for QA. doctor.py can simulate reduced-motion to catch layout shifts.

title: SVG Path Import & Normalization Pipeline
text: Complete utility chain: parsePathData (handles SVG path grammar including arc flags), normalisePathData (converts to absolute M/L/C/Q/Z only), transformPathData (applies 2D matrix), fitMatrix (scale-to-fit aspect-preserved into target bbox), printPathData (2-decimal output), shapePathData (converts rect/circle/ellipse/line/polyline/polygon to path), svgToPathData (loads SVG in offscreen DOM, uses getScreenCTM for transform resolution, fits to target path's bbox). Handles degenerate cases, definitions filtering, display:none skipping. Returns fitted path data + shape count.
how: Integrate into asset pipeline (Muse/FLUX outputs, icon libraries). Add svg_to_path.py using the JS logic (port to Python or run via Node). Use in compose_lab.py for stroke-draw animations (charts, UI panels, logo reveals). Target bbox comes from composition variable default (e.g., stroke-trace default path).

title: Debounced Iframe Preview Reload for Variable Tweaks
text: Catalog-detail debounces variable changes (300ms) then posts { type: 'hf:variables', variables } to preview iframe. Iframe reloads only inner composition frame with new query string, preserving playhead. Parent page never blinks. This enables real-time visual feedback while tuning colors, timings, depths without full re-render.
how: Build a lightweight preview server (FastAPI + static files) that serves composition HTML with variable injection. preflight.py spins it up, opens headless page, and as Gemini suggests variable tweaks, sends postMessage to update iframe. Avoids full HyperFrames render cycle for visual audit. Requires composition to read variables from URLSearchParams on init.

title: Drifting film rows with drag/swipe/shift-wheel, focus hold, pause button (WCAG 2.2.2)
text: Two rows drift opposite directions (90s/105s loop). Drag pointer (6px threshold), horizontal swipe, or Shift+wheel moves row. Keyboard focus centers card and pauses drift. Global pause button stops motion. Reduced motion = static rows, native scroll.
