text: emitWords splits word arrays into lines ≤16KB; createProgressWriter coalesces rapid download progress events (same phase/model) into latest, preserving order and backpressuring on slow stdout.
how: Replace current telemetry emitter with createProgressWriter for dashboard updates; apply emitWords for any word-level streaming (captions, transcripts).

title: Child-process runtime health probe with timeout
text: Before using a native binary (sherpa-onnx), spawn a child that loads it; capture stderr, enforce 60s timeout. If load fails, log error once, fall back to cache or reinstall. Probe runs in isolated process so onnxruntime aborts don't crash main.
how: Add similar probe for Chrome/ffmpeg in preflight.py: spawn headless Chrome to load a tiny page, verify GPU/renderer; if fails, trigger doctor repair before render.

title: Strict 16-bit mono PCM WAV validation
text: readWav() verifies RIFF/WAVE header, fmt chunk format=1 (PCM) or 0xFFFE (extensible), 1 channel, 16-bit depth. Throws descriptive error on mismatch. findWavChunk() parses RIFF chunks generically.
how: Add to voice gate and mix.py: validate any WAV before processing. Use findWavChunk for custom chunk inspection. Ensures ffmpeg output matches whisper/Parakeet expectations.

title: Test isolation: Chrome tests run serial after unit tests
text: vitest config splits into three projects: unit (parallel), chrome (fileParallelism=false, runs after unit), spawn (serial, last). Chrome tests get 20s/30s timeouts; Windows pre-warms Fontconfig with single Arial font to avoid 9s cold start.
how: Adopt in CI: separate unit, browser, and CLI-spawn test suites. Run browser tests sequentially after units. Add Windows Fontconfig pre-warm in vitest setup. Prevents flakes from resource contention.

title: Collision-proof temp audio paths with PID+UUID
text: Temp WAV path = `${tmpdir()}/hyperframes-audio-${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}.wav`. Guarantees uniqueness across parallel transcribe calls (e.g., per-scene pipeline) that would collide on Date.now().
how: Replace any date-based temp names in prepareWav/extractAudio with this pattern. Use in compose.py, mix.py, and any parallel ffmpeg jobs. Add cleanup in finally blocks.

title: Runtime preview guards with banned pattern enforcement
text: lint-runtime-preview-guards.ts enforces required source patterns (e.g., external composition ready gate, child timeline activation) and bans anti-patterns (instanceof DOM interfaces) via regex scans. Runs in CI to prevent regressions.
how: Add similar guards to studio CI for compose.py/compose_lab.py: require 'externalCompositionsReady' check before timeline bind, ban 'instanceof HTMLElement' in favor of structural predicates. Run on every PR.

title: Runtime artifact integrity with SHA-256 manifest
text: build-hyperframes-runtime-artifact.ts bundles the runtime IIFE/ESM, computes SHA-256 of source, and writes a manifest.json with version, buildId, sha256, and contract version. Enables verification that injected runtime matches expected build.
how: Adopt for the HyperFrames runtime script injected in compose.py/compose_lab.py. Generate manifest at build; in render step, fetch manifest and verify script hash before injection.

title: Injected IIFE artifact pattern for browser runtimes
text: buildInjectedArtifact.ts bundles an entry stub into a minified IIFE string constant, exported as a getter function. Used for audio-FX runtime and position-edits render — injected as a single script tag, no file I/O in browser.
how: Refactor mix.py audio processing and compose_lab.py position-edits logic into entry stubs; build IIFE constants at studio build time; inject via script tag in headless Chrome. Removes need for external JS files.

title: GSAP timeline parser/writer for programmatic animation
text: gsap-parser-acorn.ts and gsap-writer-acorn.ts parse GSAP code into AST and generate GSAP code from AST. Enables programmatic creation/modification of animations (e.g., from plan.py scene specs) without string templating.
how: In plan.py, output GSAP timeline JSON per scene; use parser to validate, writer to emit final GSAP code for compose_lab.py. Allows dynamic animation generation from structured scene data.

title: Composition contract schema for scene plan validation
text: composition-contract.ts (exported) likely defines a JSON schema for composition structure. Validating scene plans against a schema catches missing fields, type mismatches, and duration inconsistencies before render.
how: Define a JSON schema for plan.py output (scenes, hooks, visual specs, durations). Add validation step in preflight.py; reject plans that fail schema. Use schema to generate TypeScript types for compose scripts.

title: Audible video detection via data-has-audio attribute
text: Video element is audible iff not muted AND (data-has-audio absent OR exactly "true"). Case-sensitive: "TRUE" counts as false. Selector: audio[data-start], video[data-start]:not([muted]):is(:not([data-has-audio]),[data-has-audio="true"]).
how: In compose.py when building scenes, set data-has-audio="true" on video clips that contain audio (from metadata). mix.py uses this to include only audible tracks in loudness measurement and SFX ducking.

title: Preset wet/dry blend as single automation target
text: Effects from a preset (fromPreset field) are wrapped in a shared wet/dry gain pair (two GainNodes moving in opposition). Whole-preset amount stored as presetAmount (0–1). Automation lane target "fx.<presetId>" drives the blend, not individual node params. Split preset runs (non-contiguous nodes) each get their own blend pair, all driven by same lane.
how: In audioFx registry, mark preset effects with fromPreset. mix.py builds one wet/dry pair per preset run. Automation lanes can fade entire preset in/out (e.g., telephone effect on voiceover). Simplifies lane authoring.

title: LFO phase alignment for modulated effects on seek/scrub
text: Chorus/phaser LFO implemented as looping BufferSource (not OscillatorNode) so phase can be set via start(when, offset). Offset = (clipElapsed * speed) % 1. On render start (elapsed=0) phase=0. On preview seek, pass current clip time to buildFxNode so LFO matches render.
how: In compose_lab.py preview server, when seeking, rebuild modulated effects with elapsed time. Ensures phaser/chorus sweep position matches between preview and final render.

title: Automation parameter unit mapping from knob to AudioParam
text: Each automatable knob declares a map function: gain (dB→linear), delay (ms→seconds), mix (0–1→wet/dry opposite gains). Registry flags automatable params; buildFxNode exposes only flagged ones. Validation test ensures no flagged param lacks AudioParam and no unflagged param is exposed.
how: Extend audioFx registry in mix.py with map functions. Prevents unit mismatches (e.g., -12 dB scheduled as linear -12). Enables correct automation lanes authored in UI units.

title: Automation lane sampling density and straight-segment detection
text: Curved segments sampled at 100 pts/sec, clamped to 8–4096 points. Straight segment = no curve, no via point, linear scale, no unit map. Only straight segments use linearRampToValueAtTime; everything else sampled. Log-scale frequency sweeps sampled geometrically. Via-point bends (from timeline drag) sampled same as curve exponent.
how: In mix.py automation, apply same rules: detect straight ramps for efficiency, sample curves densely. Ensures smooth filter sweeps without excessive AudioParam events.

title: Deterministic normalized reverb impulse synthesis
text: synthesizeReverbImpulse(sampleRate, size, damping) returns Float32Array normalized to unity energy (RMS=1). Deterministic for same params. Length scales with size (0.1→1.0). Tail decays to <0.01 amplitude. Prevents level jumps when adding reverb at any wet level.
how: Use in mix.py for reverb SFX. Generate once per (size, damping) combo, cache. Convolve with dry signal at desired wet gain. Ensures consistent loudness across renders.

title: Worklet-backed effects with explicit dispose signaling
text: Compressor and truepeak limiter use AudioWorkletNode (hf-compressor, hf-truepeak). On parameter change, port.postMessage({param: value}) updates running processor. On dispose, sends {__hfDispose: true} so processor can retire (return false from process()). reset() sends {__hfReset: true} only to history-carrying effects (truepeak, compressor).
how: Implement hf-compressor and hf-truepeak worklets for mix.py loudness chain. Use dispose/reset in render pipeline to avoid orphaned processors across preview rebuilds.

title: Shape-based graph rebuild detection
text: Signature string includes: type, poles, fixed frequency (for 1-pole IIR), wave type (phaser), preset run, lookahead (truepeak). If signature unchanged, push new params into running nodes (2.7 ms quantum); else rebuild. Prevents stale params on structural edits.
how: In HyperFrames audio graph builder, compute similar signature for each clip's FX chain. In preflight.py, compare signature before render; if changed, force full rebuild. Saves CPU on parameter tweaks.

title: Sub-knee shortcut skips transcendentals
text: In compressor, samples below (threshold - knee) get unity gain without log/exp. Knee width in dB = 20×log10(knee_ratio). Saves ~70% CPU on quiet material.
how: If implementing custom dynamics in mix.py, add knee_start_lin = 10^((threshold - knee_db)/20) and bypass gain computer when envelope ≤ knee_start_lin. Benchmark vs FFmpeg.

title: Audio analysis ladder with quality gates
text: runLadder tries providers in order (local → hosted), respects quality='local' flag, falls through on failure/unavailable, emits provenance and warnings. Used for moments, onsets, envelope, loudness, silence, classify (voice/music/sfx).
how: In scout.py or research.py, adopt ladder pattern for audio-based content analysis: first try local (Essentia, librosa), then hosted API. Tag results with provenance. Use classify to tag B-roll as music/voice/sfx for edit decisions.

title: True-peak limiter with 4× oversampled detection
text: Kaiser-windowed sinc polyphase branches (4×) estimate inter-sample peaks; lookahead (default 3 ms) + 16-sample detector delay gives total latency. Holds ceiling within 0.01 dB for tones, 0.5 dB for programme, 1.35 dB for full-band noise.
how: Port the hf-truepeak worklet algorithm to FFmpeg filter chain in mix.py (or use as reference to validate current true-peak limiting). Set lookahead 3 ms, release 80 ms, ceiling -1 dBTP for -14 LUFS master.

title: Click-free pitch-shift with dual-tap granular crossfade
text: Two read taps 180° apart in 100 ms grain, each sweeping at (1-ratio)/grain. Equal-power crossfade (sin(π×phase)) hides splice. Wet path ramped in/out (15 ms one-pole) when semitones changes or mix moves. At semitones=0, true bypass (no 50 ms delay).
how: For 'chipmunk' or 'slow-mo' voice effects in Kaise Tech, replace any pitch-shift with this algorithm. Implement as FFmpeg filter chain (asetrate+aresample+rubberband) but mimic dual-tap crossfade via two delayed streams mixed with sine weights.

title: Worklet registration retry after transient failure
text: Failed addModule promise is not cached; readyContexts only marked on success. Next ensureAudioFxWorklets call retries. Prevents permanent disable of half the rack after one slow load.
how: In HyperFrames render worker startup, wrap audio worklet registration in retry loop (max 3, 500 ms backoff). Log failures to doctor.py. Ensure context recreation on repeated failure.

title: Syllable-rate modulation metric for voice detection
text: syllableModulation(): 10 ms hop RMS → 1024-pt FFT → power in 3–8 Hz band / total power. Returns 0–1. Voice scores ≥0.35; music/sfx lower. Combined with low onset regularity (<0.35) gives speechLike flag.
how: In voice gate, compute syllableModulation on TTS output; if <0.25, flag as potentially unnatural (flat prosody). Add to brain.jsonl as lesson.

title: Gemini 4 Neon
text: A new Gemini 4 model optimized for developers and coding tasks with updated benchmarks. We use Gemini free credits for plan.py and research.py; switching to Neon should improve script logic and scene planning accuracy.
how: Update the model ID in plan.py and research.py to use 'gemini-4-neon' for better scene-by-scene logic.

title: GTA 6 Creator Trends
text: New creator tools and high-demand content trends specifically for GTA 6 on Shorts and Reels. Massive hook potential for 'Kaise Tech' (tech behind the game) and 'Aage Suno' (storytelling) given the 2026 relevance.
how: Inject 'GTA 6' as a high-weight keyword in ideas.py to trigger tech-explainer scripts about the game's engine or leaks.

title: Instagram Story Edit
text: A new feature allowing users to edit Stories for up to 15 minutes after publishing. Allows us to fix typos in Hinglish captions or tags without deleting and losing early engagement.
how: Update the Telegram 'Studio360' bot to include an 'Edit Story' reminder link for 15 mins after publish.py runs.

title: Intelligibility Bias Weighting
text: When analyzing voice for carving, weight the frequency selection toward the 1-3kHz 'presence' region. Raw power analysis usually selects the fundamental (100-200Hz), but dipping that only thins the bed. Apply a 30dB 'authority' penalty that rises as frequencies move away from 2kHz to ensure the carve actually unmasks speech rather than just following the loudest bass tones.
how: Update the scoring logic in our audio analysis script to apply a bell-curve weight centered at 2kHz before selecting which bands to dip.

title: Clip-Edge Fade Clamping
text: When applying linear fades (data-fade-in/out), if the combined duration of the fades exceeds the total clip length, scale them proportionally so they meet exactly in the middle. This prevents gain calculation errors or overlapping logic on very short clips (like SFX).
how: Add a clamping check in the audio mixing logic that compares (fadeIn + fadeOut) against clip.duration.

title: FX Parameter Normalization & Safety
text: Prevent audio graph failures by strictly normalizing all FX parameters before rendering. Treat null, undefined, or empty strings as 'use default' rather than 0 (which is often a valid setting like 0dB). Clamp all numbers to defined min/max ranges and replace NaN with defaults. This prevents 'silent renders' caused by invalid values reaching the audio engine.
how: Implement a normalization layer in mix.py that validates every FX node against a schema before generating the final FFmpeg or Web Audio command.

title: Stable Node IDs for Automation
text: Assign stable, sequential IDs (e.g., 'n1', 'n2') to audio effect nodes when they are created. Automation lanes should target these IDs (e.g., 'fx.n1.gain') rather than array indices. This ensures that reordering effects in a chain or adding a new filter doesn't break existing volume or frequency automation points.
how: Modify the HyperFrames audio schema to include an 'id' field for every node in the 'data-fx-chain' attribute.

title: Outcome-Based Audio Naming
text: Name the outcome, never the mechanism. Instead of 'Highpass at 100Hz', use 'Remove Rumble'. Describe controls by what changes in the sound (e.g., 'Thins it out' vs 'Only the deepest') rather than signal theory. This makes audio adjustments intuitive for non-engineers and LLM planners.
how: Update the 'shared brain' and script prompts to use these terms. When Gemini suggests audio edits in `plan.py`, it should use outcome names like 'Muffle' or 'Brightness' instead of technical filter types.

title: Voice-Neutral Copy Rule
text: Ensure audio effect descriptions do not assume the source is a voice (e.g., use 'Thins the sound' instead of 'Thins the voice') unless it is a specific voice-only preset. This prevents confusing UI when applying effects to music or SFX.
how: Audit the prompts in `plan.py` and the descriptions in our shared brain to ensure they are source-agnostic.

title: Named Audio Jobs Menu
text: Implement a menu of 'Jobs' which are pre-configured peaking filters for specific frequencies: 'Tame Boominess' (200Hz), 'Reduce Mud' (250Hz), 'Reduce Boxiness' (400Hz), 'Add Clarity' (3kHz), and 'Soften Harshness' (3.2kHz). Each job has a preset gain and Q factor.
how: Add these as standard presets in `mix.py`. Allow the script planner to request a 'job' by ID to fix specific recording issues identified during the research or review phase.

title: One-Knob DSP Profiles
text: Map complex multi-parameter effects to a single 0.0-1.0 'Strength' knob. For a compressor, the knob should simultaneously lower threshold, increase ratio, and boost makeup gain (using a non-linear curve like s*s*9.5 to maintain perceived loudness).
how: In `mix.py`, implement the 'at(strength)' functions for Compressor, Gate, Saturate, Reverb, and Bitcrush using the provided anchor points and interpolation logic.

title: Precision Gain Serialization
text: When saving volume/gain values, use 6 decimal places (e.g., `.toFixed(6).replace(/\.?0+$/, '')`). This prevents rounding errors that collapse low-volume fader positions to absolute zero (mute) during project reloads.
how: Update `mix.py` and any state-saving logic to use this high-precision formatting for all linear gain values.

title: Pitch-based voice activity detection
text: Resample to 8kHz, compute YIN periodicity per 40ms frame, voiced if energy > -35dB and normalized difference < 0.15. Voiced share = frames with pitch / total frames. Silence, noise, music score near 0; speech scores >0.9.
how: In voice gate (after TTS), run voicedShare on generated audio; reject if <0.8 (indicates TTS failure, silence, or music bleed). Also use pitchTrack to verify fundamental frequency in expected range for chosen voice.

title: High-quality resampling for analysis consistency
text: Use windowed-sinc kernel (8 zero-crossings, 256 steps/crossing, cos taper) with cutoff at 95% target Nyquist. For each output sample, sum input samples within reach = zeroCrossings/scale. Scale by min(1, ratio)*cutoff. Yield every 4096 output samples.
how: In any audio analysis step (beat detection, levelling, pitch), resample input to standard rate (e.g., 22.05kHz for rhythm, 8kHz for pitch) using this method to ensure decode-rate-independent results.

title: Quantize edit points to beat grid with drift report
text: For each edit time, find nearest beat within tolerance (e.g., half median beat interval). Record shift distance; report median shift (ms), count snapped/unsnapped. Unsnapped times kept as-is.
how: In compose.py, after beat detection, snap all scene cut times to beats using snapper(); log report to review.py for alignment verification.

title: Safe leveller insertion in FX chain
text: Leveller adds gain node labeled 'Even Out Levels' with fromLeveller=true. Inserts before last node if it's a limiter (to avoid lifting into ceiling). Replaces existing leveller node by ID. Automation targets fx.<nodeId>.gain. Removes node and its lane together.
how: In mix.py, when applying levelling to voice group, ensure gain stage sits before master limiter. Store fromLeveller flag in FX chain JSON for idempotent re-application.

title: Per-beat confidence for selective sync
text: For each beat, analyze 6s window: autocorrelation at beat period (clarity), smoothed onset peak vs mean (lift). Confidence = clarity * min(1, lift/3). High confidence beats safe for hard sync; low confidence use soft sync or skip.
how: In compose.py, filter beat times by localBeatEvidence(confidence > 0.3) for hard cut snapping; use others only for soft alignment.

title: Yielding computation pattern for long renders
text: Wrap long loops in generator yielding void every N iterations (e.g., 4096 samples). Driver calls next() until done; caller can inject async pause() between yields. Enables progress UI, cancellation, and CPU sharing.
how: Refactor compose.py render loop, preflight.py checks, doctor.py tasks to use Steps pattern; integrate with existing doctor.py 10-min timer for cooperative multitasking.

title: Structured clip facts for timeline debugging
text: ClipFact schema: id, kind, start, duration, end, trackIndex, src, volume, lanes (target + points), playbackRate, audioGroup, role, sourceFile. `formatClipLine` prints rounded ms values. Helpers: `byStart` sort, `spansOverlap`/`spansShareTime` (float-safe, half-microsecond tolerance), `isInsideSpan` (strict), `sameInstant` (float rounding join).
how: Adopt ClipFact in review.py for vision review logs. Use `spansOverlap` to detect unintended clip collisions. `formatClipLine` for human-readable timeline in approval Telegram messages.

title: Chrome environment variable allowlist
text: Only passes allowlisted vars to Chrome: PATH, HOME, locale, display, XDG, fontconfig, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, GPU drivers (MESA_, VK_, __GL_, __NV_), proxies, CA bundles, Windows system dirs, macOS encoding. Extra vars via `HYPERFRAMES_CHROME_ENV_PASSTHROUGH=COMMA,SEPARATED`. Case-insensitive matching with prefix wildcards (LC_*).
how: Replace ad-hoc env filtering in render.py with `buildChromeLaunchEnv()`. Add any needed vars (e.g., for GPU) to passthrough. Prevents leaking secrets (API keys) into Chrome processes.

title: Browser process marking for orphan cleanup
text: Adds `--hyperframes-owned-browser` to every Chrome launch. Optional `--hyperframes-owner=<id>` (alphanumeric, dot, dash, 1-64 chars) from `HYPERFRAMES_OWNER` env. Idempotent: multiple wraps add marker once. `withoutHyperframesOwner()` strips owner arg for comparison.
how: Pass `HYPERFRAMES_OWNER=run-<jobId>` in render.py launch. Doctor.py can kill only marked processes. Prevents killing unrelated Chrome instances on shared servers.

title: Secondary/HSL qualifier for targeted corrections (skin, skies)
text: Up to 4 secondaries, each with hue (center 0–360, range 0–180, softness 0–180), saturation/luma (min/max 0–1, softness 0–0.5), and correction (hueShift ±180°, saturation/luma/temperature/tint ±1). Shader matches via packed 8-bit softness (unitFloatToByte(softness/0.5)). Disabled secondaries stay authored but pixel-inactive.
how: Add secondary support to compose_lab.py for skin-tone protection (hue ~24°, range 18°) or sky enhancement. Planner can specify secondaries in scene plan; preflight validates via lint.

title: Active vs authored grading detection for optimization
text: isHfColorGradingActive() returns true only if grading actually changes pixels: non-zero vignette/grain, any active effect, intensity>0 with adjust/wheels/curves/hueCurves/secondaries/LUT. hasHfColorGradingAuthoredValues() also true for disabled secondaries. Zero intensity + LUT = inactive. Finishing details (vignette/grain) count as active even at intensity 0.
how: In preflight.py, skip color grading render pass if not active. In review.py, flag authored-but-inactive grades as potential mistakes. Saves GPU time on neutral clips.

title: Variable substitution for template-driven grading
text: normalizeHfColorGradingWithVariables() resolves $var, ${var}, or whole-object $colorGrade references against a variable map before normalization. Supports nested paths in adjust, details, effects, palette, lut, secondaries. Used for dynamic theming (e.g., per-series color palette).
how: In plan.py, allow scene.grading to contain variable refs; resolve them with episode-level vars (brand colors, series mood) before passing to render. Add variable map to brain.jsonl per series.

title: Creative effect presets with calibrated defaults
text: HF_COLOR_GRADING_EFFECT_APPLY_DEFAULTS gives one-click values for 18 effects: blur 0.45, pixelate 0.55, bloom 0.55/8px, chromaBleed 0.55, tapeDamage 0.65+tracking 0.55, filmArtifacts 0.55, scanlines 0.35/count 0.17, chromaticAberration 0.15, crtCurvature 0.2, digitalGlitch 0.55 with sub-controls, halftone 0.94/size 0.36, twoInkPrint 1/size 0.42, ascii (size 5/76), dither 1/size 0.5, monoScreen 1, engraving/crosshatch/kuwahara with tuned params. Each effect has family, label, description.
how: Map these to lab-look effect tokens (e.g., 'vhs', 'halftone', 'ascii') in compose_lab.py. Planner picks by name; render applies calibrated defaults. Override sub-controls via scene plan.

title: Palette system for duotone/tritone looks
text: 15 built-in palettes (noir, ink-paper, terminal, amber-glow, handheld-green, golden-hour, deep-sea, arctic-night, synthwave, vaporwave, forest, sepia, blueprint, warm-print, electric-ink) with 2–6 colors each. Palette activates only for palette-aware effects (ascii, dither, monoScreen, engraving, crosshatch). Custom palettes accepted (2–6 hex colors, lowercased).
how: Add palette_id to scene grading spec. In compose_lab.py, pass palette to effects that support it. Use electric-ink (6 colors) for cyberpunk tech explainers, handheld-green for terminal scenes.

title: Serialization round-trip for grading version control
text: serializeHfColorGrading() omits identity wheels/curves/hueCurves but preserves authored secondaries and palette. Round-trip test guarantees byte-identical output. Disabled grading returns empty string. Lint validates serialized JSON in data-color-grading attribute.
how: Store serialized grading strings in brain.jsonl per scene. On replay, deserialize via normalizeHfColorGrading() to get full resolved object. Ensures reproducible renders across code versions.

title: Hue curve periodic sampling for HSL grading
text: `compileHfHueCurve` takes points `[hueDegrees, delta]` (0–360), mirrors last two points at -360 and first two at +360, then samples 1024 points over 0–360. Ensures smooth wrap-around for hue shifts (e.g., skin-tone protection).
how: Add hue curve UI in plan.py (e.g., "protect skin tones"). In lab shader, apply hue LUT after RGB curves: `hue = texture(hueLut, hue/360).r`.

title: Strict color curve validation with actionable errors
text: Validation throws `RangeError`/`TypeError` with messages: "Color curve inputs must be strictly increasing", "Color curves must include input endpoints 0 and 1", "Curve outputs must be between 0 and 1", "A color curve supports at most 32 points".
how: In plan.py, when parsing color grading params from Gemini, run the same checks. Fail fast with clear error so the script retry loop can fix the curve definition.

title: Scoped GSAP timeline proxy
text: Runtime wraps `gsap.timeline`, `.to`, `.from`, `.fromTo`, `.set`, `.utils.toArray`, `.utils.selector` with a Proxy. Targets (strings/arrays) are resolved via `__hfResolveGsapTarget` which uses composition-scoped `querySelectorAll`. Timeline registry is proxied so `window.__timelines[compId]` maps to the runtime timeline.
how: In compose_lab.py, inject a small GSAP proxy module before composition scripts. Ensures animations in nested compositions (e.g., badge inside card) never leak selectors or timelines to siblings.

title: LUT domain preservation for non-[0,1] ranges
text: Cube parser reads `DOMAIN_MIN`/`DOMAIN_MAX` (vec3) or `LUT_3D_INPUT_RANGE` (scalar min/max). Stores `domainMin`/`domainMax` in `CubeLut3D`. `fitCubeLutToTexture` copies them to the resampled LUT. Shader must map input colors to domain before lookup.
how: When loading creative LUTs (e.g., from DaVinci), keep `domainMin`/`domainMax`. In fragment shader: `vec3 uv = (color - domainMin) / (domainMax - domainMin); vec3 out = texture(lut, uv.xy).rgb;`

title: Variable default precedence: html → composition root
text: Variable defaults are declared on `<html data-composition-vars>` (page level) and on the composition root `[data-composition-id]` (component level). Merge left-to-right; later wins. Templated compositions only have the root carrier.
how: In plan.py, when building scene variables, apply page-level defaults first, then scene-level overrides. Store carriers in order in brain.jsonl for debugging.

title: Composition-scoped CSS via selector rewriting
text: Rewrite every stylesheet selector to be prefixed with `[data-composition-id="<instanceId>"]` at parse time, caching the parsed PostCSS AST so one sheet serves N mounts. Handles authored-root IDs, SVG clip-path/filter ID aliases, and `:is()` fallbacks for renamed IDs.
how: In compose_lab.py preflight, integrate a PostCSS-based scoper (or port the JS logic) that takes a composition's CSS and instance ID, outputs scoped CSS. Cache scoped sheets per (sheetHash, instanceId). Apply before render.

title: Nested composition guard: ancestry + depth cap
text: When assembling a page, walk `data-composition-src` hosts; skip any whose src appears in the ancestry chain (circular) or when ancestry.length >= 20. Return both hosts and skipped list with reasons.
how: Add `enumerate_nested_hosts(assembled_root, ancestry)` to compose.py/compose_lab.py. Call during plan.py scene assembly; abort or log warning on skipped. Set MAX_SUB_COMPOSITION_DEPTH=20 constant.

title: Collect template-sibling assets, not just root
text: For templated compositions (`<template>`), styles/scripts are siblings of the composition root inside the template. Scanning only the root drops entire stylesheets. Collect from the whole template content, then hoist `<link rel=stylesheet|preconnect>` from host `<head>`.
how: Modify compose_lab.py's asset collection: when `has_template=True`, query `template.content` for `style, script, link[rel=stylesheet], link[rel=preconnect]` instead of root-only. Keep head hoisting for full-document compositions.

title: SVG reference ID isolation across instances
text: SVG `clipPath`, `filter`, `gradient` IDs are rewritten per instance (e.g., `clip` → `card__hf2--clip`). The rewriter reads `data-hf-svg-reference-aliases` attributes on SVG elements, builds a map of `before→after`, and rewrites CSS `url(#id)` and attribute `clip-path="url(#id)"` references.
how: Extend preflight.py's SVG audit: when a composition is instantiated N times, generate unique IDs for all referenced SVG defs, inject `data-hf-svg-reference-aliases` on each SVG, and rewrite url() references in inline styles and attributes.

title: Preserve CSS Nesting in Scoping
text: Do not re-scope rules nested inside another rule (CSS Nesting Module). They inherit scope via the parent's & at match time. Re-scoping produces `[scope] [scope] .child` which matches nothing. Detect via rule.parent.type === 'rule'.
how: When implementing CSS scoping (item 1), skip scoping for any rule where isNestedInsideAnotherRule(rule) returns true. Allows us to use native nesting like `[data-composition-id="scene"] { .card { .header { ... } } }` safely.

title: Composition-Relative Asset Resolution
text: assetUrl(path) resolves against the composition's own source file (compositionSrc) or page baseURI. Implemented in scoped __hyperframes.assetUrl using new URL(path, compositionSrc ? new URL(compositionSrc, page) : page).
how: Add assetUrl to our HyperFrames runtime. In compose.py, pass each scene's source path to the wrapper. Allows scenes to reference assets like "assets/env.hdr" relative to their own folder, not the host page.

title: Font-face Deduplication
text: Across all stylesheets, keep only the last @font-face with identical descriptor set (family, src list, weight, style, display, unicode-range, important). Parsed via PostCSS; key = concatenated normalized declarations. Unparseable sheets pass through untouched.
how: In thumb.py/compose.py, before injecting combined CSS, run dedupeFontFaceRules on all @font-face rules. Prevents duplicate font loads when multiple scenes import the same font stylesheet.

title: Script Breakout Prevention
text: Escape every dynamic literal emitted into a <script> element: JSON.stringify(value).replace(/</g, "\\u003c"). Applied to composition IDs, variable keys/values, error labels, scope selectors, authored root IDs. Prevents </script> in data from closing the script tag and executing as markup.
how: Create jsonScriptLiteral helper. Use in plan.py when emitting any inline script (variable tables, config, composition wrappers). Critical for user-supplied text in Hinglish shorts (titles, captions).

title: Composition Root Selector Remapping
text: When scopeRootSelectors=true, bare html, body, :root selectors are remapped to the composition's own box: `[data-composition-id="x"]:not(:has([data-hf-inner-root])), [data-composition-id="x"] > [data-hf-inner-root]`. Compound forms (body.dark) fall through to normal scoping. Prevents sub-composition body{width/height/overflow} from clobbering host document.
how: In CSS scoping (item 1), enable scopeRootSelectors for any nested composition (mounted via data-composition-src). Our panel components often set body{margin:0;overflow:hidden}—this keeps them contained.

title: Media ID collision auto-suffix
text: When two scenes use the same video element `data-hf-render-id`, the bundler suffixes duplicates with `__hf2` (e.g., `clip` → `clip__hf2`). Template authors can safely reuse IDs across scenes.
how: In compose_lab.py, allow scene templates to use static `data-hf-render-id` values; rely on bundler to uniquify at bundle time.

title: Nested timeline isolation per host
text: Each nested composition host gets its own timeline key (`take-a`, `take-b`), not the shared file composition ID. Prevents timeline crosstalk when multiple panels share a style file.
how: Structure lab scenes with distinct `data-composition-id` per panel (e.g., `stat-counter`, `chart-panel`); avoid sharing a single composition ID across hosts.

title: Scoped styles/scripts for duplicate template mounts
text: When the same inline template is mounted multiple times, bundler emits scoped styles (`[data-composition-id="scene__hf1"] .title`) and unique timeline IDs (`scene__hf1`, `scene__hf2`).
how: Reuse card/clue templates in classic look by mounting the same template ID multiple times; bundler isolates styles and timelines automatically.

title: Module script base URL preservation
text: Local `<script type="module" src="./module.js">` keeps its import base URL; relative imports inside resolve correctly. Bundler does not inline module bodies.
how: Write scene modules with relative imports (`./utils.js`); reference via `<script type="module" src="./scene.js">` in template.

title: Script order: external deps before inline
text: Sub-composition external scripts (`<script src="assets/plugin.js">`) are inlined before the composition's inline scripts. Ensures plugins load first.
how: In scene templates, place plugin scripts as `<script src="...">` before any inline `<script>` that uses them.

title: Template dimension inheritance
text: Inline template's `data-width`/`data-height` are copied to the host element when mounted. Define dimensions once in template.
how: In compose.py templates, set `data-width`/`data-height` on the template's root div; host elements need not repeat them.

title: Asset inlining budget with fallback
text: Bundler stops inlining repeated assets once a byte budget is spent, leaving remaining references as relative URLs. Prevents bundle bloat from reused backgrounds/icons.
how: Add `INLINE_BUDGET_BYTES=50000000` to render pipeline; modify asset inliner to count bytes and switch to relative paths after limit, emitting a warning.

title: CDN script hoisting and deduplication
text: External CDN scripts (GSAP, Lottie) from sub-compositions are hoisted to the bundle head and deduplicated by URL. Ensures single load per library.
how: In htmlBundler step, collect all `<script src="https://...">` across compositions, deduplicate by URL, inject once in `<head>`.

title: Symlink escape guard for asset resolution
text: Bundler refuses to inline scripts reached via symlinks pointing outside project root (security). Prevents leakage of external files.
how: Add `isSafePath(resolved, projectRoot)` check in asset resolver before inlining; skip and warn if path escapes project.

title: Control character sanitization in file paths
text: Bundler detects ANSI escape sequences in composition paths, warns with visible escapes (`\x1b]0;title\x07`), and skips the file. Prevents terminal injection.
how: In scout.py and file watcher, validate filenames for control chars (regex `[\x00-\x1f\x7f]`); reject or rename before adding to project.

title: Self-contained runtime inlining
text: When no `HYPERFRAME_RUNTIME_URL` is set, bundler inlines the full runtime IIFE (~150KB) instead of emitting `<script src="">` (which causes infinite self-fetch).
how: Ensure render pipeline never sets `HYPERFRAME_RUNTIME_URL`; verify bundled HTML contains `data-hyperframes-preview-runtime` with non-trivial body.

title: Safe JS chunk concatenation with ASI hazard prevention
text: joinJsChunks trims each chunk, ensures it ends with ';' or adds '\n;' (newline closes line comments), then joins with '\n'. Prevents bugs like `a()` + `(b)()` becoming `a()(b)()`. Used before injecting merged scripts into bundle.
how: In mix.py or compose.py when concatenating multiple GSAP plugin scripts, custom animation code, and runtime snippets, apply this rule: chunk.endsWith(';') ? chunk : chunk + '\n;'.

title: Force geometricPrecision text rendering for headless Chrome parity
text: injectTextRenderingRule inserts `html,body,*{text-rendering:geometricPrecision}` at head start. Headless Chrome defaults to optimizeSpeed (integer glyph advances) causing line-wrap shifts vs full Chrome; this forces subpixel positioning for byte-aligned snapshots.
how: Add this CSS rule to the base template in compose.py/compose_lab.py (or via a style injection in the bundler) so every render gets consistent text layout between studio preview and headless render.

title: Protect SVG sprite fragment references from inlining
text: isExternalSvgFragmentUse detects <use href="sprite.svg#icon"> and skips inlining the SVG file (would make it opaque origin, breaking same-origin requirement). Only inlines if the SVG is not a fragment reference.
how: In thumb.py or compose.py when inlining assets, check if an <svg><use href=...> or <use xlink:href=...> points to an .svg file with a hash fragment; if so, keep the relative URL instead of converting to data: URL.

title: Two-phase media duration compilation with ffprobe
text: compileHtml does a static pass adding data-end from data-duration, then probes unresolved video/audio via ffprobe, injects durations, then clamps pre-resolved audio to source length while preserving explicit video slots (loop or data-end) that may outlive source. Returns HTML with data-duration/data-end on every media element.
how: In compose.py/compose_lab.py render prep, call compileHtml with a probeMediaDuration that shells to ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0. Use the returned HTML for the render so GSAP timelines have exact media durations.

title: Linear-time HTML manipulation without DOM parsing
text: htmlDocument.ts uses string scanning (markupStarts, findTagEnd, insertBeforeCloseTag) that processes 100k-tag pages in O(n) with zero lowercased copies. Functions: injectScriptsIntoHtml, stripEmbeddedRuntimeScripts, insertRuntimeTag, hasCompositionOutsideTemplates. All avoid full DOM parsing.
how: Replace any BeautifulSoup/lxml usage in compose.py, thumb.py, or scout.py with these string-based helpers (port to Python or call via Node). Especially useful for injecting runtime scripts, stripping preview markers, and tagging scene parts in large templates.

title: CSS @import inlining with URL rebasing to project root
text: inlineCssFile recursively inlines @import rules, rebases url() paths to project-relative, strips comments via placeholders, and hoists distinct @import statements to top of merged sheet. Uses isSafePath to prevent symlink escape.
how: In htmlBundler bundle step (or a pre-render CSS pass), run inlineCssFile on each <link rel=stylesheet> before rendering. This eliminates HTTP round-trips during headless Chrome render and ensures url(assets/...) resolve correctly.

title: Private file exclusion during build reads
text: BundleReadScope with privateFiles='studio' (default) blocks reads of .git/, .env*, .hyperframes/, and any VCS/secret paths via isVcsOrSecretPath / isStudioPrivatePath. onRead callback tracks every file actually read for reproducibility.
how: When running bundleToSingleHtml in doctor.py or a CI step, pass privateFiles='studio' and an onRead logger. This prevents accidental bundling of credentials, cache, or git history into the render bundle.

title: SVG ID disambiguation with data-hf-authored-id fallback for author scripts
text: When renaming colliding SVG IDs, keep the original ID on the first instance; for subsequent instances, rename the ID attribute and add data-hf-authored-id with the original ID. Author scripts using document.getElementById('originalId') will still work via a scoped shim that falls back to data-hf-authored-id.
how: Ensure compose_lab.py's SVG renaming adds data-hf-authored-id; if using HyperFrames runtime, the selector shim is already included.

title: Import map merging for ES module compositions
text: If compositions use ES modules via import maps, merge mounted composition import maps into page import map (first mapping wins, conflicts warned). Rebase specifier URLs relative to composition directory. Block invalid entries (null, non-string) as browsers do.
how: If studio adopts ES modules in HyperFrames, integrate parseImportMap and mergeImportMapsIntoDocument in compose_lab.py bundling step.

title: Preserve inner root as child with data-hf-authored-id for bundler path
text: When flattening inner root (bundler path), clone the root element, add data-hf-authored-id with original ID, remove the ID attribute, strip timing attributes, and append as child of host. This preserves the element for CSS selectors targeting #root[data-composition-id] rewritten to compound attribute selector.
how: Implement flattenInnerRoot in compose_lab.py per HyperFrames pattern; ensure CSS scoping uses compound selector for root.

title: Charge byte budget for SVG ID renaming to the mount that grows
text: Track the additional bytes added by SVG ID renaming (new IDs, updated references) and attribute them to the specific mount instance that caused the collision. Use for render budget accounting and optimization.
how: Add chargeEmitted callback in compose_lab.py inlining step; compute size delta of rewritten SVG and CSS, call with source filename and byte count.

title: Scene swap safety analysis
text: Detects side effects in scene scripts (event listeners, WebGL, Workers, timers, GSAP timelines not registered, etc.) that would prevent clean hot-swapping. Returns a refusal reason like "its script uses addEventListener" or null if safe.
how: Add a preflight check in preflight.py that runs sceneScriptSwapRefusal on each scene's script before approving a swap; mark unsafe scenes with data-hf-no-swap in the HyperFrames document.

title: Scene-part manifest for incremental rebuilds
text: Injects a meta tag with SHA1 hashes of shared page content and each scene's outerHTML. Changing one scene only invalidates its hash; shared hash ignores font-face styles so font additions don't block swaps.
how: In doctor.py or a new rebuild.py, parse the manifest to decide which scenes need re-render; only re-compose scenes whose hash changed.

title: Robust CSS selector ID token replacement
text: Replaces whole-token #id occurrences outside quotes and attribute brackets, decoding CSS escapes (\2e → ., \31 → 1) before matching. Uses escapeCssIdentifier for round-trip safe output.
how: Replace current SVG ID namespacing regex in compose_lab.py with replaceSelectorIdTokens when rewriting #clip references in stylesheets after namespacing IDs.

title: Script run grouping for safe concatenation
text: Groups adjacent classic inline scripts into runs split by external src, module, or pinned scripts. Each run anchored to the next separate-execution script, so merging never reorders past a boundary.
how: In compose.py when bundling scripts, use inlineScriptRuns to concatenate only within a run; inject each run as one script tag before its anchor.

title: Audio FX Chain Precedence
text: A scene's local data-fx-chain attribute should always override the master project's chain. If a scene declares no chain, the master chain should be explicitly removed for that standalone render to prevent double-processing or incorrect LUFS levels.
how: Update 'mix.py' to check for scene-level FX attributes first before applying global mastering settings.

title: Namespace Prefix Capping
text: Limit the length of generated namespace prefixes (e.g., 48 chars). If a namespace is too long, use a hash of the value to ensure the resulting element IDs remain within safe browser/CSS limits.
how: Use a hashing utility in our asset pipeline to shorten long file-path-based namespaces when generating unique IDs for complex 'Aage Suno' stories.

title: Standalone Scene Extraction
text: Extract a single composition from a master index.html while preserving global library scripts (GSAP) in the <body>, resetting the target scene's data-start to 0, and adopting the scene's specific data-duration and data-fx-chain.
how: Implement in a new 'isolate.py' or within 'preflight.py' to allow rendering and auditing individual scenes in isolation without loading the entire project timeline.

title: Pure editing affordance resolution by element facts
text: resolveEditingAffordances() takes normalized facts (tag, computed/inline styles, composition role, lock state, source existence, editable text, timing, animation count) and returns capabilities (canMove, canResize, canCrop, canEditStyles) and section applicability (text, media, colorGrading, timing, animation, layout, style, audioFx). No DOM, no getComputedStyle — caller supplies facts. Audio and hf-audio-group get timing but never animation/layout/style.
how: Use in plan.py to decide which panels (colorGrading, audioFx, animation) to generate per scene element. Feed facts from HyperFrames composition spec. Prevents offering animation controls on audio-only tracks. Map canCrop to Ken Burns vs static decision in classic look.

title: Deterministic timing resolver enables preview==render parity
text: resolveTimings() is a single pure implementation intended for both preview (SDK session) and render (timingCompiler) paths. Tests assert identical output for identical input — once both paths call it, drift is impossible. Anchor-producing inputs (TTS word timings) come from backend; until wired, parity is a property of the function, not the live paths.
how: Ensure plan.py and render pipeline both import the same timing resolver (port to Python or call via Node). Store word timings in brain.jsonl per video. When regenerating, reuse resolver with same anchors to guarantee identical enter/exit/hold. Document as contract in playbook.md.

title: Distributed renderer FPS allowlist
text: DISTRIBUTED_FPS = [24, 25, 30, 60] — only integer rates accepted by Lambda/Cloud Run render workers. Fractional FPS (23.976, 29.97) render in-process only. isDistributedFps() guards job routing.
how: In publish.py and render queue, validate output FPS against this list before sending to cloud render. For NTSC sources, force 30 or 60 in-process. Add to preflight.py check. Prevents failed distributed renders due to FPS mismatch.

title: In-place radix-2 FFT for beat/onset detection
text: fft(re, im) modifies Float64Arrays in place, O(N log N), no allocations. Input length must be power of two. Can run in Node or browser. Pair with 16kHz mono PCM from TTS or music bed to extract spectral flux or onset strength for beat-synced cuts.
how: Add fft.ts to audio/analysis.py. Downmix music bed to mono 16kHz, window in 1024-sample frames, compute magnitude spectrum, track spectral flux peaks. Output beat grid timestamps to plan.py for quantize edit points. Keep free-stack: no external deps.

title: Env proxy detection for resilient asset fetching
text: fetchGoesThroughEnvProxy(env, execArgv) returns true only when HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy is set AND NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 or --use-env-proxy flag present. Handles case-insensitive env vars and NODE_OPTIONS parsing. Separates proxy config from runtime support.
how: Add to scout.py and image/clip fetchers (Muse, Pollinations, Cloudflare). Before each batch fetch, check envProxyEnabled(); if false but proxy vars exist, warn in dashboard. In doctor.py, verify proxy connectivity before long downloads. Prevents silent hangs in restricted networks.

title: Figma asset snippet generation with escaped attributes
text: buildAssetSnippet() emits with all interpolated values HTML-escaped (&, <, >, "). Returns {path, html}. Provenance includes fileKey, nodeId, format. Used for design-to-code asset injection.
how: If studio uses Figma for thumbnails/lab UI panels, add figma/assetSnippet.ts to thumb.py. Pull manifest from Figma API, generate snippets, inject into HyperFrames HTML. Escaping prevents XSS from designer-written descriptions. Track nodeId in brain.jsonl for update detection.

title: Figma API client retry/backoff with Retry-After cap at 60 s
text: Shared get() retries 429 up to 3 times (configurable), honors Retry-After header (seconds) capped at 60 s, exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Maps 403 'Invalid token' → BAD_TOKEN, scope errors → FORBIDDEN with exact scope name, 403 on variables → REQUIRES_ENTERPRISE.
how: Apply same retry/cap pattern in our Muse/FLUX/Pollinations wrappers (muse.py, flux.py); add endpoint attribution (low-cardinality labels) to telemetry for debugging.

title: Color conversion: figma {r,g,b,a} floats → #RRGGBB or rgba()
text: figmaColorToCss() multiplies channels by 255, rounds, hex-pads; if alpha<1 emits rgba(r,g,b,alpha) with 4-decimal precision. Handles extraOpacity multiplier for layer opacity stacking.
how: Use in compose_lab.py when applying figma token colors to GSAP/HTML styles; ensures exact brand color match without manual hex copying.

title: Ease mapping table covering motion.dev named eases → GSAP
text: mapEase() covers 25+ names (easeOut→power2.out, backInOut→back.inOut, circOut→circ.out, expoInOut→expo.inOut, bounceOut→bounce.out, elasticOut→elastic.out, anticipate→back.in, spring→elastic.out, hold→hold). Unknown → none (linear). Bezier 4-tuples passed through.
how: Add to motionEase.ts in our pipeline; use when translating any designer-provided easing specs (Figma, After Effects, CSS) to GSAP in lab look.

title: Text-box-trim for vertically trimmed Figma text
text: When text node's box height < lineHeightPx, nodeToHtml emits text-box-trim: trim-both; text-box-edge: cap alphabetic. Prevents glyph overflow in browser render vs Figma trimmed bounds.
how: Apply same logic in compose_lab.py when rendering text layers from figma tokens or Muse-generated captions; ensures Hinglish/English captions match design.

title: Figma design-token bindings with exact-ID resolution
text: Store Figma variable/style IDs in .media/figma-bindings.jsonl with aliasChain and version; resolve at compose time via exact figmaId match (never by name/value). Upsert on re-import replaces stale rows by figmaId, preserving other files' bindings.
how: Add a figma-tokens import step in scout.py/plan.py that writes bindings via upsertBindings(); modify compose_lab.py to resolve colors/variables through findBindingByFigmaId() before rendering, falling back to baked literals for unresolved.

title: Node-to-HTML conversion with binding-aware styles and rasterize list
text: nodeToHtml() outputs positioned HTML with data-figma-id, resolves fills/text colors to var(--figma-*) with literal fallback, flags unresolved via data-figma-unresolved, routes VECTOR/IMAGE-fill nodes to rasterize list (img placeholders), handles gradients, shadows, text-box-trim for trimmed text, sanitizes fontFamily.
how: Integrate in compose_lab.py: import Figma frame as base layout, run nodeToHtml with resolved/unresolved bindings from bindings.ts, feed rasterize list to Muse image-to-video, inject HTML into HyperFrames template.

title: JSONL reader skips malformed lines with warning
text: readJsonlValues() parses each line, on JSON.parse failure logs warning with first 40 chars and continues; prevents partial writes from crashing downstream readers.
how: Replace current JSONL reads in brain.jsonl, results.md, playbook.md with this function; add terminalText warning to doctor.py log.

title: Double-Paint Prevention
text: When a node is flagged for rasterization (e.g., complex vectors or images), suppress its CSS background-color and border-radius. The exported image already contains these; applying them in CSS causes 'double-painting' artifacts like flat color blocks behind the art.
how: In `compose_lab.py`, add a conditional check to skip background/border styles if the element is an tag sourced from a Figma raster export.

title: CSS-Safe ID Minting
text: Figma names often start with digits (e.g., '3D Panel'). These are valid HTML IDs but invalid CSS selectors for querySelector(). Prefix digit-leading slugs with 'n' (e.g., 'n3d-panel') to ensure GSAP and CSS targeting work without escaping.
how: Update the ID generation logic in `compose_lab.py` to check for leading digits and apply the 'n' prefix before rendering HyperFrames HTML.

title: Canonical CSS Sanitization
text: Attackers can bypass regex filters using CSS escapes (e.g., '\75 rl' for 'url'). Decode hex escapes and normalize whitespace/line-feed folds (CRLF to LF) before scanning for forbidden keywords like '@import' or external 'url()' calls.
how: Integrate a CSS normalization function into `preflight.py` or a shared utility to scrub any dynamic CSS or SVG style blocks before rendering.

title: Context-Aware Href Security
text: In SVGs, allow 'data:image/' URLs only on resource-fetching tags like <image> or <use>. Block them on <a> tags, as they can trigger top-level navigation/XSS in browsers. Always allow local fragment identifiers (starting with '#').
how: Add a tag-specific check to the SVG sanitizer in `preflight.py` to differentiate between inert resource fetches and dangerous navigation links.

title: Variable Collection Namespacing
text: Figma allows identical variable names in different collections (e.g., 'Blue' in 'Brand' vs 'Blue' in 'Primitives'). Namespace composition IDs as 'figma:Collection/Name' to prevent collisions during brand-token resolution.
how: Update `research.py` or the Figma import script to include the collection name in the variable mapping key used by HyperFrames.

title: Alias Chain Leaf Resolution
text: Walk Figma VARIABLE_ALIAS chains to find the final leaf value (color/number) but record the semantic ID. This ensures the video uses the correct value while maintaining the link for future brand updates. Include cycle detection to prevent infinite loops.
how: Add a recursive resolver to the variable processing step in our Figma-to-HTML pipeline to flatten alias chains before they reach the HyperFrames template.

title: Font alias resolution for typo tolerance
text: Resolves authored font-family spellings (case, spaces, hyphens, underscores) to declared Google Fonts families (e.g., "Saira ExtraCondensed" → "Saira Extra Condensed") while emitting faces under the authored name so CSS still matches. Works for @import, <link>, and local @font-face declarations.
how: In compose_lab.py and compose.py, when specifying font families for kinetic titles or captions, use the exact Google Fonts family name (with spaces) in @import but allow authored CSS to use common typo variants; the resolver will map them at compile time.

title: Oblique/variable font style embedding
text: Supports font-style: oblique, oblique 10deg, oblique 0deg 10deg, oblique -12.5deg 2.5deg. Each subset (per unicode-range) is embedded with correct font-style and font-weight range (e.g., 100 1000). Enables smooth GSAP animation of font-variation-settings 'slnt' axis for kinetic titles.
how: In compose_lab.py kinetic title animations, use variable fonts with 'slnt' axis (e.g., Roboto Flex). Animate fontVariationSettings: '"slnt" 0' to '"slnt" -10' via GSAP. Ensure @import requests the full slnt,wght range (e.g., family=Roboto+Flex:slnt,wght@-10..0,100..1000).

title: Fail-closed font fetching for deterministic renders
text: With failClosedFontFetch=true, any unresolved font (network error, 5xx, 4xx after alias attempts) throws FontFetchError before render starts, preventing non-deterministic fallback fonts across workers. 4xx from Google Fonts is treated as deterministic "family not served" and falls through to bundled/alias lookup without tripping fail-closed.
how: Add failClosedFontFetch: true to injectDeterministicFontFaces calls in the render pipeline (likely in preflight.py or the HyperFrames compiler step). Ensure fontFetchRetryPolicy is set (baseDelayMs: 0, maxAttempts: 3) for transient 5xx. Catch FontFetchError in doctor.py to surface as actionable render failure.

title: Parse-once HTML optimization for font steps
text: normalizeSystemFontPrimaryFamilies and injectDeterministicFontFaces share a parsed DOM tree when called sequentially on the same HTML string, avoiding double parseHTML (linkedom) calls. Saves ~50-100ms per render on typical pages.
how: In the render pipeline, ensure the HTML passes through normalizeSystemFontPrimaryFamilies then injectDeterministicFontFaces without re-stringifying/re-parsing between steps. If using separate modules, pass the parsed document or use the same HTML string reference.

title: Locale-aware text subsetting for transforms
text: Font subset requests must include transformed characters: uppercase/lowercase per lang (Turkish İ/ı, Azeri), full-width (ＡＢＣ), full-size-kana (ぁ→あ), and composed forms (á→á). CSS variables and nested lang attributes are resolved. Budget: ≤1700 encoded chars per request; exceed → request full font.
how: When generating caption/title HTML for HyperFrames, ensure the text passed to font subsetter includes all transformed variants. Use lang="hi" for Devanagari, lang="en" for English. Preflight.py should verify subset size <1700 chars.

title: Cross-render Google Fonts CSS cache
text: Cache Google Fonts CSS responses keyed by family+text subset. Concurrent callers share the same in-flight lookup; one caller's abort doesn't invalidate the cache for others. Cache persists across renders in the same process.
how: Implement a module-level cache in a new font_service.py used by compose.py, thumb.py, and preflight.py. Key by (family, text_subset, weight, style). Invalidate on config change. Saves ~200ms per font per render.

title: CSS variable font-family resolution
text: Resolve var(--font, fallback) chains, nested vars, and cycles. Undefined vars use fallback list; defined vars override. System-font keywords (-apple-system, system-ui) get Inter prepended when undefined. Inherit/initial are treated as keywords, not fonts.
how: Extend font_service.py to parse CSS variables from :root and component styles before font injection. Pass resolved families to HyperFrames injectDeterministicFontFaces. Critical for lab look theming (dark/light modes via vars).

title: Google Fonts Weight Supplementing
text: When using a bundled font (like Montserrat), if the CSS requests a weight not in the bundle (e.g., 200), fetch only that specific weight from Google Fonts to supplement the local faces. This provides design flexibility without bloating the local font library.
how: Modify our font resolver to check if a requested weight exists in our local 'Free stack' (Muse/Cloudflare); if missing, trigger a targeted Google Fonts CSS fetch for that specific weight.

title: Serverless Font Cache Strategy
text: In read-only environments like AWS Lambda, use mkdtemp in /tmp for font caching. For local dev, use a persistent cache dir. This ensures font downloads are shared across warm instances even when the home directory is locked.
how: Update our asset resolver to check for environment variables (like AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME) and redirect the font cache to a writable /tmp path with a stable process-level suffix.

title: On-the-fly WOFF2 Compression
text: Use wawoff2 to compress TTF/OTF fonts to WOFF2 before converting to Data URIs for inlining. This significantly reduces the size of the final HTML sent to the headless browser, improving render startup speed.
how: Integrate wawoff2 into our font-inlining step. Cache the compressed WOFF2 buffers by SHA-256 hash to avoid re-compressing the same fonts across different projects.

title: HDR reference nits from keyframe transfers
text: toneMapReferenceNits returns 203 nits only if every keyframe transfer is arib-std-b67 (HLG); otherwise 100 nits (PQ). Unspecified transfers inherit stream transfer. Probed first-frame tags fill missing tags before tone map.
how: In media metadata extraction (scout.py/research.py), run ffmpeg -discard nokey -bsf:v trace_headers to collect keyframe transfers. Pass to tone map filter. Avoids blown highlights on mixed PQ/HLG sources.

title: Capture canvas marking protocol
text: Chrome ≤155 uses canvas[layoutsubtree]; ≥157 uses canvas[content=drawable] + child[drawable]. markCaptureCanvas/markCaptured/unmarkCaptured toggle attributes. CAPTURE_CANVAS_SELECTOR finds nested capture canvases.
how: In render worker (compose.py), after htmlInCanvasForm detection, call markCaptureCanvas on the capture canvas. Before screenshot, markCaptured on target elements. Ensures Chrome captures correct subtree for nested compositions.

title: HTML-in-canvas form detection
text: htmlInCanvasForm checks CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.drawElementImage and canvas.requestPaint + canvas.layoutSubtree (old) or canvas.updateElementGeometry (new). Returns 'layoutsubtree' | 'drawable' | null.
how: In compose.py render init, call htmlInCanvasForm(window). If null, abort with clear error. Log form to telemetry. Ensures we only render on Chrome versions that support Element Capture API.

title: Capture defect scanner for preflight
text: createDefectScan samples the DOM at each render step, detecting: nested capture canvas, accelerated/WebGL canvas, iframe/object/embed in root, root transform/opacity/blend-mode, backface-visibility in 3D context. Returns first defect with timestamp.
how: Integrate into preflight.py after HyperFrames HTML generation but before render: run scan in headless Chrome, fail fast on defects. Add to doctor.py for stuck-job diagnosis. Uses same Chrome pool as render.

title: Rich-text sanitizer preserving safe inline styles
text: richTextHtml parses with linkedom, runs sanitizeRichTextChildren (allows b, i, u, s, strong, em, span with font-size/color, br, sup, sub), strips scripts/on* handlers/url() backgrounds, serializes with entity escaping. Round-trips entities.
how: Replace current caption HTML injection in compose.py with this sanitizer. Feed plan.py's caption text through richTextHtml before writing to HyperFrames data-content. Prevents XSS from AI-generated captions.

title: CSS translate property handler with GSAP sync
text: Position edits IIFE reads data-x/data-y, computes delta from data-hf-edit-base-x/y, merges into element's translate style via calc(), preserves original translate in data-hf-edit-original-translate. Skips fold if unchanged. Wraps seek to reapply.
how: Adopt in compose_lab.py's GSAP timeline: store base x/y in data attributes, use translate property (not transform) for 2D moves. Add seek listener to reapply position edits after scrub. Reduces transform thrash.

title: First-frame color probe + keyframe transfer args
text: firstFrameColourArgs runs ffmpeg -frames:v 1 -vf showinfo to get color_space/primaries/trc. keyframeTransferArgs uses -discard nokey -bsf:v trace_headers (filter_units=pass_types=33 for HEVC) to list SPS transfers per keyframe.
how: Add to media indexer (stats.py/scout.py): run both probes on ingest, store in brain.jsonl. Enables correct tone map filter selection later without re-probing. Cost: ~200ms per clip.

title: GIF Disposal Artifact Prevention
text: Detect if a GIF 'ghosts' by checking if frames are left in place (disposal 1) then followed by background clearing (disposal 2). Force 'DISPOSE_TO_BACKGROUND' (9) to ensure clean frames.
how: Update asset processing to use 'clearGifFramesBeforeNext' logic when handling animated stickers or icons in 'Kaise Tech' lab looks.

title: GIF Metadata Extraction
text: Parse GIF binary headers (NETSCAPE2.0) to extract loop counts and frame-specific delays. Clamp delays <= 1cs to 10cs to match browser playback behavior.
how: Apply in 'research.py' when Gemini analyzes reference shorts to accurately estimate the pacing of animated assets.

title: Keyframe Property Defaults
text: Maintain a static map of 'rest' values for animation properties (opacity: 1, scale: 1, x/y: 0, rotation: 0) to handle missing authored values safely.
how: Use 'KEYFRAME_PROPERTY_DEFAULTS' in the GSAP generator to ensure elements don't 'disappear' if a Gemini plan omits a starting state.

title: SignalStats Media Grade Analysis
text: Use FFmpeg 'signalstats' filter to extract YMIN, YMAX, and SATAVG. Calculate suggested exposure, contrast, and temperature adjustments based on normalized averages and clipping risks (e.g., YLOW <= 16).
how: Integrate into 'review.py' or 'preflight.py'. Use the logic in 'mediaGradeAnalyzer.ts' to auto-suggest exposure tweaks for dark clips in 'Puraan Ki Katha' videos.

title: Asset Readiness Gate
text: Block rendering/previewing until HTMLMediaElement.readyState >= 3 (HAVE_FUTURE_DATA) and Lottie animations have totalFrames > 0.
how: Add a check in 'preflight.py' using the 'previewAssetsUnloaded' logic to prevent Gemini from 'watching' blank or loading frames.

title: ENOENT Path Recovery
text: Extract missing file paths from ENOENT error messages or error chains using regex to identify exactly which asset failed.
how: Update 'doctor.py' to parse logs and automatically re-trigger 'Muse' or 'Cloudflare' jobs for specific missing filenames.

title: Project Discovery via Spotlight
text: On macOS, use 'mdfind' with a query for project markers (hyperframes.json) to find projects instantly instead of a slow recursive walk. Fall back to a walk for other OSs.
how: Update 'scout.py' or the studio dashboard to use 'spotlightMarkers' for near-instant project listing when running on local dev machines.

title: GSAP Introspection: Set-Seeding
text: When parsing GSAP scripts for preflight, 'gsap.set()' calls must seed the 'from' state of subsequent '.to()' tweens. This prevents 'jumpy' animations where the starting state is unknown to the parser.
how: Update 'preflight.py' logic to track the most recent 'set' values per selector. Use these to populate 'fromProperties' when evaluating if a scene actually contains motion.

title: Video Proxy Dimension Rungs
text: Quantize video proxy dimensions to a fixed ladder: 256 * 2^(k/4) (e.g., 256, 304, 362, 430...). This ensures nearby aspect ratios share cached proxy files, reducing disk usage and transcode time.
how: In our media proxy logic, apply 'quantizePreviewProxyBox' before triggering a transcode. This will significantly optimize the 'Muse' browser cache for recurring video formats.

title: CSS animation adapter: WAAPI sync + hidden-clip fallback
text: The CSS adapter drives CSS Animations via WAAPI currentTime when available, but for display:none clips (no live Animation) it writes animationDelay = -(localTime) and animationPlayState=paused. On rediscover it restores authored delay/play-state, so hidden clips show correct pose when revealed.
how: In compose_lab.py, any UI panel that uses CSS @keyframes (e.g., spinning loaders, pulsing dots) must be registered via the CSS adapter. Ensure clips with display:none have data-start on ancestor. Preflight should call adapter.discover() before still capture.

title: Readiness adapters for async assets (maps, D3, WebGL)
text: createReadinessAdapter wraps any async-ready signal (Google Maps tilesloaded, D3 transition.end()) into getReadyPromise(). The render pipeline can await all adapters' promises before first frame, avoiding blank tiles or half-drawn charts.
how: In plan.py, when a scene includes a map or D3 chart, add a readiness adapter instance to the scene metadata. In the render worker, await Promise.all(adapters.map(a => a.getReadyPromise?.())) before starting frame loop. Document in playbook.md.

title: GSAP authored-order stamping determines same-time priority
text: stampAuthoredOrder(gsap) runs once at load, assigning incremental _hfOrder to each tween. At identical start times, the later-authored tween wins. This is deterministic and matches GSAP's native behavior. Compositions must add tweens in visual priority order (bottom layer first).
how: In compose_lab.py, ensure kinetic titles, panel shines, and stat counters are added to the timeline in z-order (background → foreground). Add a lint rule in preflight.py that warns if a later-added tween targets same property on same element without overwrite:'auto'.

title: Mute discrete GSAP callbacks during preflight/still generation
text: muteDiscreteCallbacks([timeline]) temporarily replaces onStart, onComplete, onReverseComplete, onRepeat with no-ops while preserving onUpdate. Returns a restore() function. Prevents side-effects (analytics, state mutations, sound triggers) during Gemini still audit or review.py frame checks.
how: Wrap preflight.py's per-scene still render: restore = muteDiscreteCallbacks([sceneTimeline]); renderStill(); restore(). Also wrap review.py's vision review renders. Add to HyperFrames render context as a context manager.

title: Overlap span detection for GSAP property conflicts
text: Scans all tweens per target, builds `PropertyWrite` (start, end, properties set, authoredOrder). Detects overlaps where two tweens write same property. `settleOverlapsEndedBetween(from, to)` finds sets that end in range and restarts earlier tween to `laterStart - 1e-4` to re-apply correctly.
how: Add `spansWhereTweensShareAProperty` in compose_lab.py GSAP utilities. Call `settleOverlapsEndedBetween` in seek path when seeking backwards. Cache spans per timeline version.

title: Three.js loading manager hook for render-ready gating
text: Wraps `THREE.DefaultLoadingManager.onStart` to arm a pending promise when new loads queue. `getReadyPromise()` returns promise that resolves when `itemsTotal <= itemsLoaded`. Re-installs user callbacks. `discover()` called repeatedly to catch late-loaded THREE.
how: Add ThreeAdapter class in compose_lab.py mirroring three.ts. Call `discover()` in preflight.py each render cycle. Await `getReadyPromise()` before screenshot capture. Track `itemsLoaded/itemsTotal` via injected `onLoad` wrapper.

title: TypeGPU present heartbeat for paused GPU canvas
text: When paused on a WebGPU composition (`data-requires-webgpu`), re-dispatches `hf-seek` at `TYPEGPU_PRESENT_HEARTBEAT_MS=250ms` interval via `forceDispatchSeekEvent` to re-present last frame. Stops heartbeat on `play()` or `revert()`. Skips if seek-completion barrier active.
how: Add `startPresentHeartbeat/stopPresentHeartbeat` to TypeGPU adapter in compose_lab.py. In render loop, when `pause()` called and GPU composition present, start 250ms interval calling `forceDispatchSeekEvent(currentTime)`. Guard with `isSeekCompletionBarrierActive()`.

title: Resilient Playhead Following
text: The playhead should follow the primary 'playing voice' (Charon) even if secondary SFX or background clips are late or broken. It avoids freezing the composition if a media element has no source or a network error, ensuring the video completes even with asset misses.
how: In mix.py and the runtime, designate the TTS voice track as the 'master clock'. If an SFX clip is in state readyState < 4, the playhead should continue moving based on the voice track's progress rather than stalling.

title: Vendor-Agnostic Runtime Analytics
text: Emit events like 'composition_loaded', 'composition_played', and 'element_picked' via a postMessage bridge. This separates the event trigger from the provider (PostHog/Mixpanel), allowing the host app to handle data routing.
how: Add emitAnalyticsEvent calls to our HyperFrames runtime. When a video finishes rendering or a preflight fails, send a postMessage to our dashboard to track pipeline health and template performance.

title: Headless Video Texture Substitution
text: Headless Chrome often fails to extract valid frames from
how: In compose_lab.py, if we use WebGL for HUD/UI panels, we should modify our render loop to inject decoded frame snapshots as tags next to

title: CSS Value Sanitization
text: When injecting variables into CSS custom properties, strip characters like ';', '{', '}', and '<'. This prevents 'declaration smuggling' where a user-provided string variable could inject malicious CSS or break the stylesheet structure.
how: Add a sanitizeCssValue utility to our script generation logic. Any time we map a variable from ideas.py to a style attribute or CSS variable, run this regex: .replace(/[;{}<>\r\n]/g, '').

title: Caption State Classification
text: Automatically distinguish 'active' vs 'dim' caption words by comparing GSAP tween targets against the CSS 'rest' color. If a tween targets a color different from the stylesheet's base color, classify it as the 'active' (spoken) state. This allows applying global overrides (like changing the highlight color) to pre-existing animations without manual tagging.
how: In the caption renderer, use `getComputedStyle` to find the base color, then scan `gsap.getTweensOf` to identify and repaint the 'active' color targets.

title: Structural FX Swapping
text: Swap audio effect chains (adding/removing nodes) without restarting the source node. By disconnecting the old chain and splicing the new one between the source and destination gain stages, the audio continues playing seamlessly while the DSP changes. This prevents the 'audio chop' heard during live edits or template updates.
how: Modify `mix.py` or the render engine to support dynamic graph rebuilding. Use a 'detach/attach' pattern where the source node remains connected to a temporary destination during the swap to avoid gaps.

title: Rate-Aware Automation Re-anchoring
text: When `playbackRate` changes, re-calculate all automation lanes (fades, sweeps) against the new wall-clock time. A 10s sweep at 1x must become a 5s sweep at 2x wall-clock time to stay aligned with the material. Without this, envelopes drift and finish after the audio ends.
how: In the audio scheduler, implement a `setRate(rate)` method that rebases the 'elapsed' clip-time and re-schedules all future `AudioParam` events from the current playhead.

title: Worklet-Gated Dry Path
text: AudioWorklet nodes (limiters, compressors) throw errors if constructed before their modules register. Implement a 'dry-until-ready' gate: play the audio without effects (dry) while the worklet loads, then automatically swap the full FX chain in once registration resolves. This prevents silent tracks or initialization crashes.
how: Add a `chainNeedsWorklets` check before rendering. If true, start a dry connection and use a Promise to trigger a 'rebuild' of the audio graph once `audioWorklet.addModule` finishes.

title: Visual Change Flashing
text: Implement a 'flash-elements' command that applies a temporary CSS pulse animation (e.g., 2px blue outline) to specific selectors. This is used to visually highlight which parts of a frame were modified by an AI edit or a code fix during the review process.
how: Add a global CSS rule for `.__hf-flash` with a pulse keyframe. Create a helper that adds this class to elements and removes it after a set duration (e.g., 800ms).

title: Bridge Security for External Previews
text: When framing the studio preview on another site, restrict the bridge to 'playback-only' commands (play, pause, seek). Block inspection commands (pick-mode, flash-elements, runtime-data) to prevent sensitive metadata leakage while still allowing external stakeholders to review the video flow.
how: In the communication bridge, check for a `servedToAnotherSite` flag (via meta tag) and filter the `CONTROL_HANDLERS` map to a safe subset.

title: Ink Reach Calculation
text: Calculate the 'ink' padding of an element by summing its `box-shadow`, `text-shadow`, `filter: drop-shadow()`, and `outline`. Use `3 * sigma` for `blur()` filters. This prevents clipping of glows or shadows during isolated mover captures. Cap at 256px.
how: Add an `ink.py` utility to the render pipeline. Before capturing an element for a motion trail, use Gemini or a headless script to check computed styles and expand the capture box by the calculated ink reach.

title: Short-Way-Round Rotation Interpolation
text: When interpolating between two rotation matrices for sub-frame motion blur taps, ensure the rotation follows the shortest path (e.g., 350° to 10° should pass through 0°, not 180°). This prevents 'spinning' glitches during fast turns.
how: In the sub-frame tap generator within our GSAP-to-MP4 logic, apply a shortest-path algorithm to the rotation component of the affine transform matrices.

title: Layout-Aware Pose Reading
text: Accurately determine an element's global position by composing `offsetLeft/Top` with all parent transforms and subtracting `scrollLeft/Top`. This is critical for aligning synthesized blur trails with the actual DOM elements.
how: Implement a recursive coordinate resolver in the render runtime that accounts for the full CSS transform chain and parent container scroll offsets.

title: Half-open clip windows with 1 µs terminal epsilon
text: isInClipWindow(t,start,end) = t>=start && t<end && !sameInstant(t,end) (sameInstant uses 1e-9 tolerance). isClipVisibleAt adds terminal grace: if end >= compositionDuration-1e-6, clip stays visible at and past composition end so last frame doesn't blink to blank. isClipOnScreenAt snaps start/end to frame grid via exportClipWindow() before testing.
how: In plan.py/scene timing, adopt half-open [start,end) for all clips. In review.py frame-accurate checks, use isClipVisibleAt with compositionDuration and TERMINAL_EPSILON_SECONDS=1e-6. Ensures final frame of video holds without one-frame gap.

title: Single-clock TransportClock with stall correction
text: One TransportClock drives both interactive preview and render: play() records _playStartMs, pause() snapshots _baseTime, seek() resets _playStartMs to now. On each now() read while playing, if wall-clock gap since last read >500 ms, add (gap-33 ms) to _playStartMs so the stall never counts as played time. Audio-master mode clears _lastReadMs so fallback starts fresh.
how: Replace any dual-clock or GSAP-driven timeline in compose.py/plan.py with this TransportClock class (port to Python). Use in render loop: call clock.now() once per frame; stall correction auto-handles GC pauses or slow frames. For audio sync, attach TTS element via attachAudioSource(); clock follows its currentTime, falls back to monotonic on pause/buffer.

title: Captured media idle route: Web Audio graph mute without mix restart
text: When audio element hidden (data-hidden), its MediaElementSourceNode gain set to 0; when shown, gain restored. Group mute (hf-audio-group) toggles all members' gains. Lease/release for paused scrub: leasePausedMedia() connects element directly to destination at its own volume; releasePausedMedia() returns to graph. No stopAll() calls on mute/unmute.
how: In mix.py, implement Web Audio graph with per-track gain nodes. On scene hide (data-hidden), set gain.gain.value=0. On group mute, iterate members. For Telegram preview scrub, leasePausedMedia(element) connects element→destination bypassing graph; release restores. Avoids audio glitches during seek.

title: CSS custom properties for dynamic grading with automatic clamping
text: Grading values are read from inline CSS properties (--hf-color-grading-exposure, --hf-color-grading-blur, etc.) on every redraw. Invalid values are clamped to safe ranges (e.g., exposure -2..2, blur 0..1, intensity 0..1) without throwing.
